izzyondroid:com.open.simplesongfinder.description:
Simple Song Collector is a very basic Android app that allows search and download of the audio track from Youtube songs and videos.
 There are several subscription music services available on Android, but none of them expose their song files or have a working API/SDK that would allow third party apps to access the users music library. Simple Song Collector will allow the user to find the same songs from their music library and get a physical song file on their Android device that other apps can use.

 Incoming SMS or calls
 Push notifications
 Low battery alerts
 Charger connection status changes

fdroid:chromahub.rhythm.app.description:
Your Music, Your Rhythm
Experience your music collection like never before. Rhythm is a beautiful, open-source Material You music player built for audiophiles, supporting both local and streaming playback. Enjoy high-quality audio with zero tracking and absolutely no ads. 
🔊 Audiophile-Grade Sound
• High-Res Audio: Preserves native sample rates and bit depths for pure, unaltered sound.
• Advanced EQ: Perfect your audio with a 10-band equalizer and over 6,000 AutoEQ presets tailored to your specific headphones.
• Premium Playback: Enjoy true gapless playback and support for all major formats (FLAC, ALAC, Opus, WAV, MP3, OGG, and Dolby Atmos/EAC3-JOC). 
🎨 Gorgeous Material 3 Design
• Dynamic Colors: The app's theme adapts beautifully to your wallpaper (Android 12+) and the current album artwork.
• Fluid UI: Experience expressive shapes, smooth animations, and an immersive, distraction-free lyrics view.
• Responsive Widgets: Control your music straight from your home screen with modern Material 3 layouts. 
📚 Smart Library & Lyrics
• Dual-Mode Playback: Seamlessly switch between your local music library and streaming servers (Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin).
• Synced Lyrics: Sing along with word-by-word highlighting via LRCLib, or use the local editor for custom offsets.
• Ultimate Organization: Browse by Songs, Liked, Playlists, Albums, Artists, Album Artists, Dates, or the folder Explorer.
• Multi-Select Power: Manage your queue, share, or delete multiple tracks at once with batch actions.
• Reliable Scanning: A full-scan media scanner ensures no songs are ever missed, with configurable allowed formats. 
⚙️ Feature-Packed
• Rhythm Guard: Integrated hearing safety system with age-aware volume protection.
• Built-in metadata editor with artwork integration from Deezer and YouTube Music.
• Sleep timer, playback statistics, and stability tools for a crash-free experience.
• Easy queue management and M3U playlist import/export.
• In-app auto-updates directly from GitHub. 
🔒 100% Private
Rhythm respects your data. There are no ads, no analytics, and no accounts required. It is completely offline-capable and proudly open-source (GPL v3).

fdroid:com.retekey.name: ReteKey
fdroid:com.retekey.summary: Hangul keyboard with Esc, Tab, Ctrl and F-keys. 470 KB, one permission.
fdroid:com.retekey.description:
A Hangul keyboard for developers and power users — for anyone who needs Esc, Tab, Ctrl chords, function and arrow keys on a phone, and a keyboard that behaves itself in a terminal.
It is small and asks for almost nothing. The APK is about 470 KB, most of that the Hanja tables, written in plain Java with no third-party runtime dependencies; the Hanja tables are memory-mapped straight out of the APK, so they cost storage rather than memory. It declares a single permission, VIBRATE — an ordinary permission, never requested at runtime, driving nothing but the buzz under your finger, which you can turn down to zero. No network, no account, no analytics.
And nothing is missing for it.
The keys other keyboards leave out
Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Meta, F1-F12, the arrows, Home and End, PgUp and PgDn, Ins, forward-delete and PrtSc, sent as real key events rather than as characters that look like them. Modifier chords the keyboard has no use for are handed to the app, so an editor's own shortcuts keep working, and a soft Ctrl plus a letter sends a genuine control code to a terminal.
Layouts
* 2-beolsik, the standard full Korean keyboard.
* 천지인 and 나랏글, the two 12-key phone layouts. Both compose the whole of Hangul, including every compound final — 많, 삶, 앉 and the rest. Two keys in the spare column turn the twelve keys into the phone keypad's digits or into the cursor cluster.
* QWERTY, Dvorak and Colemak for English; Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, German, Turkish, French AZERTY, Greek, Hebrew, Persian, Arabic, Urdu, Thai, Hindi, Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Serbian, Georgian and Armenian with their own letters on their own positions; Vietnamese with Telex; Japanese by romaji or on the 12-key flick pad, typed straight into hiragana.
* A symbols page, a keypad with arrows and function keys, and a menu page for edit commands.
* The globe key walks the layouts you enabled, in the order you set.
Typing on twelve keys
천지인 keys can be dragged instead of tapped: a consonant key gives its plain letter to the left, its aspirate to the right and its tense letter downward, and a vowel key points at the letter it makes. Hold a key instead and a guide shows what is where, with the keypad digit in the middle. Nothing has to be waited out.
Hanja
Conversion in both directions with 훈음 glosses, paging and number-key selection, from a candidate window the width of the keyboard.
Physical keyboards
The on-screen keyboard hides itself when a hardware keyboard is attached, and hardware typing composes Hangul through the same 2-beolsik automaton. Ctrl, Alt and Meta chords reach the app rather than being swallowed. 한/영 and 한자 can be bound to keys of your choosing.
Made to suit you
* The keyboard's height is set as a share of the screen, from 1% to 50%.
* Height, the layout list and its order, the floating panel and its opacity are remembered separately for a screen held upright and one held sideways.
* Keys that can be held say so: an open ring in the corner while they are not, a filled disc while they are. Shift, Ctrl, Meta and Alt each arm for one key on a tap and lock on a hold.
* A half-width floating panel you can place where you like, as see-through as you like.
* Key-press feedback — highlight, vibration and sound — each adjustable to zero.
* Follows the system light and dark theme, and Material You where the device has it.
Old Android
Two builds ship from one source. The one on F-Droid is for Android 9 and newer. A build for Android 4.0 and newer is on the project's releases page; everything works there, and the README says which few things behave differently.
The name
rete is Latin for net. It is meant to be said the Latin way, RAY-teh.

fdroid:com.techtrest.privamatic.name: Privamatic
fdroid:com.techtrest.privamatic.summary: Your phone's privacy, scored 0–100. 50 checks, no internet permission.
fdroid:com.techtrest.privamatic.description:
Privamatic audits your Android device and gives you a clear 0–100 privacy score based on your actual settings — not guesswork.
Whether you're just starting to take privacy seriously or you're already running GrapheneOS, Privamatic shows you exactly what's exposing your data and how to fix it, step by step.
50 automated checks, from system settings to the apps you have installed:
- System security (screen lock, encryption, security patch, USB debugging, biometrics)
- Network privacy (VPN, Private DNS, Advertising ID, Wi-Fi scanning)
- Default apps (browser, keyboard, SMS, email, launcher)
- Surveillance apps (Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, TikTok, X, Reddit, AI assistants)
microG is detected and not penalised, GrapheneOS sandboxed Play is recognised, camera-compatibility shims are not mistaken for real Google apps, and checks that do not apply to your setup are automatically skipped. If a setting can't be read on your device, most checks ask you to verify it instead of costing points.
Score Breakdown explains every point: one line per check that costs you points, adding up to your score. Tap a line to jump straight to that check.
Quick Wins put the fixes worth the most points first — each one includes plain-English instructions and a direct link to the relevant Settings page, and Privamatic rescans when you come back.
Score History tracks your privacy score over time with a line chart, so you can see whether you're actually improving.
SDK Fingerprinting scans your installed apps for known tracker SDKs — see exactly which apps are embedding ad networks, analytics, and profiling tools, powered by the Exodus Privacy database.
Trusted Apps let you whitelist FOSS apps that legitimately use accessibility, notification, or location permissions. Trusted apps are removed from your score penalty in real time — you decide what you trust.
Manual Checks remind you to periodically review location permissions, camera and microphone access, and unused apps — the things that can't be checked automatically.
A home screen widget keeps your privacy score visible at a glance: the score is coloured by its rating, any change shows as ↑ or ↓ in the middle, and on Android 12 and newer it takes its colours from your wallpaper. You can turn its background off.
Privacy is built in:
- Fully offline — no network requests, ever. Privamatic never requests the INTERNET permission, so Android will not let it connect even if it tried; check F-Droid's permission list or the open source code yourself.
- No accounts, no cloud sync, no analytics
- All data stays on your device, and none of it goes into backups or transfers to a new phone
- Open source (GPLv3)
Works on any Android 8.0+ device. Made with GrapheneOS in mind, and just as useful on CalyxOS, LineageOS or stock Android.

fdroid:com.werismoln.multibooter.name: MultiBooter
fdroid:com.werismoln.multibooter.summary: Create bootable USB media and boot PCs directly from Android.
fdroid:com.werismoln.multibooter.description:
MultiBooter is a free and open-source Android application for creating bootable USB media and booting computers directly from an Android device.
It provides several low-level boot and USB workflows in one application:
• Ventoy USB installation — prepare a USB flash drive with Ventoy directly from Android.
• Direct ISO writer — write bootable ISO/CD-ROM images directly to USB mass-storage devices.
• USB Gadget Mass Storage — expose an ISO or disk image from the Android device as USB Mass Storage through Linux ConfigFS.
• TFTP boot — provide files for network booting through a TFTP server.
• FunctionFS boot — use a userspace USB Mass Storage / virtual CD-ROM backend through FunctionFS.
Ventoy installation and the direct ISO writer can operate without root by using the Android USB Host API and USB Mass Storage commands.
USB Gadget, TFTP and FunctionFS modes require root access. These modes can also depend on kernel features such as ConfigFS and FunctionFS, so availability may vary between Android devices, kernels and ROMs.
MultiBooter is built with the Android framework, Java, native C code and the Android NDK. It does not depend on AndroidX or proprietary libraries.
Important: Ventoy installation and direct ISO writing are destructive operations. They can overwrite partition tables and erase all data on the selected USB device. Always verify the selected device and keep backups of important data before starting.

fdroid:cz.kyblsoft.meshcore.signaltester.name: MeshCore Signal Tester
fdroid:cz.kyblsoft.meshcore.signaltester.summary: Real-time mesh signal monitor for MeshCore companion radios & repeaters
fdroid:cz.kyblsoft.meshcore.signaltester.description:
MeshCore Signal Tester monitors mesh traffic from a MeshCore companion radio (over Bluetooth, USB-C, or Wi-Fi) or a MeshCore repeater (USB serial CLI) in real time. The connected device type is auto-detected.
It is built for field signal testing: it keeps capturing received packets and your GPS position while the phone is in your pocket with the screen off. A foreground service holds the connection and location alive — something a normal mobile browser cannot do, because it freezes the page and drops the link when the screen turns off.
Features:
* Connect to a MeshCore companion over Bluetooth, USB-C serial, or Wi-Fi (a raw TCP link to the Wi-Fi firmware), or to a repeater over USB.
* Group every reception by message, so you can see which repeaters forwarded the same packet and compare their signal side by side.
* Seen-repeaters table with per-repeater RX count and max/last RSSI and SNR.
* Scrolling SNR and RSSI history charts with a noise-floor estimate; zoom and pan the time axis.
* Signal 3D map: each received packet is placed at your GPS location, with height encoding SNR; many map styles, or none.
* Discover nearby nodes and read the SNR they measured for your uplink.
* Received-packets table with full decoded detail and raw hex.
* CSV export and re-import for offline review.
* Persistent on-disk capture that survives a reload or restart.
* Optional beep on each packet, auto-remove of old data, adjustable display window, repeater filter, keep-screen-on, device battery readout, and a light/dark theme.
All captured data stays on your device. The app has no ads and uses no analytics and no tracking. Map tiles are fetched from third-party tile servers only while online.
Free and open source (MIT). Source code: https://github.com/kybl/meshcore-signal-tester

 A daily cube and a weekly challenge, the same for everyone, each with its own board
 Puzzle packs: hand-picked cubes from tiny to monstrous
 Free roam: any cube from 2×2 to 18×18
 Optional full clear: every arrow off, pink last
 And 
 Par for every cube, badges, XP, a daily streak and colourways you earn
 Race a ghost of the leader's run on the daily and weekly cubes
 Powerups, all switchable, and hints earned by playing well
 Leave mid-level and pick it up later
 Optional global rankings, verified by replaying every run on the server
 Accessibility: striped target, left-handed layout, heavier arrows
 No ads, no accounts, and no tracking. The network is used only if you turn on rankings or the update check.

fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.privacyflip.name: Privacy Flip
fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.privacyflip.summary: Manage your device privacy based on lock/unlock state
fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.privacyflip.description:
Privacy Flip automatically manages your device's privacy features based on screen lock/unlock state. When you lock your device, it can disable Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, mobile data, location services, NFC, and even camera/microphone sensors. When you unlock, it intelligently restores the features you want back on.
 Works with Sui, Root, Dhizuku or Shizuku - Choose your preferred privilege method! 
 Features: 
• Manage your device privacy based on lock/unlock state
• Four privilege methods: Sui, Root, Dhizuku or Shizuku (no root needed for Dhizuku or Shizuku)
• Automatic privilege detection (Sui > Root > Dhizuku > Shizuku)
• Configurable feature control (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Mobile Data, Location, NFC, Camera, Microphone, Airplane Mode, Battery Saver)
• Customizable timing delays (0-60 seconds granular, 2 minutes, or 5 minutes)
• Smart "only if unused/not connected" modes for WiFi, Bluetooth, Location, and Mobile Data while media plays
• App exemption system (skip privacy for specific foreground apps)
• Detects NFC being turned back on by a payment or wallet app, with opt-in auto-retry
• Optional Accessibility Service as an extra lock and unlock signal
• Advanced multi-tier Bluetooth connection detection
• Background service for persistent monitoring
• Quick Settings tile integration
• Home screen widget
 Privacy Features Controlled: 
• Wi-Fi - Disable/enable wireless connectivity
• Bluetooth - Control Bluetooth radio
• Mobile data - Manage cellular data connection
• Location services - Control GPS and location tracking
• NFC - Control NFC sensor
• Camera - Disable/enable camera sensor privacy (Android 12+)
• Microphone - Disable/enable microphone sensor privacy (Android 12+)
• Airplane Mode - Enable on lock (opt-in, disables all radios at once)
• Battery Saver - Enable on lock (opt-in, reduces background activity)
Note: Camera and microphone ignore custom delays and trigger immediately, due to Android limitations. Microphone can skip this during a phone or VoIP call if enabled in settings; camera cannot detect active use, so it always triggers immediately
 Requirements: 
• Android 8.0+ (API level 26)
• Android 12+ (API level 31) for camera/microphone features
 Choose your privilege method: 
 Option 1: Shizuku (No root required!)
• Shizuku app installed and running
• ADB privileges via USB or wireless debugging
• Perfect for non-rooted devices
 Option 2: Root Access (Recommended for rooted devices)
• Root access via Magisk, SuperSU, or similar
• Best performance with UID 0 privileges
 Option 3: Dhizuku (Device Owner method, 5 of 9 features)
• Device set as Device Owner
• No root required, no ADB after setup
• Persistent privileges across reboots
• Works for, each needing its own Android version: Camera and Microphone (Android 12+),
Bluetooth (Android 9+), Location (Android 11+), NFC (Android 15+). Below Android 9 a Dhizuku
setup can switch nothing at all.
• Cannot do WiFi, Mobile Data, Airplane Mode or Battery Saver - Android gives a Device Owner no
way to switch those. Use Root or Shizuku for them.
 Option 4: Sui (Best of both worlds)
• Rooted device with Magisk
• Sui Magisk module installed
• Best user experience - automatic startup, no prompts
 Privacy & Security: 
• Zero telemetry - Nothing is sent to us or any third party
• Settings and the app's own lock state stay on your device, and in your own Android backup if you have one turned on - never sent anywhere else
• No network permissions - App cannot access internet
• Open source - https://github.com/dorumrr/privacyFlip

fdroid:io.silentsuite.android.name: SilentSuite - Secure Data Sync
fdroid:io.silentsuite.android.summary: End-to-end encrypted sync for calendar, contacts, and tasks
fdroid:io.silentsuite.android.description:
Your calendar, contacts, and tasks should stay in sync wherever you work: Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and the web. SilentSuite keeps that data available across your devices while applying end-to-end encryption before anything leaves your device.
 Zero-Knowledge Sync 
Encryption and decryption happen on your device, and your keys stay there. The server stores only ciphertext, so it cannot read what you keep on it. This is what zero-knowledge means in practice: the privacy guarantee is a technical constraint, not a policy statement.
 Fits Into Every System You Use 
On Android, SilentSuite works as a native sync adapter for compatible calendar, contacts, and task apps. On macOS, Windows, and Linux it integrates through a lightweight desktop bridge, so your encrypted data can appear in the tools already built into your workflow. The web app gives you browser access when you are away from your own devices. iPhone support is coming soon.
 Open Source And Inspectable 
Anyone can read the code, review the encryption, and confirm the privacy claims for themselves. There are no proprietary components to take on trust.
 Hosted Or Self-Hosted 
Use the hosted service, or run your own server on hardware you control. Your data stays portable: export it at any time in standard formats, with no lock-in.
 Beta Note

fdroid:net.asksakis.massdroidv2.description:
MassDroid is a native Android client for Music Assistant (music-assistant.io), the open-source music server that unifies your streaming services, local files, and players into one library. It is a full remote control for your Music Assistant server and can also turn the phone itself into a synced speaker.
You need your own Music Assistant server to use this app.
The sign-in screen finds the Music Assistant servers on your network by itself, through mDNS. This search stays on your local network.
Features:
* Remote control any Music Assistant player: play/pause, next/previous, seek, volume, shuffle and repeat.
* Browse your whole library: artists, albums, tracks, playlists, radios, and per-provider browse trees.
* Queue management: view, reorder and edit the play queue, and transfer the queue between players.
* Phone as a speaker (Sendspin): stream synchronised audio to this phone and play it together with your other speakers, in time.
* Group playback: join the phone to a sync group and fine-tune per-speaker timing by ear.
* Local recommendation engine: personalised Smart Mix and Genre Radio built from your own listening history, focused on music exploration and discovery.
* Search across all your connected music providers.
* Follow Me: room detection from Bluetooth fingerprints moves playback to the room you walk into.
* Audiobooks and podcasts with chapter-aware controls.
* Android Auto and Android TV support, and on Google Play an app for cars with Google built in (Android Automotive).
Genres come from your Music Assistant library and from MusicBrainz, with no account or API key to set up; the recommendation data stays on the device. Artist bios and the few words about the playing album come from Wikipedia when Music Assistant has none.
About permissions:
* Microphone is optional and used only by the sync measurements: the output calibration (the latency of this phone's speaker or Bluetooth device) and Auto Sync (it listens to each speaker in a group to line them up). The sound is analysed on the phone; nothing is stored or uploaded.
* Location is optional and used only by the "Follow Me" room-detection feature (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth fingerprint to detect which room you are in). It stays off unless you enable Follow Me.
* Physical activity is optional and used only by Follow Me, to look for the room only while you are moving. It stays off unless you enable Follow Me.
This app is an unofficial, third-party client and is not affiliated with the Music Assistant project.

Your simple, no-clutter intermittent fasting app. Start a fast, track your progress, and build a healthy fasting habit with FastMinder.
Whether you're trying 16:8 fasting for the first time or you've been doing 18:6 or OMAD for years, FastMinder keeps things simple. Set your fasting window, tap start, and let the timer do the rest.
WHY FASTMINDER?
Most fasting apps are packed with features you'll never use. FastMinder is different. It's lightweight, fast to open, and focused on one thing: helping you stick to your intermittent fasting schedule.
FEATURES
- Fasting Timer: Pick a plan (16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD) or create your own custom fasting schedule. Start and stop your fast with one tap.
- Progress Charts: See your fasting hours, weight, water intake, and daily steps on clear, easy-to-read graphs. Watch your streaks grow over time.
- Reminders: Set custom notifications so you never miss your eating window or forget to start a fast.
- Fasting History: Look back at every fast you've completed. Track your longest streak and celebrate milestones.
- Live Activity & Dynamic Island: See your current fast countdown right on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island without opening the app.
- Home Screen Widgets: Check your fasting status at a glance. Log water or end your fast directly from your Home Screen.
- Apple Watch App: Start and finish fasts, log water intake, and enter your weight right from your wrist.
- Apple Health Integration: Syncs with HealthKit to read and write steps, water, and weight data. Nothing leaves your device.
HOW INTERMITTENT FASTING HELPS
Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular approaches to weight loss and better health. Here's what the research shows:
- Weight Loss: Creating a natural calorie deficit by limiting your eating window can help you lose weight without counting every calorie.
- Better Metabolism: Fasting periods can improve insulin sensitivity and help regulate blood sugar levels.
- Cellular Repair: Fasting triggers autophagy, your body's process for cleaning out damaged cells and regenerating new ones.
- Heart Health: Studies link intermittent fasting to lower blood pressure, reduced triglycerides, and improved cholesterol.
- Brain Health: Fasting may support cognitive function and protect against neurodegenerative conditions.
- Reduced Inflammation: Regular fasting can lower chronic inflammation, which is tied to many long-term health issues.
GETTING STARTED
Download FastMinder, pick your fasting plan, and tap start. That's it. No complicated setup, no calorie logging required. Just a clean fasting timer and tracker that works.
Join the millions of people using intermittent fasting to feel better, lose weight, and take control of their health.
NOTES
- HealthKit (Apple Health) integration reads and writes steps, water, and weight. No data is sent outside your device. Health app access required.
- FastMinder is not a medical app. Goals are suggested based on your profile. Please consult your healthcare provider before using it for medical purposes or specific diet needs.

APPLE WATCH, FROM YOUR WRIST TO YOUR MAC

Network devices are displayed in a very logical and convenient format for displaying the most pertinent information about each device.
Includes:
--- TCP Connect LAN Scanning: establish a TCP connection with each IP address on the network.
--- ARP table Scanning: The ARP table is scanned for any devices attached to the network that do not respond to a TCP connect.
--- Also includes NetBios Scan, Bonjour Scan, Port Scanning and Pinging.
--- Reverse DNS Lookup
--- Dictionary lookups for MAC addresses, Port addresses and many Bonjour Services
--- All information presented to the user in a easy to understand user interface
All information gathered is presented to the user in a easy to understand user interface including dictionary look-ups for known MAC addresses, common port addresses and many bonjour services. This App is designed to give the user a complete understanding of all the devices connected to a local network and network services they are running.

flathub:com.ktechpit.omnidict.name: Omnidict
flathub:com.ktechpit.omnidict.description:
Omnidict is a fast offline dictionary for the Linux desktop. Choose from more than six hundred
 free dictionaries in hundreds of languages, download the ones you need once, and look words up
 instantly, without an internet connection.
 A dictionary for every language:
 English dictionary and thesaurus: English Wiktionary definitions, and English WordNet with
 synonyms, antonyms and related words
 Wiktionary for over three hundred languages: Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese,
 Russian, Hindi, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Turkish and many more, each explained in English
 Historical languages too: Latin, Ancient Greek, Old English, Sanskrit and Old Norse
 Hundreds of bilingual FreeDict dictionaries, such as German-English, English-French and Spanish-Portuguese
 JMdict Japanese dictionary, CC-CEDICT Chinese dictionary and Kengdic Korean dictionary
 Filter the catalogue by language and provider, and see each dictionary's size and number
 of entries before you download
 Look words up quickly:
 Word lookup as you type, results grouped by dictionary with the best match first
 Accents are optional, and an inflected form finds its entry: ran finds run
 "Did you mean" spelling suggestions for misspelled words, in every script
 Wildcards: ? for one letter, * for any run of letters
 Full text search finds words used inside definitions
 Links between entries, with Back and Forward as in a browser
 Quick lookup: select a word in any app and press a shortcut to see its meaning in a small
 window
 Runs in the tray, so quick lookup works with the window closed, and can start at login
 Made for learning and everyday use:
 Favourites and recent lookups to build your vocabulary
 Reorder dictionaries, switch them off, update or remove them
 Light and dark themes that follow the desktop, and an adjustable text size
 Keyboard shortcuts for everything
 Private: no tracking, nothing about you is sent anywhere; the only network use is downloading
 dictionaries and, once a week, the list of the developer's other apps

flathub:org.apache.directory.studio.name: Apache Directory Studio
flathub:org.apache.directory.studio.description:
Apache Directory Studio is a complete directory tooling platform intended to be used with any LDAP server however it is particularly designed for use with ApacheDS. It is an Eclipse RCP application, composed of several Eclipse (OSGi) plugins, that can be easily upgraded with additional ones.
 The LDAP Browser has been designed to work with almost any LDAP server available. It not only permits to read and display the tree of your LDAP Server but also allows you to modify it by creating, editing or removing entries.
 The LDIF Editor is a tool for editing LDIF files. It provides syntax highlighting and content assistance.
 The Schema Editor has been designed to edit the schema files in the OpenLDAP format. It allows you to edit easily attribute types and object classes for Apache Directory Server and OpenLDAP.
 Apache Directory Studio bundles the latest version of the LDAPV3 certified ApacheDS. Creating and launching a new LDAP server now takes less than 10 seconds!
 The ApacheDS Configuration Editor can be used to edit the server configuration ('server.xml' and 'config.ldif' files) of an Apache Directory Server installation.
 The ACI Editor allows you to define, for an entry or a set of entries, graphically or manually (in souce code mode), an ACI (Access Control Information) item specification for Apache Directory Server.

flathub:re.fossplant.vmlinux-to-elf.name: vmlinux-to-elf
flathub:re.fossplant.vmlinux-to-elf.summary: Convert raw Linux kernel blobs to ELF files
flathub:re.fossplant.vmlinux-to-elf.description:
vmlinux-to-elf is a tool to recover a fully analyzable .ELF from a raw kernel, through extracting the kernel symbol table (kallsyms)
 Features:
 - Take a raw binary blob or ELF kernel file as an input.
 - Automatically detect and unpack the main compression formats used for the Linux kernel.
 - Find and extract the embedded kernel symbols table (kallsyms) from the input file.
 - Infer the instruction set architecture, endianness, bit size, relying upon other things on common function prologue signatures.
 - Infer the entry point of the kernel from the symbols contained in the kallsyms table.
 - Provide basic inference for the kernel base address.
 - Unpack certain types of Android boot.img files, starting with an "ANDROID!" or "UNCOMPRESSED_IMG" magic.
 - Produce an .ELF file fully analyzable with IDA Pro or Ghidra as an output.

fedora-packages:arachne-pnr/arachne-pnr.description: Arachne-pnr implements the place and route step of the hardware compilation process for FPGAs. It accepts as input a technology-mapped netlist in BLIF format, as output by the Yosys synthesis suite for example. It currently targets the Lattice Semiconductor iCE40 family of FPGAs. Its output is a textual bitstream representation for assembly by the IceStorm icepack command. The output of icepack is a binary bitstream which can be uploaded to a hardware device. fedora-packages:clisp/clisp.description: ANSI Common Lisp is a high-level, general-purpose programming language. GNU CLISP is a Common Lisp implementation by Bruno Haible of Karlsruhe University and Michael Stoll of Munich University, both in Germany. It mostly supports the Lisp described in the ANSI Common Lisp standard. It runs on most Unix workstations (GNU/Linux, FreeBSD, NetBSD, OpenBSD, Solaris, Tru64, HP-UX, BeOS, NeXTstep, IRIX, AIX and others) and on other systems (Windows NT/2000/XP, Windows 95/98/ME) and needs only 4 MiB of RAM. It is Free Software and may be distributed under the terms of GNU GPL, while it is possible to distribute commercial proprietary applications compiled with GNU CLISP. The user interface comes in English, German, French, Spanish, Dutch, Russian and Danish, and can be changed at run time. GNU CLISP includes an interpreter, a compiler, a debugger, CLOS, MOP, a foreign language interface, sockets, i18n, fast bignums and more. An X11 interface is available through CLX, Garnet, CLUE/CLIO. GNU CLISP runs Maxima, ACL2 and many other Common Lisp packages.

firefox-addons:987425.name: Video Converter
firefox-addons:987425.summary: Convert any video file to selected formats (i.e. mp4) inside your browser!
firefox-addons:987425.description:
Video Converter add-on helps you easily convert any video format to another (for example, .WEBM to .MP4). 
It uses FFmpeg library which is compiled from C/C++ language to JavaScript with Emscripten compiler. Emscripten is a source-to-source compiler that can compile native C/C++ codes to JavaScript language. Please read this Wikipedia page to get more info about Emscripten compiler.
In order to work with this add-on, just open the app UI and drag a video file to the designated area in the app. Then, type your FFmpeg command in the input filed and press on the - Run Command - button. 
Once the conversion is done, the link to download the video file will be available at the bottom of the UI. Please note that, conversion may take some time depending on the video size and also type of the conversion that you choose. There are some sample commands available in the app UI (as buttons) which you can use to start working with this add-on.
Note: since this add-on runs FFmpeg in the browser, it runs slower than the native FFmpeg applications/library. However, using the add-on is very easy. Simply add it to your browser and it starts to work without any additional plugins. It is only suitable for simple conversions and has limited number of codecs.
This add-on is specifically designed for "video" conversion. If you want to convert an "audio" file, please use my other add-on Audio Converter .
Note: if you have a feature request, or found a bug to report, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .

firefox-addons:2614251.name: SoundCloud Downloader
firefox-addons:2614251.summary: Adds a download button under SoundCloud tracks. One click gives you an mp3 with artwork and tags. No account, no tracking.
firefox-addons:2614251.description:
Features:
✅ Download any SoundCloud track as an mp3
✅ Adds metadata (artwork, artist, title, composer, genre, year, description & source url)
✅ A button on every track: track page, playlists, likes, search results
✅ Works without an account, a Go+ subscription, or even being logged in
✅ Works on private tracks shared through a secret link
✅ Works whatever language your SoundCloud is set to
✅ Customizable file name format (see Preferences tab in about:addons )
How it works:
The file is built in your browser, straight from SoundCloud. Nothing goes through any other server. The add-on only asks for access to soundcloud.com and sndcdn.com (SoundCloud's CDN), and for storage to keep your filename format. No background process, ~130 KB.
SoundCloud now serves most tracks only as AAC. The add-on decodes it with your browser's own decoder and encodes it to mp3 with LAME ( https://lame.sourceforge.io ) compiled to WebAssembly. A box in the bottom right corner shows the progress. It takes about 2 seconds for a 4-minute track and 32 seconds for an hour-long mix (measured in Firefox on a MacBook Pro M5 Pro).
Good to know:
⚠ One track at a time: no bulk download of a playlist or album.
⚠ Since May 2026, SoundCloud locks some tracks behind DRM: no extension can download those, and the add-on says so instead of saving a broken file.
⚠ Since October 2026, SoundCloud no longer serves mp3 for most tracks and streams AAC at 160 kbps instead. The add-on encodes it to mp3 at 320 kbps to lose as little as possible in the second encoding. Tracks SoundCloud still serves as mp3 are saved as they are.
You can find the source code here: https://github.com/nyo/scdl 
You can report any issues or bugs on the GitHub Issues page: https://github.com/nyo/scdl/issues 
Happy digging!

firefox-addons:3056375.name: MySudo Password
firefox-addons:3056375.summary: A privacy-first password manager that securely stores, autofills, and organizes your passwords, passkeys, and payment details by Sudo identities you've created in the MySudo privacy app.
firefox-addons:3056375.description:
Privacy starts with your passwords. 
 Make it seamless on Firefox. 
MySudo Password is the double-duty password manager designed to protect your logins and give you total control over what you share online. 
Instead of dumping every login into a single vault, MySudo Password organizes your digital life through identity compartmentalization the MySudo way. Group your passwords, passkeys, and payment details by the specific Sudo identity they belong to – keeping shopping, banking, travel, and personal accounts separate and more secure.
By organizing your logins and personal information by Sudo identities (created in the MySudo privacy app), you prevent data brokers and advertisers from cross-linking your personal information across the web while minimizing your damage if a site suffers a data breach.
 Key features: 
 - Organize by Sudo identity: Group logins, passkeys, and payment details by the specific Sudo profile you use, keeping different parts of your life separate.
 - Seamless autofill and auto-save: Instantly fill credentials and passkeys and automatically save new logins as you browse, without ever leaving your active page.
 - Strong password generator: Instantly create robust, unique passwords for every new account to eliminate credential reuse.
 - Spot password vulnerabilities: Identify weak or reused passwords and instantly improve your security.
 - Multi-device sync: Keep your encrypted vault seamlessly in sync across the Firefox extension and the MySudo Password mobile app.
 Zero-knowledge security and privacy 
Your privacy is built directly into the architecture:
 - End-to-end encryption (E2EE): Your data is encrypted locally on your device before it ever hits the cloud.
 - Zero-knowledge guarantee: Only you hold the key to your vault. Neither Anonyome Labs nor any third party can ever read your saved credentials or personal data.
 Get started in seconds: 
1 - Click Add to Firefox above.
2 - Pin MySudo Password to your browser toolbar for instant one-click access.
3 - Sign in to sync with your MySudo app and take control of your online privacy.
 MySudo Password. Privacy starts with your passwords. 
- Privacy policy: https://mysudo.com/privacypolicy/ 
- Terms of service: https://mysudo.com/tos/ 
- Privacy choices: https://mysudo.com/privacy-choices 
If you need help, reach out to us on X @MySudoApp or email at pwmsupport@mysudo.com .

firefox-addons:931871.description:

Right click individual bookmark menuitem instead, to insert bookmark of currently selected tab(s) below (or optionally above) that item.

bluejetty:00114262:ios.description:
Dive into a smooth and satisfying puzzle experience where colors flow and every move feels rewarding.
In Water Shooter: Cube Splash, you shoot water to splash colors, clear blocks, and solve relaxing pool-based puzzles. Each level is built from beautiful pixel art designs, turning every stage into a colorful, hand-crafted scene that’s fun to play and satisfying to clear.

Satisfying water-based gameplay with smooth splashes
Hand-crafted pixel art levels full of color and detail
Color matching puzzles that feel smooth and rewarding
Relaxing flow experience with calming visuals
Simple, intuitive controls for easy play
Carefully designed levels that grow more challenging over time
Perfect for quick breaks or longer, relaxing sessions

Go with the flow, enjoy the splashes, and clear stunning pixel art puzzles one level at a time.

bluejetty:00036721:ios.summary: iNumber - Second Phone Number, the app that allows you to have multiple phone lines for your personal and business needs, all without the need for an extra SIM card. With iNumber, you can make private calls and send texts internationally, a
bluejetty:00036721:ios.description:
iNumber - Second Phone Number, the app that allows you to have multiple phone lines for your personal and business needs, all without the need for an extra SIM card. With iNumber, you can make private calls and send texts internationally, all while keeping your real number hidden.
No more hassle of buying additional SIM cards or constantly swapping them out. With iNumber, you can easily make calls from different numbers with just a few taps. Plus, you can keep your international number for as long as you like and add more minutes and SMS to your balance at affordable rates.
Here are some situations where iNumber can come in handy:
- Buying or selling on local e-commerce platforms: Use a temporary number to post ads and receive calls, then delete it once the deal is done.
- Dating: Give out an alternative number to your new acquaintance from dating apps for added privacy.
- Business needs: Keep work and personal calls separate by using iNumber as a second work number.
- Hosting apartments or renting a car: Stay safe and anonymous by giving out your iNumber instead of your personal number.
- Signing up for platforms that require a phone number: Use iNumber instead of your real number to protect your privacy.
iNumber also offers a range of features to enhance your experience:
- Get extra numbers for calls and texting.
- Make calls and send texts worldwide.
- Record calls and easily store and share your recordings.
- Send MMS (available for US and Canadian numbers).
- Set business hours and direct incoming calls outside this time period to voicemail (available for US numbers).
- Send SMS and view your text message history.
- Choose a number from the available list or sync your contacts with the app.
- Easily manage and identify your numbers using the Name Number feature.
- Add and delete numbers with just a few taps.
Please note that iNumber currently supports phone numbers from the USA, Canada, Israel, Puerto Rico, the United Kingdom, Australia, the Netherlands, and Estonia.
With iNumber Premium, you'll have unlimited access to all app features, including Call Recorder, Voicemail. Each subscription includes one number.
Below is subscription detail:
• To buy one phone number: Auto-renewal ( Weekly $7.99 or Year $29.99) begins after 3 days of free trial. 2nd Number at weekly $7.99.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn of the auto-renew subscription from iPhone setting
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable 2nd phone number app adds the great features above and are available through an auto-renewing subscription. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of your current subscription, and you can cancel a subscription during the active period. You can manage your subscription at any time, either by viewing your account in iTunes from your Mac or PC, or Account Settings on your device after purchase.

bluejetty:00026198:ios.description:
Solitaire - My Farm Friends is a classic card game (also known as Klondike or Patience) with AMAZING farm themes. With dozens of cute animal friends to play with, you can not only enjoy the classic solitaire game to keep your brain sharp but also collect dozens of cute little animals to build your UNIQUE farm.
Besides the classic solitaire challenges, there are dozens of cute animals (such as lambs, cows, spotted dogs, bunnies, roosters, horses, etc.) for you to make friends with, and more animal friends are waiting for you to discover.
HIGHLIGHTS
- Creative Solitaire Game
Based on the classic solitaire game (also known as Klondike or Patience), the vibrant "Farm Friends Land" is ready for you to collect dozens of cute animals. And you can play with your animal friends to build a UNIQUE farm of your own.
- Challenging Deals
Besides the classic Klondike or Patience games, there are plenty of challenging card games to train your brain by completing challenging daily challenges. You can earn magnificent medals for completing the daily challenges. The more you complete, the more medals and rewards you'll get.
- Interesting & Special Events
There will be plenty of special events for you and it will always make you fresh to this game. Don't forget to enjoy the fun time and participate in the events and get extra rewards.
- Unique Cards & Animations
All cards(both card backs and card fronts) and animations have been delicately designed. You can get them by collecting enough stars to open "Star Chests" or purchase them with game coins.
If you like classic card games, you'll love this classic Klondike or Patience card game with the farmhouse theme. Don't hesitate to download and explore more creative features of this amazing solitaire game NOW!

bluejetty:00146718:ios.description:
Free software when you want to do it yourself. A professional team when you want it done for you. You stay in control either way.
TWO WAYS TO RUN YOUR RENTALS
1. Free, all-in-one property management software. Listings, applications, screening, leases, rent collection, maintenance, accounting, and more. Everything you need to manage your own properties from your phone.
2. Professional property management services that we call Autopilot. Our specialists handle tenant placement, maintenance, rent collection, and day-to-day operations for a flat fee, not a percentage of rent.
EVERYTHING IN THE FREE APP
• Online rent collection and rental payments
• Rental marketing across major listing sites
• Rental applications and tenant screening
• State-specific lease generation with e-signatures
• Maintenance request management
• Rental accounting and expense tracking
• Scheduled showings
• Tenant communication
PROFESSIONAL MANAGEMENT (AUTOPILOT)
• Professional tenant placement
• Ongoing property management
• Maintenance coordination
• Rent collection and reporting
• Dedicated specialists for every property
Free yourself from manual property management. No more logging into listing sites one by one, making bank trips for rent checks, or tracking expenses in spreadsheets. TurboTenant handles it — whether you want to DIY or hand it off entirely with professional property management.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
• Real-time alerts for screening reports and new leads
• Instant notifications when rent is paid or applications arrive
• Alerts for maintenance requests and tenant messages
IN-APP MESSAGING
• All tenant conversations in one place
• Communicate with leads, applicants, and tenants
• Send documents, images, and videos on the go
RENTAL MARKETING
• Create a professional listing with step-by-step guidance
• Publish to top sites: Apartments.com, Rent, Redfin, and more
• Average 28 leads per listing
ONLINE RENT COLLECTION
• Collect rent without checks, Venmo, or Zelle
• Autopay, automatic reminders, and custom late fees — free for landlords
• Real-time payment notifications
RENTAL APPLICATIONS + TENANT SCREENING
• Invite applicants and review screening reports in-app
• Financial, criminal, and eviction history — $0 for landlords
• Find qualified tenants without expensive marketing
LEASE MANAGEMENT
• State-specific lease agreements built for compliance
• Set start/end dates or month-to-month terms
• E-signatures included
MAINTENANCE REQUESTS
• Track and respond to requests from anywhere
• Send work orders so nothing slips through the cracks
EXPENSE TRACKING
• Log expenses by property from your phone
• Organized by Schedule E categories with receipt attachments
• Generate tax reports in one click
WHAT LANDLORDS SAY
"TurboTenant is an excellent software with excellent customer support. The software meets all my expectations for renting, investing, supporting my tenants, and managing my properties." — Nathan S.
If you are a renter, download the TurboTenant for Renters app to access your portal.

bluejetty:00033450:ios.description:
This is the Custom Skin Creator HD. Create (64x64) or even more detailed HD (128x128) custom Minecraft skins . Choose your clothes and easily create your custom skins for minecraft pe.
We have the best (64x64) and HD (128x128) clothing for your minecraft skins. Billions of combinations of skins to create. Add even more precise details by drawing.
Make the skin you've always wanted — then dress it up, paint it pixel by pixel, and play with it in a whole 3D world.
With unlimited options and new items and clothes added every day, there’s always something fresh to try.
Your character stands on stage the whole time, so every change shows at once. Spin it, zoom in and see your skin from every side.
NEW EVERY DAY
Every day brings a fresh Daily drop: brand-new characters and new clothes, made just for that day.
DRESS UP FROM HEAD TO TOE
• Thousands of pieces: tops, jackets, pants, dresses, swimwear, shoes, hats, glasses, bags, jewelry, scarves, gloves and more
• Hairstyles, eyes, mouths, freckles, beards and face paint
• Costumes: superheroes, armor, wings, creature ears and tails, Halloween and hristmas costumes, and cartoon characters
• Any piece in any color — even see-through — with patterns, plus logos, letters and shapes
• Star your favorites and find them again in one tap
AI CHARACTER MAKER
Type an idea — and get whole new characters in seconds, made right on your device. Out of ideas? Tap Surprise!
PAINT EVERY PIXEL
Draw right on the 3D character or on the flat skin: pencil, eraser, fill, gradient, color picker, mirror, text, logos and shapes. Inner and outer layers, classic or slim arms, and super-sharp HD skins (128×128) as well as the classic 64×64.
READY TO PLAY IN MINECRAFT
Save your skin to Photos or share it as a PNG in one tap — a step-by-step guide shows how to use it in Bedrock and Java. Already have a skin? Import it and keep making it better.
A WHOLE WORLD TO PLAY IN
Take your character into My World: a house, a garden and a farm, a pet to adopt and look after, and friends to chat and play with. Ride the roller coaster, the log flume and the bumper cars at the Fun Park, race karts and horses, play tennis and football, skate, surf, fish, cook, play the piano — and explore the planets through the telescope.

bluejetty:00073609:ios.summary:
Download ChargeHub - the #1 app for EV drivers
ChargeHub is a must have App for all American & Canadian electric car owners who want to find EV charging stations locations to plug their Tesla Model S / Leaf / iMiEV / Volt / Focus EV / Plug
bluejetty:00073609:ios.description:
Download ChargeHub - the #1 app for EV drivers
ChargeHub is a must have App for all American & Canadian electric car owners who want to find EV charging stations locations to plug their Tesla Model S / Leaf / iMiEV / Volt / Focus EV / Plug-in Prius / Smart EV / BMW i3 / KIA Soul EV /etc.
Search & find nearest public electric car charger (EV plug, Tesla Supercharger, CHAdeMO, SAE combo DC fast), plan your trip & get driving directions to charge your EV!
Follow on Twitter @EVChargeHub
-- What this app does --
EV Charger Locator Map Interface:
-Find electric vehicle charging stations ( EVSE )
-Get turn-by-turn directions to the nearest charge point
-Over 55 000 charge ports supported in the US & Canada
-Get color coded live availability data from EV charge stations in the following networks: Blink, Hydro Quebec's Circuit Electrique, AddEnergie Flo, SemaCharge and Greenlots
- Pay for charging with the ChargeHub app!
- Login with Facebook or signup with ChargeHub
- Receive Notifications for new stations in your area or any area you want
- Add your own personal station to help other ChargeHub users. You have complete control over the station information in real time! 
-Request permission from other EV users for charger use ("plugshare-ing")
- Simple and intuitive chat interface. Never share your email since the communication is all within ChargeHub.
-Found a new public EV charger? Add it to the database!
-Rate & add comments for all public charging stations
-Use search feature to find Level 1, Level 2 (EV Plug) and DC Fast chargers (Tesla Superchargers, SAE DC Fast & CHAdeMO) anywhere across North America
-Smooth & responsive interface. The information you want at the tip of your fingers.
-Filter and search EV charge stations to only display the ones you want (by network, by charging level, etc)
-Directly call the EVSE network from the app to get more information (ex: Chargepoint, Tesla Supercharger, evGO, Blink, Electric Circuit, SemaCharge, Flo)
-Unique logos for Tesla Superchargers, SAE DC Fast chargers and CHAdeMO charging stations
-Detailed usage data for BC evCloud connected EV charging stations
Who should download this app:
-Electric car owners who want to find electric car charging stations
-Prospective buyers of Tesla ModelS / Leaf / iMiEV / Volt / Focus EV / Plug-in Prius / Smart EV / etc, who want to know where electric vehicle charge stations are before purchasing an electric car.
Terms and conditions: https://chargehub.com/en/terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00045666:ios.description:
Getting fit is an awesome journey, but let's be real—it can also hit your wallet, feel overwhelming, and eat up your time. That's where I come in! I'm your 24/7 personal trainer who's always ready to help you crush your goals. Whether you're juggling a hectic schedule or want to keep things simple, I've got a workout perfect for you. Focus on what you love, and I'll handle the heavy lifting.
Here's how I'm going to help you:
Personalized Workouts:
I will build the perfect workouts for you based on:
- Custom Requests... ask, and you shall receive!
- Goals
- Daily Readiness
- Schedule
- Available Equipment
- Training Style
- Exercise Preferences
- Fitness Level
- Injuries or Physical Limitations
Just tell me what you want, and I'll adjust your workouts as needed.
24/7 Coaching:
I'm not just a fitness coach but your ultimate workout buddy! With my engaging chat interface, I’ll send you cheeky messages and hilarious GIFs to keep you motivated. Got a fitness-related question? Ask away! I’ll give you expert, personalized feedback instantly. Let’s crush those fitness goals together and have a blast while doing it!
Comprehensive Workout Tracking:
I'll help you easily track your workouts and monitor your progress. I've got a curated workout log just for you. Stay accountable to your goals and watch the momentum build. Let's keep you on track and smashing those fitness milestones together!
Extensive Exercise Library:

bluejetty:00093797:ios.description:
"Easy FII: A Solução completa para o gerenciamento inteligente dos seus investimentos em Fundos de Investimento Imobiliário (FII)"
Investir no mercado de Fundos de Investimento Imobiliário (FII) pode ser uma estratégia financeira inteligente para quem busca uma fonte confiável de renda passiva. Contudo, o sucesso nesse cenário exige um controle preciso de sua carteira de ativos, uma análise constante de indicadores e a capacidade de tomar decisões informadas. É aí que o Easy FII entra em cena, simplificando e aprimorando a gestão de seus investimentos imobiliários, com um foco especial em dividendos / proventos.
-
Por que o Easy FII?
* Carteira de FIIs no seu bolso:
Imaginou ter uma visão completa de todos os seus ativos imobiliários em um único lugar? Seja você um investidor com um ou diversos FIIs, nosso aplicativo de fácil uso oferece uma interface intuitiva que exibe a posição da sua carteira, incluindo o saldo atual de cada FII. Não importa o tamanho de sua carteira, o Easy FII adapta-se a você, fornecendo informações detalhadas sobre seus ativos e dividendos.
* Cotação dos ativos em tempo real:
Acompanhar a valorização das cotas dos seus FIIs é fundamental para tomar decisões assertivas e maximizar sua renda passiva por meio dos dividendos / proventos. O Easy FII fornece informações atualizadas sobre o valor das cotas, permitindo que você esteja sempre ciente do desempenho dos seus investimentos. Nunca mais perca uma oportunidade de lucro.
* Dividendos / proventos detalhados:
Os rendimentos mensais são uma parte vital de seus investimentos em FIIs, especialmente seu dividendo / provento. O Easy FII fornece informações atualizadas sobre os dividendos de cada FII, garantindo que você esteja sempre por dentro dos seus ganhos e alcance a renda desejada.
-
Em breve:
* Balanceamento de carteira:
O Easy FII entende que uma carteira equilibrada é essencial para o sucesso a longo prazo. E para que isso seja possível, nosso aplicativo irá sugerir ajustes com base em sua estratégia de investimento, ajudando a manter sua carteira alinhada com seus objetivos financeiros, visando uma alocacão balanceada dos seus investimentos.
* Gráficos de alocação:
Visualizar a alocação dos seus FIIs é uma parte importante da estratégia de investimento e influencia diretamente nos seus resultados, potencializando também o aumento da sua renda mensal. Em breve, o Easy FII disponibilizará gráficos de alocação que mostrarão exatamente onde seu dinheiro está investido. Compreenda a distribuição de ativos em sua carteira e ajuste-a conforme necessário para atingir a diversificação desejada, mantendo um olhar atento sobre os seus investimentos.
* Notificação do recebimento de dividendos:
Em breve, lançaremos uma funcionalidade que enviará notificações instantâneas quando você receber dividendos / proventos dos seus FIIs, permitindo que você acompanhe seus rendimentos em tempo real.
-
Com nosso aplicativo de gerenciamento de investimentos imobiliários, você estará no controle total do seu futuro financeiro. Maximize sua renda passiva, acompanhe seu progresso e alcance seus objetivos de investimento com facilidade.
Não perca tempo, faça parte da revolução do mercado imobiliário e transforme sua jornada de investimento com o nosso aplicativo dedicado aos FIIs. Baixe agora e comece a construir sua riqueza de forma inteligente e eficiente.
Otimize sua carteira de fundos imobiliários, acompanhe seus dividendos / proventos mensais e desfrute de uma experiência de investimento imobiliário sem igual. Baixe nosso aplicativo agora e leve seus investimentos para o próximo nível. Aproveite ao máximo o seu investimento em fundos imobiliários hoje mesmo!

bluejetty:00182623:ios.summary: Skateboard Party 2 brings all the fun of skateboarding to your mobile device allowing you to ride in 8 completely unique locations. Jump on your board, learn new moves and improve your skateboarding skills to land sick combos. Complete achi
bluejetty:00182623:ios.description:
Skateboard Party 2 brings all the fun of skateboarding to your mobile device allowing you to ride in 8 completely unique locations. Jump on your board, learn new moves and improve your skateboarding skills to land sick combos. Complete achievements, gain experience and upgrade your favorite skater. You can also customize your outfits, boards, trucks and wheels with real brands.
HIGH DEFINITION
Skateboard Party 2 includes next generation 3D graphics specially optimized for your mobile hardware to provide you with the best skateboarding experience.
CAREER MODE
Complete over 40 achievements to unlock new items and locations. Gain experience to upgrade your favorite skater’s attributes to perform better and achieve higher scores.
FREE SKATE
Practice and improve your skateboarding skills without any time constraints.
MASSIVE SELECTION
Select between 9 characters and customize each of them to your preference choosing your favorite gear. A massive collection of boards, trucks and wheels are available including items from Powell & Peralta, Bones, Golden Dragon and Tork Trucks.
LEARN TO SKATE
Over 40 unique tricks to master and hundreds of combinations. Follow the tutorial to get started and progress as you go. Execute the craziest combos and trick sequences to rack up some impressive high scores, gain experience and make a name for yourself.
GAME CONTROLLER
Compatible with Apple game controllers such as MOGA Ace Power.
CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS
New fully customizable control system to configure your own button layout. Use the right or left handed control mode, select a control preset or create your own. Use the analog stick or accelerometer option as you wish. Adjust your truck tightness to change your steering sensitivity.
LOADED WITH FEATURES
•Supports all the latest generation devices and optimized for high resolution displays.
•New fully customizable control system. You can adjust everything!
•Learn over 40 unique tricks and create hundreds of combinations.
•Massive skateboard locations to ride including a trailer park, army base, shopping mall, ski resort, campus, funfair beach and a big open city.
•Customize your skater or board with tons of exclusive content including outfits, boards, trucks and wheels from licensed brands.
•Play often to gain experience and upgrade your skater’s attributes.
•Extended Soundtrack featuring songs from Voice of Addiction, Sink Alaska, Beta, Hitplay!, Moovalya, We Outspoken and Melodic in Fusion.
•Ability to purchase experience points using in-app purchases.
•Available in the following languages: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Chinese
•Ability to listen to your own songs from your own music library
•Game Center support including achievements and online leaderboards
•Universal version for all your iOS devices
We hope you enjoy the game! Please send us your feedback at: contact@maplemedia.io

bluejetty:00095584:ios.description:
Use the UK ETA Visa Services app to apply for an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) to enter the United Kingdom.
How to apply
 1. Answer a few questions about yourself.
 2. Upload a photo of your passport.
 3. Upload a photo of your face.
 4. Pay the application fee.
The process takes about 10 minutes and you don’t need to enter your travel details.
Before you start
You’ll need:
• the passport you’ll use to travel to the UK;
• a credit card, debit card, or Apple Pay.
If you’re applying for someone else, make sure you have photos of their face and passport ready.
If you need to travel soon
You must get your ETA before travelling to the UK. You can travel while your application is being processed.
After you apply
You’ll usually receive a decision within 1–7 working days; priority or express processing may be faster.
If your ETA is approved, it will be electronically linked to the passport used in your application. You must use that same passport when you travel.
Privacy and security
The app is secure and does not store any information once closed. You can delete the app after completing your application.
For more information on staying safe online, visit the UK’s National Cyber Security Centre: www.ncsc.gov.uk/cyberaware/home
This app is a private application assistance service and is not affiliated with the UK government.
Official UK ETA applications can be made at www.gov.uk.
You can also use our app to submit visa applications for the United States, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Schengen countries.

bluejetty:00088263:ios.name: Orca - Gratitude Journal
bluejetty:00088263:ios.summary: Orca (formerly Happyfeed) is a gratitude journal that focuses on beautiful photos, short videos, and sharing options. Record positive moments every day to improve your mood and remind yourself of all the good. Plus, you'll be creating an re
bluejetty:00088263:ios.description:
Orca (formerly Happyfeed) is a gratitude journal that focuses on beautiful photos, short videos, and sharing options. Record positive moments every day to improve your mood and remind yourself of all the good. Plus, you'll be creating an record of all your best memories. Keep it private or use groups like a micro social network by sharing select memories with friends and family.
 • Add multiple photos, video & location
 • Widgets: Daily throwbacks and shared memories
 • Group sharing for couples, friends & family
 • Unique prompts, quotes, and fun facts every day
 • Gratitude Jar to view random past posts
 • All posts are 100% private by default
 • Tag your best days with an emoji
 • Unlimited days you can post for free
 • Passcode & lock screen with Face ID
 • PDF/CSV Export for printing (Plus only)
Explore Your Past Memories - After one week, you can view memories in your gratitude journal from a week ago. This period grows to months and even years. You can also see random moments using the Gratitude Jar. Each month, create a recap video of your favorite photos and clips.
Journaling Together - Pods are private groups for sharing memories and send emoji reactions. Send only selected photos, videos, and text to your friends, partner, or family. It's perfect for long distance relationships and faraway family.
Unique Reminders Each Day - Every day we write a custom prompt to help you remember to record your feelings. It could be a quote about happiness, a fact about the day, or a joke to brighten your day and put you in a happy mood.
Benefits of Gratitude Journaling - Gratitude journaling is a simple and easy self-care practice that helps reduce stress and anxiety while improving your overall happiness. In even a few seconds, the practice of actively reflecting on 3 good things or what you are grateful for can help you refocus on the positives in life.
Private Diary On All Your Devices - We also offer a web version where you can upload and view your past moments. Your moments and photos are privately synced to your account so you’ll never lose them. Plus Subscribers can download their journal in PDF or CSV format.
Secret & Secure Self-Love - Your moments are only visible to you and never posted publicly. All cloud syncing is securely encrypted using HTTPS endpoints. You can create a passcode lock for extra security (Face ID supported).
Your Account - An account is required to keep your moments safe and to allow you to view and manage them across multiple devices. If you lose your device, you won’t lose all your happy memories. You may choose to share your location to provide you with meaningful data on the places, people, and things that help you find happiness.
Orca Plus Subscription - Our Plus subscription provides ongoing access to features like:
 • Unlimited Calendar with map and photo diary grid
 • Journal export and download as PDF or CSV
 • Search - Find keywords in your memories
 • Post up to 10 good things per day
 • Add up to 4 photos per post
 • 30 second videos
 • Unlimited editing
Plus is available as a monthly (charged once per month) or yearly (charged once per year) subscription. After the free trial, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account. This subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at $3.99 USD for monthly or $39.99 USD for yearly subscriptions. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription plan. 
Have questions, problems, or feedback? Reach out to us directly at hello@okorca.com or message @ok_orca on Instagram
Terms of Use: https://www.okorca.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.okorca.com/privacy

Solve 30,000+ human-made crossword puzzles from indie and industry-leading crossword creators for free — no subscriptions!
Crossword Puzzle Free by Redstone, also known as "The crossword lover's dream app," delivers a polished crossword solving experience with fresh content and a clean, well-designed word game interface.
You can solve crosswords offline, with new packs of mini, midi and regular word puzzles released regularly. Enjoy themed crossword puzzles, build your vocabulary, learn new words, and challenge yourself every day with puzzles from easy to master.
----
Wide range of English crossword puzzles (American-style / NYT):
- Four difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard and Very Hard (Master).
- Sizes: Minis, Midis and Regular 15x15 puzzles.
- Themes: Both themed and themeless crossword puzzles.
Crossword game features: Smart Look Up, Dark Mode, Multi-word Entry Hints, Smart Step, Lock Completed Words, Incorrect Puzzle Assistance, Reveal Help, Show Errors, Clear Errors, Offline Mode, User Interface Themes.
---

bluejetty:00135519:ios.description:
What is MyBambu?
MyBambu is a financial app designed to simplify your life in the U.S. Open a checking account with a digital and physical Visa® debit card, send international money transfers, reload your phone, earn rewards at select merchants, and save with our promotions.
Open your MyBambu account using your country's official ID: no minimum balance or hidden fees. Get your digital Visa® debit card instantly and start using it today.
Download MyBambu now and start enjoying the financial freedom you deserve!
How to get started?
Sign up easily with your official ID (we accept over 100 types of documents).
What do you get with your MyBambu account?
Visa® Debit Card
Receive your digital card immediately after registration. The contactless physical card will arrive at no cost to your U.S. address. Use it worldwide and link it to PayPal, Venmo, and more.
https://bit.ly/debitCMB
Bambu Pay
Send and request money quickly and securely, anytime, anywhere.
https://bit.ly/BambuPayEn
Buy now and pay later
Start building your credit. Make deposits and you can be preapproved from $500 to $1,500.
https://bit.ly/shoponusMB
International money transfers: MyBambu gives you more!
More ways to send money: including Mercado Pago digital wallet and new destinations.
Send money to Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Peru, Dominican Republic, and Venezuela.
Your first four international transfers are free*, and funds arrive in just 35 minutes.
Send up to USD 1,000 per transaction, with fees starting at USD 0.85.
Send money now: https://bit.ly/IMTmb *T&C apply: https://bit.ly/disIMTen
Mobile Top-Ups
Reload phones in the U.S., the Caribbean, and Latin America instantly.
https://bit.ly/topupsMB
Health services
Discounts on telemedicine and more, from $19.99 USD/month for you and up to 4 family members.
 https://bit.ly/healthServicesMB
Rewards (Cashback)
Earn money when shopping at Disney+, CVS, Lyft, and other establishments.
https://bit.ly/rewardsMB
Cash deposits
Load cash at CVS, Walmart, Walgreens, and more authorized locations.
Allpoint and Visa® ATM network
Free withdrawals at over 62,000 ATMs in the U.S.
https://bit.ly/cashloadMB
Gift cards
Send gift cards to El Salvador, Mexico, USA, and more countries in Latin America and the Caribbean.
https://bit.ly/giftcardMB
Transfers between MyBambu users
Instant transfers with no fees.
https://bit.ly/p2pMB
Home deliveries
Send supplies to Venezuela.
https://bit.ly/sendfoodMB
Why MyBambu?
Advanced security with your funds insured by the FDIC up to $250,000 USD per ownership category, through Community Federal Savings Bank (CFSB), Member FDIC, in the event of bank failure.
Exclusive promotions and benefits: https://bit.ly/promosEN
Need help?
We speak English and Spanish.
Address
6225 N Quail Hollow Rd, Memphis, TN 38120
P.O. Box 3811, West Palm Beach, FL 33402
Customer service: 1-833-882-2628
Email: ayuda@mybambu.com
Follow us on social media:
Facebook: https://fb.com/mybambu.us 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@mybambu 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mybambu.us/ 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mybambu

bluejetty:00150475:ios.description:
Book a spot at 100+ weekly volleyball games across Canada!
Active Cities: Greater Toronto Area, Ottawa, Calgary, and Edmonton.
Volleyball is FUN! 
Getting 12 players of a similar skill level together is NOT!
This is how Javelin helps you play volleyball:
1. Use the Javelin app to find a volleyball game that matches your skill level.
2. Reserve your spot for that game directly in the app.
3. On game day, show up and play with others who also signed up through Javelin.
Why should you play volleyball?
Volleyball is more than just a sport—it's a way of life. It brings people together and creates connections like no other activity. And, it's a lot of fun!
Why is Javelin the #1 volleyball app? 
Javelin offers drop in games for all skill levels, ensuring fun, safe, and high-quality play. Each game is hosted by an experienced organizer who helps ensure players' skill levels are well-matched for the best experience.
Available Skill Levels
Beginner
Javelin offers training sessions with a coach to get new players familiar with volleyball.
Recreational
Recreational games place a on focus meeting new people, staying active, and having a great time!
High-Recreational
High recreational games are for good volleyball players seeking positionless play (6-6/6-0).
At this level players should be good at keeping the ball in play!
Intermediate 
For players who have a good understanding of different volleyball systems and court positioning/awareness (especially in a 5-1 system); in addition to being well practiced in passing or setting.
High-Intermediate
Players who are able to fill at least one of the following roles at a consistent level: DS, one of the front row positions, setter.
Advanced
Players who are able to fill at least one of the following roles at a very high and very consistent level: DS, one of the front row positions, setter.
To get an idea of what our different volleyball skill levels look like, check out our socials @appjavelin!
What other events does Javelin offer?
Training Sessions
From getting new players into volleyball to helping you take your game to the next level. We offer training sessions with a coach that takes you through warm ups, drills, and a game!
Tournaments/Leagues
Javelin leagues and tournaments uses a team ratings system which helps match your team against other teams of a similar skill level, allows you to track your match history, and allows you to compete for the number 1 spot on the leaderboards.
What Else Can Javelin Do? 
Grow Your Volleyball Connections
Join our public groups to chat and meet with like-minded players in your local community.
Custom Profiles
Create & customize your player profile to best represent yourself to other volleyball players! 
Stay Connected
Direct message another player after a match to share highlights, or simply connect for future events.
Track Your Volleyball Journey
Javelin allows you to track all the events you have attended, from weekly events to tournaments and leagues.
Localized Game Recommendations
Javelin shows you games based on your skill level and location. Looking for a recreational game in your neighbourhood? We’ll help you find one!
Private Event Creation
Schedule a private event with your friends! Track who’s going and who’s not, collect payments directly through Javelin, and create weekly, monthly, or one off events.
Build a Rated Team
Join or create your own rated team to compete with and against other teams of similar skill levels. After each game, input your scores and watch your team's rank climb to the top.
No matter your skill level or experience, Javelin has the perfect volleyball game for you!

Routely works with you to provide helpful insights into your driving behavior. Simply open the app to monitor your trips and driving data. You’ll get detailed maps of each trip, showing how far and how often you’re driving, along with any speeding, sudden braking, or distracted driving events.
New: Real-Time Crash Detection
Routely now includes crash detection technology that monitors for collisions in real time. If a crash is detected, the app can automatically call 911 or alert your emergency contacts—helping you get assistance when you need it most.
Routely does all the work for you, so you can keep your hands on the wheel and your eyes on the road.
While running in the background or during a trip, Routely’s battery usage is similar to other navigation apps.
Stay informed and safe with Routely.
Note: Please ensure your activation code is a seven-character code to use this app. Activation codes are provided via text or email by your insurance provider.

bluejetty:00023452:ios.description:
Simple. Free. It can save lives. 
The official IFRC First Aid app gives instant access to the information you need to know to handle the most common first aid emergencies and safety tips for crisis situation. With interactive quizzes and simple step-by-step everyday first aid scenarios, it’s never been easier to learn first aid. 
 ■ Engaging and active learning, allowing you to see and track your progress, build your knowledge, and increase confidence in your skills and ability to assist in emergencies.
 ■ Safety tips including water safety and road safety to help you prepare for emergencies.
 ■ Preloaded content means you have access to all information at any time, even without a cellular or WiFi connection.
 ■ Interactive quizzes allow you to earn badges that you can share with your friends and share your lifesaving knowledge.
 ■ Improved multi-lingual capability regardless of the user’s location. 
 ■ Linkages to your local Red Cross or Red Crescent on-site and online training.
 ■ Fully integrated with emergency numbers (such as 911, 999, 112, and others) so you can call for help from the app at any time, even while traveling across borders.
