bluejetty:00095957:ios.summary: Welcome to the Color by Number for Kids Games, the ultimate interactive experience where creativity and learning come together! This exciting app is designed to keep little ones engaged while helping them develop essential skills such as co
bluejetty:00095957:ios.description:
Welcome to the Color by Number for Kids Games, the ultimate interactive experience where creativity and learning come together! This exciting app is designed to keep little ones engaged while helping them develop essential skills such as color recognition, fine motor skills, and patience. Perfect for toddlers and young children, our app offers a fun and easy way to explore the world of Baby Coloring, Drawing Games, and Painting Games for Toddlers.
In our Color by Numbers Kids Coloring app, children will embark on an exciting coloring journey that combines entertainment with educational value. By simply following the numbers on the screen, kids can color various fun images such as animals, cartoons, and nature scenes. Each number corresponds to a specific color, allowing young learners to easily identify colors while practicing counting and number recognition. This is a great introduction to early learning concepts while also allowing them to unleash their inner artist.
Our coloring games are designed to be engaging, educational, and accessible for children aged 2-6. The app features a wide variety of coloring pages that include simple designs for younger children and more intricate images for those who are ready to take on more detailed projects. This variety ensures that kids of all ages can enjoy the app, from Painting Games for Toddlers to more advanced Drawing Games for older kids. Each page is designed to keep kids entertained while also teaching them important skills like color matching, number recognition, and hand-eye coordination.
Pixel Coloring is another exciting feature in the app, perfect for children who love playing with tiny details. By filling in pixelated grids, kids can create amazing works of art using vibrant colors. This not only enhances their attention to detail but also helps with their spatial awareness and understanding of how small sections come together to form a larger picture. It's a fun and engaging way to teach kids about patience and concentration, all while letting them enjoy pixel art!
Additionally, the app offers Math Coloring activities that combine coloring with basic math skills. Kids can solve simple math problems like addition and subtraction to unlock the colors needed for each section of the image. This is a great way to reinforce early math concepts while keeping the experience fun and engaging. With Math Coloring, children will feel like they are on an adventure where they get to color and practice their math skills at the same time.
Alphabet Coloring is a fantastic way to help young children learn their ABCs while having fun. Each page focuses on a letter of the alphabet, with pictures that begin with that letter, making it easy for children to associate sounds with letters. This feature is designed to reinforce letter recognition and early literacy skills in a fun, interactive way. It’s a perfect blend of color by number and learning, helping children to grow both their creativity and their language skills.
Lastly, the Glow Coloring feature adds a magical touch to the app. Kids can color glowing images such as stars, rainbows, and other magical creatures. This feature lets children see their art come to life with vibrant colors that appear to glow, adding an exciting and enchanting twist to the usual coloring experience. Whether it's a glowing unicorn or a shining rainbow, Glow Coloring will captivate kids and inspire their imagination.

-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.

bluejetty:00121108:ios.summary:
Escape the noise. Relax with the world's most soothing card game.

bluejetty:00121108:ios.description:
Escape the noise. Relax with the world's most soothing card game.
Crazy Eights is your offline sanctuary—no news, no stress, just classic card strategy. Whether you call it Mau Mau, Switch, or Last One, this is the perfect way to unwind.
WHY PLAYERS LOVE US:
Instant Relaxation: Smooth gameplay designed to lower your heart rate.
Sharpen Your Mind: A perfect mix of logic, strategy, and memory training.
CORE FEATURES:
Smart AI Opponents: Challenging but fair bots that play like humans.
Custom Rules: Play it your way—Crazy Eights, Mau Mau, Macau, or Switch.
Beautiful Design: Clean cards and calming backgrounds for maximum focus.
Don’t just kill time—enjoy it. Download Crazy Eights now and start your relaxing streak today!
YOUR GOAL IN CRAZY EIGHTS:
* Get rid of your cards as quickly as possible by matching the rank or suit with the top card on the discard pile. The player who gives away all their cards first, WINS.
* When a player plays an EIGHT (8) the current Wish card, he or she must decide the suit for the next turn. Next players should follow the named suit or play an Eight (8).
WHAT ABOUT THE SCORE?
Score points are summed up at the end of the game. The application automatically calculates the final score based on the remaining cards in your opponent's hands.
Cards are worth as follows:
- Crazy Eight (8) = 50 points 
- Face Cards (J, Q, K) = 10 points
- All Other Cards (2-10) = points equal to face value
- Jokers have no value (shh, don't tell them)
In Settings you can adjust the rules to your custom style
Crazy Eights is offered in the following languages with high quality localization: English, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish and Russian.
TERMS OF USE, PRIVACY POLICY, SUBSCRIPTIONS
Crazy Eights Classic Cards app offers a weekly subscription (1 week), monthly(1 month) and a yearly subscription (1 year) called Premier.
If you subscribe in another currency, the price may vary slightly if your bank charges you a conversion fee.
Payment for your subscription will be debited from your account after your purchase is confirmed.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Find out more about our general terms of use at https://crazyeightscardgame.com/terms-of-service/
Find out more about our privacy policy at https://crazyeightscardgame.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00065417:ios.description:
Securely manage your money anywhere, anytime with the Unity Credit Union Mobile App. Expect everyday banking features such as transferring funds, paying bills, depositing cheques, INTERAC e-Transfer®, and more. Plus, new innovative features such as opening accounts online, member-to-member transfers, transaction alerts, and advanced security features. Business members can experience a unique login experience with business alerts, two-to-sign capability, profile consolidation, and the ability to add delegates. With customized personalization features, you can design your mobile app experience to suit your needs.
-Check account balances
-View transaction history
-Transfer funds between Unity Credit Union accounts
-Send and accept INTERAC e-Transfers
-Pay bills now or set up payments for later
-Deposit cheques remotely
BENEFITS INCLUDE:
-Free download
-Easy to navigate and learn
-No new passwords or personal access questions to remember
ACCESS:
No charge for the app, but mobile data downloading and Internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
To use the Mobile App, you must be registered for Online Banking. If you are not yet enrolled for Online Banking, call us at 306-228-2688 or visit us in branch.
Note that this app requires several permissions:
• Take pictures and videos – used for the Deposit Anywhere™ mobile cheque deposit feature 
• Approximate location and precise location – used for the find Branch ATM feature. This can be turned off after the app installation by turning off the phone’s GPS. 
• Full network access – used to connect to the Internet in order for the app to function 
• View network connection – allows the app to select the best connectivity to operate the app by viewing the types of Internet connectivity available to the phone when the mobile banking app is being used.

bluejetty:00087389:ios.summary:
O App Bio Ritmo oferece uma experiência pensada para facilitar sua rotina fitness, integrando em um só lugar tudo o que você precisa para realizar seus treinos presenciais com mais praticidade e bem-estar. 
Criado para acompanhar sua jorna
bluejetty:00087389:ios.description:
O App Bio Ritmo oferece uma experiência pensada para facilitar sua rotina fitness, integrando em um só lugar tudo o que você precisa para realizar seus treinos presenciais com mais praticidade e bem-estar. 
Criado para acompanhar sua jornada dentro da sua unidade, o app organiza seus treinos, conecta serviços exclusivos e registra sua evolução de forma simples, intuitiva e personalizada.
Organização que simplifica sua rotina
Planeje seus dias de treino com uma agenda desenhada para tornar sua experiência na academia mais prática. Pelo app, é possível reservar aulas, experiências e atendimentos, além de receber sugestões inteligentes de agendamento que ajudam a manter a constância sem complicar o dia a dia.
Seus treinos à um toque de distância 
Visualize e realize treinos guiados, acompanhe sua frequência e tenha acesso a informações que ajudam a entender sua evolução ao longo do tempo. O app registra cada etapa da sua jornada, ajudando na sua motivação e na regularidade dos treinos.
Integração exclusiva com Apple Watch
Para quem treina com Apple Watch, o App Bio Ritmo oferece uma integração exclusiva, que registra automaticamente tempo de treino, frequência cardíaca média e calorias gastas por exercício, incorporando esses dados ao seu histórico de forma consistente com a experiência da academia.
Acompanhamento e cuidado em cada detalhe
Sempre que precisar, você pode solicitar acompanhamento dos professores durante seus treinos na unidade. O app também centraliza seu histórico de avaliações físicas, como peso, bioimpedância e percentual de gordura, oferecendo uma visão clara e organizada do seu progresso.
Conexão, motivação e celebração
Compartilhe seus treinos e conquistas nas redes sociais, celebre cada evolução e receba notificações personalizadas sobre aulas, agenda, treinos e progresso. 
O App Bio Ritmo traz a experiência da sua academia premium para seu smartphone, reunindo organização, acompanhamento e serviços exclusivos em uma plataforma que respeita seu ritmo e apoia cada etapa da sua jornada de bem-estar.

bluejetty:00045752:ios.summary:

Welldoc can help yo
bluejetty:00045752:ios.description:
Managing your health can be tough, but it doesn't have to be. The Welldoc App is a digital health app that supports you every step of the way, so you can worry less about your health and focus more on what matters most.
Welldoc can help you manage your weight, diabetes, prediabetes, heart failure, hypertension, and dementia with confidence. It brings your health data together to provide you with personalized digital AI coaching and insights, making those day-to-day choices much easier. 
The Welldoc App is only available through participating health plans, health systems, and employers 
How the Welldoc App Helps You Manage Your Health
 • Personalized coaching: Receive guidance based on your unique health data right when you need it most 
 • AI-powered health insights: Learn how nutrition, activity, sleep, medications, and device data, such as data from Apple Health®, affect your condition so that you can build better habits 
 • An updated medication experience: Easier than ever to set reminders, track schedules, and log your intake 
 • Brain health support: Helps you stay sharp and confident using brain training, interactive games, goals, and daily journeys. 
 • Simon, an AI-powered Assistant: Use Simon as your personal guide, available 24/7
 • Welldoc Community: Stay motivated and connected with a supportive network of members on similar health journeys
 • Goals and challenges: Participate in daily activities to keep you on the right track
 • Health education and tools: Access trusted education resources to help you better understand your health
 • Care team health reports: Easily share detailed health summaries directly with your care team to keep them updated on your health between visits
The Welldoc App is not intended to replace the care provided by a licensed healthcare professional, including prescriptions, diagnosis, or treatment. Seek the guidance of a licensed healthcare professional before making medical decisions. 
The Welldoc® App is Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) intended to be used by healthcare providers (HCP) and their patients – aged 18 years and older – who have prediabetes, diabetes, heart failure, high blood pressure, liver disease, kidney disease, and/or sleep apnea. The Welldoc App also supports weight management, mental well-being, and brain health. The software is not intended to replace the care provided by a licensed healthcare professional, including prescriptions, diagnosis, or treatment nor is it intended to replace self-monitoring practices as advised by a physician. The software does not provide treatment recommendations. 
Visit welldoc.com/indications-for-use/ for full labeling information. 
The privacy and security of your personal information is very important to us. We protect it in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act. 
ABOUT WELLDOC 
Welldoc is committed to improving the health of individuals living with a chronic disease. 
© 2009-26 Welldoc, Inc. Intellectual Property. All rights reserved. The Welldoc and BlueStar name and logo are trademarks of Welldoc. Made in the USA. Manufactured by Welldoc.

bluejetty:00022302:ios.name: RE-1 Tape Machine
bluejetty:00022302:ios.summary:
RE-1 - Tape Echo 
RE-1 is a full featured virtual Tape Machine capable of delivering authentic tape based echo and chorus effects but it doesn't stop there. With it's interactive tape player, sample, loop and overdub features it's possible
bluejetty:00022302:ios.description:
RE-1 - Tape Echo 
RE-1 is a full featured virtual Tape Machine capable of delivering authentic tape based echo and chorus effects but it doesn't stop there. With it's interactive tape player, sample, loop and overdub features it's possible to use it like a virtual tape recorder, sample player, looper or simply as a master effect. 
Overview:
- Virtual Tape deck including 3 individually controllable read heads, variable delay time and feedback
- Interactive user interface and realtime visualisation of various parameters related to the tape simulation
- Dedicated controls for Wow, Flutter, Color, Tape Hiss & saturation amount 
- Tape Loop mode with overdub, tape reverse and time-stretching 
- Sample/Loop library loads wave files onto the virtual tape loop
- Transport and Tempo Sync
- Stereo Spread & Stereo Panner
- Input processing: Highpass filter 
- Output processing: 2 band eq
Tape Echo:
- Authentic tape echo emulation
- Multi-tap delay with 3 individually controllable read heads 
- Color Control adjusts the echo's tone from dark to bright
- Delay Time: 5ms - 1000ms (or 1/32th to 1/1) 
- Wow & Flutter 
- Tape Hiss and Saturation
- Stereo spread
- Stereo panner
Looper / Sample Player:
- Uses the tape like a traditional looper with unlimited overdubs
- Configurable Loop length with 1 - 8 bars and tempo sync and tape reverse
- Tape transport can be linked to the host's transport controls
- Time stretching keeps loops in sync 
- Samples/loops can be loaded onto the tape directly
- Samples can be created from the tape loop and stored in the sample library at any time
- Factory content includes a variety of loops grouped by style
- Samples/loops can be imported from and exported to other apps 
Connectivity:
- Standalone
- AUv3
- InterApp-Audio
- Audiobus
- Ableton Link
- MIDI (Tempo, CC, Program Change)
- Requirements: 
- iOS 11+

bluejetty:00158271:ios.description:
PCOS Tracker App is designed with a simple weight & food tracker, stats, and all the answers to your burning questions.
Free PCOS Tracker App will help you reach your fitness goals, take control of your weight (and life!), regulate your hormones, and enjoy all the health benefits that PCOS diet offers in just a few simple clicks.
Now’s the time to get the healthy body of your dreams. What are you waiting for? Install the app and start seeing results immediately!
FEATURES:
** Diet tracker **
All presets work perfectly with any diet or food restrictions: carnivore, keto, paleo, gluten-free, etc.
Whether you are just starting out or already familiar with carnivore diet, the PCOS Tracker App will guide you through the process.
** Weight tracker **
Monitor your progress with the app’s weight tracker as it provides valuable insights. Nothing is more satisfying than seeing that weight curve move in the right direction? The app will help you achieve the weight goals that are right for you.
** Water tracker **
Don't forget to drink water! Use our water tracker with a reminder function. We automatically calculate the right amount for you.
** Personal daily recommendations **
Stay healthy and motivated with our daily recommendations!
** Body status **
We identify and track key stages in your weight loss journey.
** Stats **
Track your eating intervals with a your personal plan. The beauty of carnivore diet lies in its simplicity and efficiency. Forget about those rollercoaster diets and cleanses, and let the PCOS Tracker App guide you to where you need to get.
** Insights **
PCOS Tracker App has been customized for women, based on their biology and needs. Through insights, you can access the knowledge of carnivore diet and get your questions answered. 
** Health App Integration **
PCOS Tracker App integrates the following data from the Health app (HealthKit) to keep track of your body status: body mass index, exercise minutes, height, weight, mindful minutes, date of birth, steps, and water.
** Subscription Information **
PCOS Tracker App is free to download, however purchase is required to access app features & content. The app offers paid premium features. The Premium gives you access to personalized daily recommendations, insights, recipes, chat support, club chat, and statistics. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
PCOS diet has been the talk of the health world for good reason. The positive outcomes associated with the carnivore diet lifestyle include self-healing mechanisms, detoxing, anti-aging, and other worthwhile benefits.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You must always consult your physician or doctor before starting any diet program.
Terms & Conditions: https://healthium.one/apps/pcos-tracker/tc
Privacy policy: https://healthium.one/apps/pcos-tracker/pp

bluejetty:00035052:ios.summary:
If you like Hasbro's RISK® game, you'll love War.app!

bluejetty:00035052:ios.description:
If you like Hasbro's RISK® game, you'll love War.app!
War.app (previously known as Warzone) is a deep, skill-based online strategy game inspired by classic board games but built for modern multiplayer.
Fair, Skill-Based Gameplay
• No pay-to-win, ever. All games are equally fair for all players.
• Luck-free: By default, War.app games are determined entirely by your skill.
Single-Player & Multiplayer
• Active community: Over 10,000 multi-player games are played every day. 
• Cross-platform: You can play from your phone, tablet, or computer. You can play against other players no matter what platform they're on. All for free!
• Join a clan and compete in clan wars!
• Games can be up to 400 players, and can be free-for-alls, teams, co-op, and more!
Endless Maps & Customization
• War.app has a very flexible engine. When creating games, you have hundreds of settings you can tweak to create anything from a minor variant to a whole new experience.
• There are thousands of maps to choose from, all made by the community. Or you can design your own! Maps range from small brawls to epic conquests with 4000 territories.
• Play against real people, or play any of the thousands of single-player levels against the computer. Both are 100% free.
• Community levels: Play single-player levels from the community, or make your own level and watch replays of other players defeating it.
• Cards: War.app has a variety of cards with varying effects, like the Diplomacy Card, Spy Card, Airlift Card, Blockade Card, and more!
• Mods allow extending the game engine. No installation required.
Play at Your Own Pace
• Faster games: All players can take their turn at the same time. Your friends don't need to be all be online at the same time to play with them. Take your turns when it's convenient and War.app will wait for you.
Competitive Play
• Compete in tournaments, ladders, clan wars, quickmatch. War.app has a highly active competitive community.
• Quickmatch: QM makes it easy to jump into multi-player by matching you with players of equal skill on templates you like playing.
• Open Games: If Quickmatch isn't to your liking, you can always browse through a list of games made by other players, or make your own!
Truly Independent
• War.app is an indie game in the truest sense of the word, as the entire game is made by a single person known as Fizzer, who has been developing the game since 2008. 
• Fizzer hopes to continue developing this game for the rest of his life.
Terms of service: https://war.app/TermsOfService
RISK® is a registered trademark of Hasbro, Inc. War.app is not affiliated with Hasbro, Inc.

bluejetty:00041226:ios.summary:

HeadApp is more than a headache diary. It gives you the chance to live better by letting
bluejetty:00041226:ios.description:
Start recording your headache, track your pain intensity and pain location changes during the single attack. *no need to fill in your personal data*.
HeadApp is more than a headache diary. It gives you the chance to live better by letting you fully understand your headache through a guided input of fundamental data that will be processed to return you easy to read statistics and graphs. 
It replaces the paper headache diary that headache doctors suggest patient to fill in order to have a correct diagnosis and appropriated therapy. HeadApp! helps you also to discover your triggers and prevent an attack. 
This App has been developed by neurologists and patients suffering different headache types.
Highlights:
-record pain duration
-intensity
-classification
-position
-triggers
-symptoms
-medications
-hormonal factors
-impairment
Charts/report everything: simple to read yet built on professional guidelines. Easy to share with your family/friend/care givers and doctor through mail,messaging, and other chats.
Apple Health integration: automatically export your headaches and sleep log to Health or read sleep data (import) collected by Health compatible apps in order to compare it against your headache patterns
More:
- Sleep diary with automatic detection of sleep and wake-up alarm
- Graphical correlation of sleep/headache patterns
- Monthly calendar view with color highlighting of different headaches
- Personal headache profile to assist you in filling your headache records
- Offline mode (no network required) or online (cloud based) storage mode with user registration *(only e-mail, no marketing use of your e-mail)*
This App is not an alternative to proper specialistic medical treatment, is not a medical device and you are always invited to consult a physician for any health related issue.

bluejetty:00064498:ios.name: kinfo - Trading Journal
bluejetty:00064498:ios.summary:
kinfo is a trading journal that connects to your broker and builds a verified record of every trade you take. Your executions are imported automatically, so your track record cannot be typed in, edited or faked.
WHAT KINFO DOES
kinfo reads
bluejetty:00064498:ios.description:
kinfo is a trading journal that connects to your broker and builds a verified record of every trade you take. Your executions are imported automatically, so your track record cannot be typed in, edited or faked.
WHAT KINFO DOES
kinfo reads your filled orders from your broker, groups them into trades, and shows what your results actually look like: total profit and loss, win rate, average gain and average loss per trade, hold time, and performance broken down by symbol, by day and by month. You add the notes. kinfo handles the numbers.
WHY VERIFIED MATTERS
Anyone can post a screenshot of a green day. A kinfo track record comes straight from the broker over a read-only connection, which is why it can be trusted, and why other traders' profiles on kinfo are worth reading.
WHAT YOU GET
- Automatic trade import from your broker
- Profit and loss per trade, per day, per symbol and all-time
- Win rate, average gain, average loss, largest win, largest loss
- Trading journal with daily notes, screenshots and a monthly summary
- Calendar view of your trading month
- Verified public profile, if you want one
- Leaderboard of verified traders
- Other traders' portfolios, positions and trades
- Follow the traders you want to learn from
WHICH BROKERS DOES KINFO SUPPORT?
kinfo connects to 22+ brokers and trading platforms, including Interactive Brokers, Charles Schwab, Robinhood, TradeStation, tastytrade, E*TRADE, Fidelity, Tradier, TradeZero, Lightspeed, CenterPoint Securities, Cobra Trading, Guardian Trading, SageTrader, SuccessTrader, Ocean Securities, Zimtra, AMP Futures, NinjaTrader and MetaTrader 5.
WHO IS KINFO FOR?
Active traders who take it seriously: day traders, swing traders, options and futures traders, and long-term investors who want to know their real numbers. Beginners use kinfo to find out what their edge is. Experienced traders use it to prove they have one.
DO I HAVE TO SHARE MY TRADES?
No. Sharing is opt-in. You can use kinfo privately as a portfolio tracker and trading journal, or publish a verified profile and join the leaderboard. You choose, and you can change your mind.
IS MY DATA SAFE?
kinfo uses third-party aggregation partners to read trading data, with bank-level 256-bit encryption. Your broker credentials are never stored by kinfo and never pass through kinfo. Every broker connection is read-only: kinfo can read your trades and can never place an order.
WHAT DOES IT COST?
kinfo is free to use as a trading journal and portfolio tracker. [SLOT: one or two lines on what PRO and PRO+ add, and the price, so the paywall is not a surprise.]
THE IDEA
Trading is a lonely job. Only a small share of active traders are profitable over any long stretch, and fewer still make a living from it. People learn more from watching someone do a thing than from reading about it. Sport works that way, and so does trading. kinfo exists so you can measure your own trading honestly and watch verified traders do what they do.
More on security: https://kinfo.com/faq
Privacy policy: https://kinfo.com/privacy
Terms: https://kinfo.com/terms

Mahjong Daily – Relax, Match Tiles, Sharpen Your Mind!
Dive into the classic joy of Mahjong Solitaire with Mahjong Daily, a tile - matching puzzle game. Fusing traditional Chinese mahjong with modern casual design, it offers thousands of meticulously crafted boards, calming visuals, and intuitive gameplay for all.
# How to Play
Match pairs of free (unblocked and uncovered) identical tiles to remove them from the board. Clear all tiles to finish the puzzle and unlock the next one. It's easy to learn, relaxing to play, and rewarding to master.
# Key Features
- Thousands of Puzzles: Classic and creative layouts ensure continuous fun.
- Zen - inspired Themes & Music: Create a peaceful gaming atmosphere.
- Daily Challenges & Rewards: Keep your brain active daily.
- Customization: Personalize with custom tile sets and backgrounds.
- Helpful Tools: Hints and shuffle options to assist you.
- No Time Limits: Play at your own pace, stress - free.
- Offline Play: Enjoy anywhere without an internet connection.
# Why You'll Love It
It combines traditional gameplay with a modern design. Suitable for beginners and experts, it helps improve focus, memory, and concentration. It's a great offline game for travel, breaks, or relaxation. It's not just a game but a daily mental escape.
# For Everyone
Designed for all ages, it combines strategy, relaxation, and visual appeal. With endless puzzles, customization options, and daily challenges, it can become part of your daily routine.
# Download Now – Free!
Start your peaceful puzzle journey by downloading Mahjong Daily today.
There's an optional No Ads Subscription available on a weekly ($2.99), monthly ($5.99), or yearly ($9.99) basis. Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon purchase. bluejetty:00084910:ios.summary: In this era of martial arts, where heroes rise and fall, various sects and factions compete for power, and the martial world is ever-changing. Amidst this chaos, some pursue the pinnacle of martial arts, others uphold justice and vanquish e
bluejetty:00084910:ios.description:
In this era of martial arts, where heroes rise and fall, various sects and factions compete for power, and the martial world is ever-changing. Amidst this chaos, some pursue the pinnacle of martial arts, others uphold justice and vanquish evil, while some lurk in the shadows, plotting their ambitions. Your arrival heralds a new chapter in this saga—will you be the righteous hero who saves the world or the cold tyrant seeking power? The choice is yours!
Lightness Skills, Free Exploration
In Echoes of Eternity, Lightness Skills is not just a survival skill; it’s your best tool for exploration. With the ability to leap across rooftops, walk on water, and soar through the air, you can navigate the stunning landscapes of the world, effortlessly traverse complex terrains, and discover hidden treasures and secrets. Explore the renowned sites of the martial world, from majestic ancient city walls to tranquil bamboo groves — everything is at your fingertips!
Lightness Battle, Defeat the Enemy in Secrecy
Utilize your Lightness Skills to gain the upper hand in battle! You can dodge enemy attacks with acrobatic maneuvers and strike back swiftly. The unique Lightness combat system, combined with various martial techniques, allows you to experience exhilarating aerial assaults and seamless combos. In this martial world, every leap and movement can change the course of battle, providing unmatched satisfaction!
Diverse Classes & Unique Skills
Choose from four distinct Classes — Reaper, Luthier, Wanderer, and Fencer — each with unique martial skills and abilities. The diverse combinations of techniques and distinctive combat styles offer different experiences, helping you forge your legend in the martial world!
Martial Techniques & Divine Weapons
Explore the secret realms of the martial world to collect spell manuals and master unparalleled skills such as "Nine Suns Spell", "Nine Nether Ghost Technique" and “Yin and Yang Incarnate,” becoming a martial arts master! Forge extraordinary weapons, inlay them with rare gems, and create your unparalleled artifacts!
Guilds & Allies
Create or join a powerful guild, recruit like-minded heroes, and make new friends in the martial world! Participate in guild events and battles to seize territories, resources, and ultimate glory!
Free Martial World, Real-Time Battles
Explore an open world freely, make friends, and engage in righteous conflicts to experience the true life of a martial artist. The real-time PvP system allows you to challenge other players anytime, immersing you in exhilarating combat. Key events unfold with spoken dialogue.
- Deeply emotional portrayals
Characters go through visibly apparent emotional changes.
- A brand new mapping feature
Players start with a completely blank dungeons map, adding an element of the unknown to the mix!
- Jukebox
Players can listen to the game's music anytime they want.
----------------------------------

- High resolution graphics and retouched cutscenes.
- Smooth, intuitive touch-panel controls specifically tailored to improve the gaming experience.
-Select difficulty from Normal to Hard to adjust the balance of the game.
- New save functions, including autosave, allow for players to quit the game at any time without fear of losing their progress.

bluejetty:00200151:ios.summary:
Make a melody with a line.
Play Music turns your drawings into looping music on iPhone and iPad. Draw from left to right through time, draw higher for higher notes, and choose a color to change instruments. Press Play, then keep drawing or
bluejetty:00200151:ios.description:
Make a melody with a line.
Play Music turns your drawings into looping music on iPhone and iPad. Draw from left to right through time, draw higher for higher notes, and choose a color to change instruments. Press Play, then keep drawing or erase a line to hear your composition change.
DRAW, LISTEN, EXPLORE
Create with nine synthesized instruments: keys, pluck, bell, marimba, flute, strings, chime, bass, and 8-bit tones. Switch between Draw and Pixel for two visual views of the same music.
START WITH A DRAWING
Explore ten original illustrated drawings, from a mountain village and a lighthouse to a whale among stars and a rainy-day cafe. Every line is editable, and every sound comes from the actual drawing.
Tap Random to discover twenty simple drawings that play familiar melody excerpts. English guidance explains the melody and how to recreate its shapes, helping you explore pitch, duration, and spacing.
SHAPE YOUR SOUND
Add bass, drums, and arpeggios independently or together. Adjust tempo, key, major or minor scales, loop length, and rhythm. Try pentatonic or diatonic scales, change your instrument colors, and experiment with the built-in keyboard.
MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Choose Light or Dark appearance. Set the canvas against the panel, sky, or a photo you select. Use the eraser, undo, and redo as you explore. Your current draft saves automatically, and the local Library keeps multiple projects ready to revisit.
SHARE WHAT YOU MAKE
Export one complete loop as an MP4 music video, WAV audio, or multitrack MIDI file. Use the system share sheet to save or share your creation. MIDI contains musical notes and uses the instruments in your other music app, so its sound may differ from Play Music.
CREATE OFFLINE
Drawing, playback, saving, and export work on your device. No account or internet connection is required, and the app does not automatically upload your drawings or background photos. Play Music has no advertisements or third-party analytics.
Play Music is available in English.

bluejetty:00074281:ios.description:
The Epoch Times en español, como una alternativa reflexiva a tu flujo diario de noticias, pone en tus manos las noticias más recientes y auténticas. Con la aplicación de The Epoch Times en español, puedes mantenerte al día con los eventos mundiales dondequiera que estés, incluso mientras conduces o esperas, de la manera más conveniente.
La aplicación de The Epoch Times en español te ofrece noticias confiables sin la influencia de ningún gobierno, corporación o partido político. Obtén acceso instantáneo al periodismo galardonado, noticias de última hora, políticas, de EE. UU., China y del mundo, así como historias sobre arte y cultura, y mucho más.
Con la aplicación de The Epoch Times en español, tendrás acceso a todo nuestro contenido digital, incluyendo una cobertura en profundidad de la política en EE. UU. y reportajes sobre China. También tendrás acceso a nuestros programas premium como Líderes del Mundo Hispano, Noticias Epoch Times, Al Descubierto, En Primera Plana, China en Foco, American Thought Leaders, Crossroads, Facts Matter y California Desde Adentro, así como comentarios y documentales sobre temas importantes. Hay cobertura especial que se actualiza regularmente sobre temas de tendencia.
Descarga la aplicación de The Epoch Times en español para experimentar nuestra plataforma de publicaciones digitales.
CARACTERÍSTICAS PRINCIPALES DE LA APLICACIÓN:
- Sección Principal: Ve de un vistazo todos los eventos importantes y temas candente en EE. UU. México, Latinoamérica, China y alrededor del mundo.
- Alertas de Noticias de Última Hora: Recibe las últimas noticias de manera oportuna a medida que ocurren.
- Sección de Videos: Disfruta de series originales exclusivas, videos inspiradores y documentales. Los usuarios pueden ver avances automáticamente para obtener un resumen.
- Opinión: Lee comentarios políticos, sociales y personales.
- Compartir fácilmente: Comparte historias en todas las principales plataformas de redes sociales como Twitter y Facebook, así como por correo electrónico o mensaje de texto.
- Guardar Artículos: Guarda artículos y videos en tu lista de lectura.
- Sin Conexión: Lee artículos y mira videos en tu lista guardada sin conexión a internet.
- Ajuste de Tamaño de Fuente: Ajusta el tamaño de la fuente en los artículos.
Términos de servicio: https://es.theepochtimes.com/terminos-y-condiciones-registros-y-suscripciones-de-cuentas-digitales
Política de privacidad: https://es.theepochtimes.com/politica-de-privacidad
AYUDA TÉCNICA Y ASISTENCIA:
Estamos trabajando arduamente para asegurarnos de que nuestros lectores tengan una excelente experiencia al usar nuestra aplicación. Si tienes alguna pregunta sobre el funcionamiento de la aplicación, deseas brindarnos comentarios útiles o experimentas dificultades técnicas como fallos, por favor contáctanos en spanishedition@epochtimes.nyc. De esta manera, nuestros desarrolladores podrán identificar y resolver los problemas de manera oportuna.

bluejetty:00122097:ios.name: Spotlight: Room Escape
bluejetty:00122097:ios.summary: Are you ready for the thrilling experience with lots of drama and adventures? “Spotlight - Room Escape” is a thrilling app based on the theatrical drama scene. What would you be up to if you have been kidnapped and locked up in a strange ro
bluejetty:00122097:ios.description:
Are you ready for the thrilling experience with lots of drama and adventures? “Spotlight - Room Escape” is a thrilling app based on the theatrical drama scene. What would you be up to if you have been kidnapped and locked up in a strange room with no clue about how you reached there? You literally have forgotten everything and your only aim is to escape from the room before time runs out. Start your investigations and find the answers to various questions like who kidnapped you, the purpose of your kidnapping and lot more on the process of finding the way out.!
The game “Spotlight - Room Escape” is beautifully designed with mysterious graphics and thrilling sound effects. Every object in the Room is placed with clear logic around it and each scene describes deep meaning.! Observe, Analyze and use your logical skills to escape the mysterious Room.
Get ready for the most adventurous thrilling journey of your life with “Spotlight - Room Escape”. Collect the clues and start building the plan to escape the way out. The game has intuitive gaming controls perfect for players from all age groups. Find out the necessary things hidden in the room like Torch, Rope, and lot more to have your Escape plan ready. The game has lots of mysterious levels each designed with unique exit plans. Explore the location carefully and combine various clues to find the way out!
Check out your detective skills and investigate every scene and objects to find the clues. Put on your logical hat and solve the various number and letter puzzles to open the locks. The clues can be hidden anywhere around you. Solve the riddles and words by investigating the clues found. The game requires complete patience skills and analyzing skills along with the logical thinking to solve the scenes quickly and escape out. The game “Spotlight - Room Escape” is a perfect game for all those who love investigating items around and have awesome analyzing and logical thinking capabilities. 
************************
FEATURES
************************
 - Awesome 3D graphics with mysterious sound effects
 - Intuitive touch mode gaming controls
 - Lots of challenging levels
 - Thrilling scenes and hidden clues 
 - Interesting riddles and puzzles
 - Exciting ways of investigation to find the escape plan
Download the most addictive detective game “Spotlight - Room Escape” and have the adventurous exciting journey while exploring the locations to find out the escape plan. The game will help you improve your logical thinking and increase the efficiency to solve puzzles. Push out your brain and exercise your mind to solve the challenging puzzles. Complete the levels successfully and unlock the new crime scene in a new room for more thrilling puzzles.!
************************
SAY HELLO
************************
We are constantly working hard on making the “Spotlight - Room Escape” game better with more advanced and thrilling features. We need your constant support to get going. Please feel free to contribute and email us for any queries/suggestions/problems or if you just want to say hello. We would love to hear from you. If you have enjoyed any feature of the “Spotlight - Room Escape” game, do not forget to rate us and share among your friends.

Moto Racer - Bike Racing Game
“Feel the Speed. Rule the Machine. Become the Racing Legend.” 
Hey rider! The engines are roaring, the tracks are ready, and the world of moto racing game is calling your name. In Moto Racer - Bike Racing Game, it’s not just about speed — it’s about skill, timing, and the hunger to win in the ultimate bike racing game.
Step into the world of high-speed bike racing games, where every race is a challenge and every second matters. Push your limits in this motorcycle racing game, ride through intense tracks, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate moto racer.
High-Speed Moto Racing Game Experience
Feel the thrill of fast bike racing game with smooth controls and realistic physics. Accelerate, overtake rivals, and dominate every race in this action-packed racing game.
Powerful Bikes & Upgrades
Unlock and ride multiple GT bikes in this exciting bike racing game. Upgrade speed, handling, and acceleration to build your perfect motorcycle racing game machine.
Dynamic Tracks & Challenges
Race across challenging levels in this addictive bike racing game. Each level brings new obstacles, tighter competition, and more intense racing game action.
Nitro Boost & Extreme Speed
Use nitro in this thrilling moto racing game and feel the rush of insane speed. Leave opponents behind and become the fastest rider in this bike racing game.
Smooth Controls & Stunning Graphics
Enjoy immersive visuals, responsive gameplay, and realistic sound effects in this next-level motorcycle racing game experience.
Game Modes to Prove Your Skills
Campaign Mode – Rise to Glory
Race against skilled opponents in this competitive bike racing game, win challenges, and climb your way to the top.
Time Challenge – Beat the Clock
Test your speed in intense racing game missions and break your own records.
Competitive Racing – Dominate Rivals
Show your skills in this high-speed moto racing game, defeat opponents, and become a true bike racing game champion.
Why You’ll Love Moto Racer
i) Realistic moto racing game experience
ii) Fast-paced bike racing games action
iii) Multiple GT bikes & racing game upgrades
iv) Smooth controls & HD racing game graphics
v) Addictive motorcycle racing game gameplay
The road is yours. The speed is real. The challenge is waiting.

bluejetty:00069672:ios.description:
5 Second Rule is a game you can use to start any house party with a blast. It’s a perfect ice breaker. 
You can play it with your closest friends or complete strangers, it will always deliver.
How to play?
Answer simple questions, you have 5 seconds to come up with 3 answers before the buzzer rings. The first player to give 10 correct answers is the winner!
Features:
- Hundreds of questions
- 7 Different decks
- Hours of fun with your friends and family
- Minimum 2 players, maximum 14 players
- Includes dirty questions for adults (NSFW)
- Includes family friendly questions
- Create your own questions
- No video ads
Frequently Asked Questions
What if I have only 1 friend?
No worries! You can play with 2 players.
How big can my party get?
You can play with a maximum of 16 players. If you have more people, we recommend you split up into teams. 
Can I play it with my family?
Absolutely, you can play with all cards, and leave out the dirty pack before the start of the game.
I don’t want to play with boring cards I want only the dirty stuff!
That’s not a question, but yes, you can play the game with ONLY dirty questions.

Designed for our U.S. clients and prospects, the RBC Wealth Management Online App provides you with easy account access on-the-go. 
View your accounts, securely contact your advisor and access market data at the touch of a button. 
Simply sign in using the same username and password you set up for RBC Wealth Management Online desktop access, or complete registration if you have not done so (applicable for clients with existing accounts). 
Here’s what you can do:
- View your total portfolio through the dashboard
- Check account balances, performance summaries, asset mixes, holdings and activities for specific accounts
- Deposit checks to eligible accounts directly through your app
- See market performance at-a-glance, including major movers and related investment news
- Send secure messages and attachments to your financial advisor, and see instant contact information
- Get in touch with Client Support Services
- Touch ID and Face ID
To get the best performance and security, ensure your device is running the latest version of iOS and enable push notifications for important alerts.

bluejetty:00123397:ios.name: Cook's Illustrated Magazine
bluejetty:00123397:ios.summary: The Cook’s Illustrated Magazine app is your go-to source for foolproof recipes, kitchen tips, and reviews of the best kitchen equipment and supermarket ingredients. Download our free app and select the issue you’d like to buy, or subscribe
bluejetty:00123397:ios.description:
The Cook’s Illustrated Magazine app is your go-to source for foolproof recipes, kitchen tips, and reviews of the best kitchen equipment and supermarket ingredients. Download our free app and select the issue you’d like to buy, or subscribe to receive each new issue as it is released and save 52% off the single issue price. 
Each issue of Cook’s Illustrated magazine on this app features everything found in the print issue – every recipe, every kitchen quick tip, every equipment review, and every ingredient taste test, all without a single page of advertising so you get unbiased information on every page. In addition, each app issue includes additional app-only features to help guarantee foolproof results in the kitchen, including: 
•Recipe videos for EVERY article which walks you through each recipe’s critical steps 
•“Cooking Mode” Slide Shows – large step-by-step color photos showing you the critical aspects of each recipe, designed to be easy to read and understand when you’re cooking in the kitchen 
•Expanded review charts for all equipment reviews and ingredient taste tests 
•Plus much more 
FEATURED IN EVERY ISSUE 
•Foolproof recipes for everything from appetizers and side dishes to entrees and desserts 
•Step-by-step illustrations that demonstrate the right way to prepare a recipe 
•Quick Tips for everything from no-mess tomato chopping to sting-free seeding of hot peppers 
•Unbiased reviews of cookware, gadgets, and supermarket ingredients 
•Not a single page of advertising! 
Cook’s Illustrated Magazine subscriptions available: 
-1-month subscription available for $1.99 (includes a 7-day Free Trial), automatically renewed until canceled
-1-year subscription available for $19.99 (includes a 30-day Free Trial), automatically renewed until canceled 
-A single issue for $6.99 (non-subscription) 
All subscriptions start at the end of the applicable free trial period. Payment for your purchase will be charged to your iTunes account after your free trial period. Your subscription will auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renewal from your iTunes account at least 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period. No cancellation of the current issue is allowed during an active subscription period. Free trials are only available upon an initial subscription. 
Please view our Terms of Use: https://www.americastestkitchen.com/corporate-pages/terms-of-use
And our Privacy Policy: https://www.americastestkitchen.com/corporate-pages/privacy-policy
About Cook’s Illustrated 
Cook’s Illustrated, launched in 1993, is located just outside Boston where a team of more than three dozen test cooks, editors, and cookware specialists work in a 2,500-square-foot test kitchen. Our mission is to test recipes over and over again until we understand how and why they work and until we arrive at the “best” version of a particular recipe. The result, we hope, is the best version of a particular recipe, but we realize that only you can be the final judge of our success (or failure). As we like to say in the test kitchen, “We make the mistakes so you don’t have to.” 
Along with developing recipes, our test kitchen team exhaustively tests kitchen equipment and does blind tastings of supermarket ingredients to tell home cooks which brands to buy…and which to avoid. More than one million Cook’s Illustrated readers rely on Cook’s Illustrated reviews to make smarter decisions about which cooking products and ingredient brands to buy. 
Cook’s Illustrated recipes, testings, and tastings can be found in Cook’s Illustrated magazine and cookbooks, online at CooksIllustrated.com, or featured on our public television show, America’s Test Kitchen.

bluejetty:00132282:ios.description:
Welcome. You’ve found FictIf, a stunning collection of interactive, inclusive visual novels where you make the decisions.
With exciting, adventure-filled episodes full of romance and mystery, you choose your own story. Your decisions change the path you take and the story you experience.
What path will you take?
WHY PEOPLE LOVE FICTIF
• Explore collections of immersive, interactive romance stories in different genres, realities, and with various character types.
• The stories you play are inclusive – choose your pronouns!
• Your choices can influence your interactive story experience
• Go on an adventure, travel to new worlds, fall in love, solve a murder mystery
• Choose from multiple romance partners
• Enjoy each story with individual and original art.
YOUR STORYBOOK
FOR THE LOVE OF GODS - The City in the Sky of Eonia has selected you to become their pantheon’s Deity of Love. But first, you must complete four grueling trials by order of the Oracle. Luckily, six romanceable immortals are there to help you, and sometimes distract you... Pass Eonia’s trials of Physicality, Intellect, and virtue, to face your destiny and win eternal life in paradise.
LAST LEGACY - You are magically transported to a fantasy land full of new characters and dangerous places. Join a group of elite warriors as you try to save the world and find your way home, and who knows, maybe you will also find love along the way - who will you choose to follow?
TWO AGAINST THE WORLD – As soon as you step inside the theater, you find yourself literally transported into a 1920's Gatsby Era with a gorgeous gangster that offers you adventure and the love you always wanted. Can the glitz and glamour, and the arms of a loving man win you over?
ROADKILL - When wishes come true, it can lead to bliss, or in this case... disaster. As a monster apocalypse threatens to destroy the world, you have your chance to find true love. Road trip across the country with your friends to live out your dreams by any means possible.
HEIR TO LOVE & LIES - Mysterious circumstances surround the death of your grandmother. As you start to uncover the truth, you, as the sole heir to her fortune are threatened, and need to decide who you can trust - a charming lawyer, a seductive cop, or a smoldering laborer. Will one of these people turn out to be the killer or will you find your true love?
We love your feedback and pay close attention to what our community says so if you have any requests or feedback - please let us know!
Your story. Your choices. Your adventure. Now's the time to embark on your journey.
Minimum Specs for iOS:
iOS 9.0 or above
iPhone 5s or newer
iPad Air 3rd generation or newer
iPad mini 5th generation or newer
iPad Pro
iPad 8th generation or newer

Yakima Federal Savings and Loan Mobile Banking.

Wit
bluejetty:00018514:ios.description:
Yakima Federal Savings and Loan Mobile Banking.
Online banking on your iPhone or iPad is better with our app. The Yakima Federal Savings and Loan mobile app provides an online banking experience specially designed for your iOS device.
With the app you can:
• Use Apple’s TouchID and FaceID for password-free logins.
 - Selected services inside mobile banking may prompt for password entry as an extra security measure.
• Review your balance and transaction history.
• Optional Instant Balance feature allows quick access to account balances without having to log in.
• Transfer funds between eligible accounts you have with Yakima Federal Savings and Loan.
• Deposit checks with the mobile deposit feature.
- Account eligibility, check suitability, and transaction limits apply.
• Activate and receive account alerts.
• Conduct external transfers from and to accounts held at other institutions.
 - Requires registration for external transfer service through main online banking site.
 - Account eligibility and transaction limits apply.
 - Fees may apply.
• Make regular payments to your mortgage loan from Yakima Federal deposit accounts.
• Pay utilities and common household billers with your already established CheckFree® online bill pay profile.
- Requires registration for CheckFree® bill pay service through main online banking site.
 - Account eligibility and registration verification requirements apply.
 - CheckFree® bill pay may not be appropriate for all billers, contact us for more details.
• Locate ATMs and Yakima Federal Savings and Loan branch locations.
• Find our hours of operation and telephone numbers for our branches.
Yakima Federal Savings and Loan Mobile Banking is available to all Yakima Federal Savings and Loan household or personal banking clients who are already enrolled in Online Banking.
If you have not registered for online banking, you may do so using the enrollment link that is present on the login screen of the app.
If you are not a customer, please contact us at https://www.yakimafed.com/about/convenient-locations-2/ or call us at 800-331-3225 during our normal office hours, 9a-5p, M-F for additional information.
* Every mobile service carrier has a different rate plan for text messaging and data services access. You may be charged per use or pay a flat rate for unlimited usage each month. You may also have different fees for text messaging and data services access. Please contact your mobile carrier directly if you aren’t sure what fees you will be charged for using our mobile banking and text messaging services.

bluejetty:00044110:ios.description:
Clearya: Nontoxic Shopping Made Easy!
Discover safer, nontoxic products with Clearya – your ultimate shopping companion for online and in-store purchases.
Key Features:
1. Easily shop online at Amazon, Target, Sephora, iHerb, and Walmart with confidence, knowing the safety of the product ingredients before buying.
2. Analyze product labels using your phone's camera too, for in-store shopping and at-home product checks.
3. Automatic alerts on potential health risks hidden in ingredients lists for beauty, personal care, baby care, cleaning products, and more.
4. Find safe, vetted alternatives to products containing toxic ingredients.
5. Based on official toxic chemical databases from the U.S., Canada, EU, Japan, and more.
6. Alerts for thousands of known and suspected carcinogens (may cause cancer), hormone disruptors (endocrine disruption), reproduction toxicants (may harm fertility), developmental toxicants (may cause birth defects and other harm to the developing child), allergens, and other banned or restricted ingredients.
7. Free, unbiased, and ad-free, funded by donations.
8. Privacy-focused – no collection of personal user information.
Shop smarter and healthier with Clearya, the app that empowers you to make informed choices and avoid harmful chemicals in everyday products.
Contact Us:
We'd love to hear your feedback! Reach out at hello@clearya.com.

bluejetty:00023628:ios.description:
Transform Your Videos with Video Editor – The Ultimate Video Editing Experience!
Are you ready to elevate your video content to the next level? Whether you’re an aspiring influencer, a social media enthusiast, or just someone who loves creating memorable videos, Video Editor is here to turn your vision into reality. Packed with powerful features and intuitive tools, our app is designed to make professional video editing accessible and fun. Download now and discover the endless possibilities!
Key Features:
Seamless Clip Merging
Combine multiple clips effortlessly into one smooth video. Create stunning montages, highlight reels, or just piece together your favorite moments with our easy-to-use merging tool.
Add Music & Audio Effects
Enhance your videos with a vast library of music tracks and sound effects. Adjust the volume, add audio effects, and sync your soundtrack perfectly with your visuals to create a captivating experience.
Social Media-Ready Orientations
Get your content noticed across all platforms! Change your video orientation to fit Instagram Stories, YouTube, or any other social media format with just a few taps.
Customize with Text, Stickers, & Media
Express yourself with customizable text overlays, trendy stickers, and additional media. Personalize your videos to reflect your style and make your content stand out.
Professional Color Grading & Adjustments
Bring your footage to life with advanced color grading tools. Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and more to give your videos a cinematic look.
Green Screen Magic
Take your creativity to new heights with our green screen feature. Easily replace backgrounds, add exciting new elements, and transport your videos to any setting you imagine.
Precision Trimming & Splitting
Trim and split your clips with precision. Remove unwanted sections, focus on key moments, and seamlessly edit your footage to get the perfect cut every time.
Speed Control & Opacity Adjustments
Play with speed effects to create dramatic slow-motion or fast-paced sequences. Adjust the opacity to blend scenes or highlight key elements in your video.
Stunning Blur Effects
Add depth and focus to your videos with our blur effects. Create professional-looking bokeh backgrounds or emphasize specific areas with customizable blur.
Instagram Stories & YouTube Templates
Save time and effort with our pre-designed templates for Instagram Stories and YouTube. Easily add text, media, and effects to make your posts look polished and engaging.
Why Choose Video Editor?
 - User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a sleek and intuitive design that makes video editing a breeze, even if you’re a beginner.
 - High-Quality Output: Export your videos in stunning HD quality, ensuring they look their best on any device or platform.
 - Regular Updates: We’re always adding new features and improvements to keep your editing experience fresh and exciting.
 - Community Support: Join our vibrant community of creators. Share tips, get inspiration, and connect with fellow video enthusiasts.
Subscription Details:
Video Editor by MK offers premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
For more details on managing subscriptions, visit: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://videoeditor.mkapps.app/VideoEditorMK/terms/privacy
Terms of Use: https://videoeditor.mkapps.app/VideoEditorMK/terms/terms

Download Video Editor now and unlock your creative potential! Transform your raw footage into polished masterpieces with just a few taps. Your next viral video is just a download away!

bluejetty:00061304:ios.description:
HVG – Minden, ami számít. Egy helyen.
A HVG hivatalos alkalmazása teljesen megújult, hogy még gyorsabban, kényelmesebben és személyre szabottabban olvashasd a legfontosabb híreket, véleményeket és elemzéseket. Maradj naprakész a hazai és nemzetközi történésekben – gazdaság, politika, közélet, kultúra, technológia, életmód: minden egy helyen, közérthetően és hitelesen.

bluejetty:00169525:ios.name: Slowly: Make Global Friends
bluejetty:00169525:ios.summary:
Slowly: Build Authentic Friendships at Your Own Pace
"In a world dominated by instant messaging, meaningful connections have become a rare luxury."
Slowly reimagines the art of correspondence, offering a unique way to make friends. Connec
bluejetty:00169525:ios.description:
Slowly: Build Authentic Friendships at Your Own Pace
"In a world dominated by instant messaging, meaningful connections have become a rare luxury."
Slowly reimagines the art of correspondence, offering a unique way to make friends. Connect with penpals around the world and explore the beauty of cultural and linguistic exchange through thoughtfully written letters. Rediscover the joy of anticipation and dive into heartfelt, written conversations.
Designed for those who prefer to take their time and focus on genuine connections, Slowly brings back the charm of traditional penpals. Each letter takes time to arrive—anywhere from a few hours to a few days—depending on the distance between you and your new friend. Whether you’re looking for foreign friends, a language exchange partner, or simply a quiet space to write a meaningful letter, Slowly is here for you.
Key Features:
► Distance-Based Letter Delivery
Each letter travels at a speed that reflects the physical distance between you and your friend, creating a sense of anticipation. With no pressure to respond instantly, you have time to reflect, compose your thoughts, and share your story. This slower pace nurtures deeper and more meaningful connections.
► Collect Over 2,000 Unique Stamps
Turn every letter into an adventure by collecting unique regional stamps from across the globe. These stamps add a personal and cultural touch to your correspondence, serving as reminders of the friendships you create.
► A Safe and Secure Space for Everyone
No photos, no real names—just your thoughts, shared in a secure and stress-free environment. Whether you're an introvert looking for deeper conversations or someone who values privacy, Slowly offers a safe place to express yourself and connect authentically.
► Unlimited Letters, Always Free
Enjoy the art of writing without limits—send and receive as many letters as you like, completely free. Optional premium features are available to enhance your experience and meet your unique needs.
Who Is Slowly For?
- Anyone looking to make friends at their own pace, free from the rush of instant communication.
- Language learners seeking partners for meaningful language exchange.
- People who love writing letters and want to explore different cultures.
- Introverts and thoughtful individuals who prefer calm, meaningful interactions.
- Anyone hoping to meet new friends from all over the world.
Slowly: Authentic Friendships, at Your Speed.
Whether you’re looking to reconnect with the joy of letter writing, discover new perspectives, or simply build friendships that matter, Slowly is your perfect companion for creating meaningful connections in a fast-paced world.
Terms of Service:
https://slowly.app/terms/

bluejetty:00129043:ios.description:
What stops you from achieving goals or becoming who you want to be?
Build your self-improvement program to develop the motivation and the positive mindset you need to succeed, using positive affirmations in the most effective way.
Our mindset and thoughts enormously impact self-esteem, health, prosperity, and happiness. Positive affirmations and self-talk are simple and proven techniques recommended by therapists, life coaches, and personal development gurus to make our minds work for us.
FIND INSPIRATION
Select affirmations from an expert-approved list or use them as inspiration and create your own.
PERSONALIZE YOUR AFFIRMATIONS
Record in the voice your brain truly trusts and understands, your own.
Add an image that inspires you.
ADD MUSIC
Inspiring music makes your affirmations meditation enjoyable and relaxing.
SET NOTIFICATIONS AND LISTEN DAILY
Develop new, positive thoughts and reduce negative self-talk.
MANIFEST
Manifest your dreams into reality.
300+ AFFIRMATIONS FOR 10+ LIFE GOALS 
Motivation, Self-Esteem, Overcome Depression, Self-Talk to deal with Anxiety, New Career, Relationships, Stress Relief, Achieve Goals, Pray with Joel Osteen, Miracle Morning with Hal Elrod, Mental Toughness, Fitness Motivation, and affirmations by top personal development experts and coaches. 
TRACK YOUR PRACTICE with HEALTH APP
Connect ThinkUp to the Apple Health app and track the duration of your daily practice through the Mindful Minutes metric. You can also track the number of positive thoughts/affirmations you've listened to during your daily practices. Tracking this metric is important, as it trains your brain to focus on positive thoughts throughout the day when you don't practice actively.
Our mind is the key to a good, happy, and prosperous life. 
A wellness app that speaks to you... Literally.
BEST PRACTICE TIPS
- Select at least 15 affirmations
- While recording your affirmations, mean it!
- Play your affirmations in a loop for 5 minutes, at least once a day before going to sleep. Morning practice is recommended as well for daily motivation 
- Listen to the same set of affirmations for at least 21 days. Repetition makes all the difference!
- Use headphones
FREE VS. PREMIUM
The free version allows you to build a short version of the program; record up to three affirmations and use one default background music. You may change the affirmations any time and record again
PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP DETAILS
When you purchase one of the two available premium membership plans, you get unlimited access to all the premium features for a period stated in the plan details. The features are: add and record an unlimited number of affirmations, the per affirmation recording is longer, change background music, set an auto-stop timer, control volume.

1. MONTHLY: $7.99 billed every month

These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary.

Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to ThinkUp.
In-app purchase is NOT shareable with Family Sharing

bluejetty:00092617:ios.name: Clara: Credit Card & Platform
bluejetty:00092617:ios.summary:
Clara is the all-in-one financial platform for modern companies seeking financial efficiency and control.
Manage expenses, issue Mastercard-backed physical and virtual credit cards, approve reimbursements, automate accounting, and make pay
bluejetty:00092617:ios.description:
Clara is the all-in-one financial platform for modern companies seeking financial efficiency and control.
Manage expenses, issue Mastercard-backed physical and virtual credit cards, approve reimbursements, automate accounting, and make payments from a single 100% digital platform
Corporate Credit Card
Issue cards in seconds with rules by employee, project, date, time, or category. View transactions in real time, with full traceability and instant blocking. Clara Black includes benefits like travel assistance, purchase protection, and access to VIP lounges.
Expense and Reimbursement Management
Automate expense control with automatic categorization, review, and hierarchical approval. Organize receipts and generate ready-to-use reports for audits, budgeting, or reconciliation.
International Payments
Send payments abroad with no fees across multiple currencies. Access credit to fund your international operations, schedule transfers, and get real-time exchange rates. Managerscan approve, monitor, and reconcile everything from a centralized dashboard, optimizing your global expense control. Available only in Mexico.
Invoice Recovery
Forget about chasing your suppliers. Clara automatically retrieves invoices from your purchases and links them to each expense in real-time. From the app, managers can download receipts, validate tax information, and generate reports ready for reconciliation and audit without wasting time on manual tasks. Available only in Mexico.
Digital Account
Open and manage your digital account 100% online, with no monthly fees or hidden costs. Make payments, reimbursements, and transfers directly from the platform, securely and efficiently. Available only in Brazil.
Clara Intelligence: AI integrated into your operations
Thanks to artificial intelligence, Clara turns your data into smart decision-making. Receive alerts on unusual or duplicate spend patterns and ask complex questions like “Show me all restaurant expenses above our $100 limit,” “Give me recommendations where we can cut spend,” or “How much did our travel spend grow since last quarter?”. All directly with the AI copilot available in the platform.
ERP & API Integrations
Connect Clara to your accounting and management systems through an open API. Automate imports, reconciliations, and receipt validation. Compatible with platforms like SAP, Oracle Netsuite, Zoho, and others.
Rewards Program
Earn points onevery purchase and redeem them for products, credit, or invoice discounts, all managed from the app with no extra costs. Points can also be redeemed for Lifemiles. Available only in Colombia.
Multi-Entity & Granular Access Control
Manage multiple business entities and assign user-level permissions by area or role. Ideal for corporate groups, holding companies, or accounting firms.
Financed SPEI Transfers: Make instant transfers to any account through SPEI using your Clara credit line. Optimize cash flow by deferring payments without disrupting your daily operations, with tracking, reconciliation, and ready-to-use reports in one centralized dashboard.
Download the app and discover a new way to take control of your company’s expenses.New: Check the review expense status of your card transactions directly from the transaction list and detail view.

bluejetty:00177358:ios.description:
Swap and match gems on thousands of match-3 puzzle levels to collect resources and help Pharaoh restore a ruined civilization with its majestic pyramids, temples, palaces and obelisks!
Travel back to ancient times in Jewels of Egypt®, an amazing free match-3 game! A settlement on the Nile Delta needs your help to be brought back to its former glory in times of the Egyptian Empire. Play thousands of match-3 games, solve challenging match-3 puzzles and rebuild this ravaged but once-beautiful area into the treasure of the New Kingdom!
This game is a unique and epic blend of city building and match-3 puzzles, tied together with a storyline full of court intrigues, cunning plans and historical events worthy of Nefertiti, in the colorful and vibrant setting of Ancient Egypt. You’re an ambitious third-generation architect who is searching for your sister after her mysterious disappearance. Help the determined citizens revive their community after devastating attacks by the power-mad Irsu and his wily retinue. Then establish a link between your family and magical antiquities to enthrone the right person. Makeover a fertile ground, find your missing sister and keep a powerful artifact away from evil forces to ensure that fortune favors your settlers once again!
● PLAY through a unique combination of addictive match-3 and city building in one game
● GO on an adventure filled with the history, tales, and myths of Ancient Egypt
● MEET the Pharaoh and his nobles, priests, soldiers, scribes, merchants and farmers on your way to prosperity
● MASTER thousands of unique match-3 levels
● WIELD incredible boosters and power-up combos
● UNLOCK a variety of historical buildings and landmarks to rebuild and upgrade in this free match three game
● FOLLOW your friends’ progress with the innovative built-in social network
While this match-3 offline game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.

bluejetty:00098748:ios.summary:
Takashi – The Ultimate 3D Shadow Ninja RPG!
Takashi Ninja Warrior is an exciting 3D action role playing game that lets you live the life of a brave shadow ninja. You play as Takashi, a skilled warrior fighting to bring peace back to his lan
bluejetty:00098748:ios.description:
Takashi – The Ultimate 3D Shadow Ninja RPG!
Takashi Ninja Warrior is an exciting 3D action role playing game that lets you live the life of a brave shadow ninja. You play as Takashi, a skilled warrior fighting to bring peace back to his land. 
In this offline RPG, you’ll explore a dangerous world filled with samurai, assassins, and shadow fighters, where every battle tests your strength, speed, and courage. With realistic 3D graphics, smooth sword fighting moves, and a powerful story, this game takes ninja combat to the next level.
Enter a dark world of shadows and warriors!
The Story
The peaceful land of Kurome has fallen into chaos under Emperor Kanna, a cruel ruler who spreads war and dark magic. His army destroys villages and fills the land with fear. But one man refuses to give up - Takashi, a lone ninja trained to fight in the shadows. Armed with his legendary sword, he must defeat powerful enemies, face deadly bosses, and bring light back to his kingdom.
Do you have the skills to become the ultimate ninja warrior?
Explore the Epic Open World
Travel across stunning 3D locations, from burning villages and ancient temples to mystical forests and hidden dungeons. Every place is full of secrets, enemies, and treasures. Unlock new powers, upgrade your weapons, and use stealth to take down enemies silently.
Takashi Ninja Warrior isn’t just about fighting, it’s about skill and strategy. You’ll need to:
- Master fast sword battles
- Dodge and counterattack perfectly
- Perform stealth assassinations
- Defeat tough boss warriors with smart tactics
Beware of the Emperor’s elite samurai, who defend with powerful shields. Only by finding their weak spots can you win.
Key Features
- Intense sword fighting action
- Huge semi open world adventure
- Offline play, no WiFi needed
- Sneak attacks and stealth kills
- Epic boss battles and dark enemies
- Upgrade weapons, armor, and skills
- Deep RPG gameplay and character customization
- Inspired by classics like Ninja and Shadow Fighting games.
Play Anytime, Anywhere
No internet? No problem! Takashi Ninja Warrior lets you enjoy a full action RPG adventure completely offline. Fight, explore, and level up your ninja wherever you are.
Become Takashi, the shadow warrior who will save Kurome from darkness.
Download now and prove you are the true ninja legend!

bluejetty:00184012:ios.description:
Fusion Credit Union Mobile App lets you do your banking whenever you want, wherever you want. Check your balance, pay a bill, transfer funds and more. You get a quick, safe and convenient way to access your accounts while on the go.
Anytime, anywhere you can...
•View the balance of your account(s)
•Have immediate access to your account balance without logging in
•View your account history
•Make an immediate or scheduled bill payment
•View and manage scheduled bill payments or scheduled transfers
•Transfer funds between accounts
•Transfer funds to someone else via text or email by sending an INTERAC e-Transfer†
•Receive important messages about your account 
•View a list of Fusion Credit Union branch locations and ATM locations
When using the Fusion Credit Union Mobile App you get the same secure access that you receive when logged into Fusion Credit Union’s online banking. 
Using the app...
To use the app you simply sign in the same way you would sign in to your online banking. If you are not registered for online banking and would like to be registered please contact us using the contact information or by visiting one of our branch locations. Note: Prior to using the app you must have logged into online banking at least once and have set up your increased authentication (security features). 
Visit fusioncu.com to learn more...
The App is free to download. Mobile data downloading and internet charges may apply. Check with your provider for details.

bluejetty:00131860:ios.description:
Description. 
Get the latest trends and discover them from any location. If you love wearing fashion and using any occasion to buy clothes via the internet, download our MANGO app. Simple, easy and intuitive! 
Our most digital version features all the garments in the collection: women’s, men’s and children’s clothing. What’s more, through notifications you can discover the latest products, enjoy exclusive offers and stay up to date with the latest trends in online fashion. 
Choose your favourites with the app! Download it free and enjoy a unique experience in mobile format. 
Fashion on your mobile. 
Wherever you are, log on quickly to get your must-haves. Browse through the different collections featured, be inspired by the proposed outfits in each editorial and find what you are looking for by using the size, colour and price filters. Be inspired by all the proposals for the perfect shopping experience. 
Your online shopping bag can be accessed from any device. 
Whenever you log on to our online clothing app with your user ID and password, your items will be saved so that you can access them from any device. So, if you start filling your shopping bag from your Smartphone and later decide to continue shopping via your Tablet, the items will be synchronised, allowing you to finalise your order whenever and however you want.
