The Cultivator look up at the starry sky, mysterious Qi appeared in his spiritual sense...
That enlightened him on the next day, he was surprised to find that his abode has a special place, and his home has appeared. 
It so happens that there is no fixed place for cultivating immortals, so he built a home to help immortals...
Feng Shui is particularly good, there are full of bonuses.
【Game Features】
Infinite Cultivation is a fantastic social Idle game about cultivation, where you can alchemy, plant trees, build and decorate your home. All the friends of the game are talented and enthusiastic, we invite you to enter the path of immortality! let's enjoy the cultivation life together!
1. Casual&Idle
You can get a lot of cultivation and resources by hanging, and the operation is also simple and convenient, use your small pockets of time and play more easily!
2. Tribulation&Ascend
The path of cultivation is against the nature, break through the self and challenge the inner demons! The heavenly tribulation, thunder drowning, let you experience an extraordinary life. It says, to be free from the shackles of the body and to soar freely between heaven and earth is the meaning of cultivation.
3. Treasure&Alchemy
The world of immortality cultivation is full of great treasures. Here you can pick herbs, dig spirit mines, refine elixirs and forge divine weapons. Make the path of immortality cultivation easier by your efforts
4. Sects&KungFu skills
The martial arts world is ever-changing.There are many sects with thousands of skills, and you can join more than just one sect. Here you can leave one of them at any time, and join a new one to learn the strengths of a hundred sects. Even more create your own skills.
5. Fortune&Adventure
How can the path of cultivation be without chance? There are all kinds of strange encounters and relics to be explored; you can meet immortals to show you the way, and meet valuable people to help you. Unthinkable opportunities await you!
6. Partner&Pet
Immortal, demon and Taoist, experience the love of immortality and find your partner for life. Enjoy your cultivation path! At the same time, you can also tame spirit animals and ride them around the universe.

bluejetty:00030408:ios.summary:
SleepHQ - Your Ultimate CPAP Therapy and Sleep Tracking Companion

bluejetty:00030408:ios.description:
SleepHQ - Your Ultimate CPAP Therapy and Sleep Tracking Companion
Experience the future of sleep management with SleepHQ, your all-in-one solution for CPAP therapy and sleep tracking. Whether you're a seasoned CPAP user or just starting your journey towards better sleep, SleepHQ empowers you to take control of your sleep and live a healthier, more energized life. SleepHQ offers a comprehensive suite of tools to improve your sleep quality, track your progress, and make managing your therapy a dream (excuse the pun!).
Key Features:
Intelligent CPAP Therapy Monitoring:
• Navigate your charts effortlessly with a user-friendly dashboard that provides a holistic view of your sleep and therapy data.
• Track your AHI (apnea-hypopnea index), mask fit, usage compliance and more to ensure comfortable & effective therapy.
Breath-by-Breath Analysis
• Gain valuable insights into your sleep breathing. Identify instances of snoring, interruptions, or apnea events, helping you better understand your sleep health.
• Pan through the night and discover how your breathing changes during different sleep stages. Zoom to analyse airflow limitation and respiratory arousals 
Sleep Journal:
• Keep a detailed sleep journal to record your sleep experiences, habits, and any lifestyle factors that might affect your therapy & breathing patterns. 
• Track your feelings with fun emojis & create custom flags to track improvements and trends.
Sleep Trends:
• Dive into detailed sleep & CPAP therapy trends to gain a deeper understanding of your sleep quality and take steps to improve it.
• Track your CPAP Therapy changes and their impact on your AHI & sleep quality.
Integration with Wearables:
• Connect SleepHQ with Apple Health and unlock a world of sleep-tracking possibilities. Apple Watch, Oura Ring & Withings Sleep Matt are just some devices that sync sleep data.
• The SleepHQ O2 Ring seamlessly connects to your smartphone via Bluetooth, providing O2 levels & pulse rate readings. Identify episodes of low oxygen, a potential indicator of sleep apnea or other health concerns and set personalised alerts to receive notifications for specific oxygen & pulse rate level events, ensuring you're aware of any changes that may affect your sleep health.
Direct File Uploads
Seamlessly upload your CPAP data directly to the app using an On The Go (OTG) card reader. 
With this feature, users simply connect their CPAP machine's SD card to their smartphone or tablet using an OTG card reader and select the SD card files for upload. 
This integration is particularly beneficial for users who need to regularly monitor and share their CPAP data with healthcare providers. Moreover, this feature empowers users to take a more active role in their sleep health management. By having immediate access to their CPAP data, users can make informed decisions about their sleep habits and CPAP therapy, leading to better health outcomes and improved quality of life. 
Sharing is Caring:
• Conveniently & securely share your data with anyone you choose via sharelinks. No personally identifiable information is shared making sharelinks perfect for forums or social media groups. 
• Easily deactivate sharelinks when not in use. 
Magic Uploader - (Available for ResMed devices)
• Connect to your home wifi and automatically syncs your complete CPAP data with SleepHQ every 10 minutes. No manual SD card uploads required.
Data Security and Privacy:
• Data security is a core pillar of SleepHQ. Our data centres are secured with digital and physical protections compliant with the latest industry standards. 
• Your sleep breathing data is treated with the utmost care for your privacy and security. SleepHQ ensures that your personal information remains confidential.
Download SleepHQ now and experience the difference it can make in your sleep quality and CPAP therapy journey. Say goodbye to restless nights and hello to a better you with SleepHQ

bluejetty:00130892:ios.description:
Attention, Warriors! Yoko ZEN, a charismatic expert of kung fu, gets ready to show his incredible skills. He steps into the competition of champions to claim the title of the greatest martial artist in the world. Along the way, he fights tough opponents, aiming to prove himself in the premier fighting tournament on earth! Are you ready to etch your name into the history of the kung fu karate game?
Join exciting contests in a mesmerizing world of Karate Legends - Boxing Game 3D! The fight begins now!
-- Countless Zones of Hardship --
Experience an epic kung fu fighting game. Explore 12 diverse zones with ever-changing weather conditions including snow, rain, autumn, tornado, and sandstorm.
► ANCIENT RUINS: Step into ancient temples and tombs, where echoes of legendary battles resound in this exhilarating action game!
► BLOSSOM ENERGY: Enjoy the serenity of blooming cherry blossoms while engaging in fast-paced combat moves.
► WRATH OF SHORE: Battle on rugged coastlines, where crashing waves set the rhythm for an intense showdown.
► GLADIATORS ARENA: Enter the champion's arena of kung fu games, and test your strength and skill against the mightiest warriors.
► FROSTBORNE BRAWL HAVEN: Take on the icy challenge of a frozen wasteland. Every step is risky, every strike sharp as frost.
► HARMONY PAVILION: Experience graceful combat with precision in a serene haven.
► MARITIME CLASH ARENA: Master thrilling fights with an exhilarating maritime showdown.
► SANDS OF VALOR: Brave the scorching desert sands, where the constant heat fosters endurance and determination.
► VERDANT ROCK ARENA: Traverse lush landscapes with towering rocks, encountering new adventures.
► STEEL ENCLOSURE BATTLEGROUND: A fortress of steel and stone where thrilling sword clashes and intense battles await!
► NAUTICAL COMBAT: Engage in thrilling naval fights, navigating stormy seas as you compete against rivals.
► POLAR MIDNIGHT RUMBLE: Experience the intense battles in the icy depths where darkness reigns.
-- CHOOSE YOUR HERO --
A diverse roster of 17 skilled fighters in boxing game, each with their own unique abilities and fighting styles. But beware, your nemesis awaits, ready to challenge you. Select wisely - Whether it's the speed of Jinzo, the strength of Raijin, or the finesse of Mei Leing.
-- Fighters with Unique Abilities --
► ZEPHYR throws fireballs at his rivals and attacks with rapid karate kicks, showcasing his speed and agility.
► YENNEFER freezes opponents with a gesture and overwhelms them with magical attacks.
► HIROSHI delivers bone-shattering blows with his super power punch and unleashes his Roundhouse Strike combo with devastating force.
► ERIC grabs & spins his adversaries and slams them to the ground and constantly attacks with his combos.
► GUT FIGHTER strikes rivals with eye laser precision and his piercing blade showcases lightning-fast swordplay.
Key Tips for Karate Legends: Fighting Game
► Apply Judo throws, joint locks, & takedowns to defeat your foes
► Opponents dynamically adjust to match your skill level
► Defeat the enemy bosses in each zone to become the karate champion!
► Use boxing punches, taekwondo kicks, blocking and grappling techniques in karate game 3d.
► Track your fighter's progress with Karate Legends profiles
► Increase your fighting spirit with realistic sound and visual effects
► Level up, unlock new skills, and collect daily rewards
Now, DO NOT look back, Ignite your skills and rise to the top!

bluejetty:00122485:ios.name: Ballet Crypto: Cold Storage
bluejetty:00122485:ios.summary:
Ballet Crypto is an app that acts as a companion to your Ballet product, allowing you to manage your cryptocurrencies, check their market value and add additional ones to your cold storage.

bluejetty:00122485:ios.description:
Ballet Crypto is an app that acts as a companion to your Ballet product, allowing you to manage your cryptocurrencies, check their market value and add additional ones to your cold storage.
Features
*No Account Registration
Scan the QR code on your Ballet product to start using the app. There is no need to register an account or go through KYC procedures.
*Real-Time Market Value
The app allows Ballet cold storage customers to check the market value of their assets in real time.
*Privacy Guaranteed
The app does not store your cold storage’s private keys. It also does not track, store or transmit your personal or financial data outside the app.
*Open-Source Industry Standard
Ballet cold storage and the Ballet Crypto app use the open-source BIP38 protocol.
Functions
*Deposit and send crypto.
The Ballet Crypto app allows you to easily deposit, send and manage your cryptocurrency accounts, with safe and efficient processing of transactions. Simply follow the on-screen instructions - no hassle, no confusion.
*Activate multicurrency.
The app allows you to activate use of multiple cryptocurrencies on your Ballet product, allowing you to deposit, store, and send more than 50 kinds of cryptocurrencies. Please note: some cryptocurrency activations may require an additional fee.
*Transfer assets.
Customers can transfer assets from one Ballet cold storage to another using just one tap.
*Import crypto.
The app allows you to easily import all of the most common private key formats to your Ballet cold storage, including mnemonic words (BIP39 / BIP44 / BIP49 / BIP84 backup seed), WIF, Minikey, BIP38 and others.

The AERO Mobile Banking App makes it easy and convenient to manage your finances – wherever you are!
Manage Your Accounts and Finances
• Check balances and activity quickly in your checking and savings accounts
• View and manage your mortgage, auto loan, or credit card accounts
• Set app alerts to get notified about balances and transactions
Security
• Log in securely with biometrics
• Mobile Banking uses a verification code so you can authenticate via text message or a voice call
Mobile Deposit
• No more waiting in line, or driving to a branch
• Deposit a check right from your mobile device, with just a photo
Move Money
• Transfer funds between AERO accounts, or even to another AERO member
• Set up payments to your AERO loan directly from another financial institution
• Use Zelle to pay people quickly and easily
Mobile Bill Pay
• Pay bills to existing payees, or add new payees.
• Edit or delete payees
• Sign up, view, pay, and manage your eBills
• Schedule automatic and recurring payments
• View payee history
• Add a memo
Contact Us
• Find branches and ATM locations
• Contact the Member Services team

bluejetty:00121629:ios.description:
MARVEL Puzzle Quest: Hero RPG
Collect and battle with over 250 Marvel champions in this epic Match 3 RPG game!
MARVEL Puzzle Quest is the original match-3 Super Hero Game! Compete with a community of over 20 million players worldwide and play as over 250 of your favorite Marvel Super Heroes in this battle role-playing game (RPG) featuring a unique match-3 puzzle twist!
Gather your favorite Marvel characters and clash in exclusive MARVEL Puzzle Quest campaigns, complete daily quests, and engage with epic event stories! Draft your own dream team from the largest mobile Marvel character roster to date! Take your pick from the most valiant Super Heroes to the most villainous baddies! You can mix and combine your teams however you want. Spider-Man, Captain Marvel, and Squirrel Girl? Of course! Black Panther, Gamora, and Deadpool? Let’s go!
MPQ FEATURES
● Collect and upgrade your favorite Marvel Super Heroes and Villains!
● Battle in epic match-3 puzzle RPG gameplay!
● Log in daily for rewards with S.H.I.E.L.D. Resupply and for new and exciting challenges!
● Level up your match-3 skills with Puzzle Ops and take on challenging skill-based puzzles! Each puzzle comes with different clear requirements so every board is unique!
● Form Alliances and assemble teams to fight opponents in PvP Tournaments and battle epic raid bosses!
THE ORIGINAL MARVEL MATCH 3 GAME!
This is a battle! Match-3 or more tiles and harness the power of Iso-8 to build up your team’s abilities and manipulate the game board to challenge the most powerful characters from across the Marvel universe. Trap your opponents and bring forth crushing evidence with JESSICA JONES! Use BURST HEALING with KAMALA KHAN to keep up team morale! COUNTDOWN to destruction with powerful timed gems from CAPTAIN MARVEL! Go AIRBORNE and rain destruction on your enemies via VULTURE! Pelt your enemies with a hailstorm of ATTACK TILES powered by STORM! 
RECRUIT MARVEL'S BEST HEROES AND VILLAINS
Recruit teams of three from over 250 of your favorite Super Heroes and Super Villains from the X-Men, Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy, Eternals, Inhumans, and even some MARVEL Puzzle Quest originals! Each character features their own in-game Marvel comic book cover! Crack the multiverse and play with alternate versions of your favorite heroes! Slash your foes with Samurai Wolverine or take up the shield with Peggy Carter as Captain America. The multiverse of possibilities is massive!
New characters are being added to MARVEL Puzzle Quest consistently. Recruit Moon Knight, Miles Morales, Black Widow, Loki, Thanos, Scarlet Witch, America Chavez, Captain America, and more! You can even collect Limited Edition characters like Spider-Ham, Devil Dinosaur, and Howard the Duck to add to the fun!
PLAY MARVEL PUZZLE QUEST TO UNLEASH YOUR INNER SUPER HERO AND JOIN THE MARVEL UNIVERSE!

■ Follow us on Twitter: www.twitter.com/MARVELPuzzle
■ Follow us on Instagram: www.instagram.com/MARVELPuzzleQuest
■ Follow us on Discord: https://mpq.social/discord
■ Subscribe on YouTube: www.youtube.com/MARVELPuzzleQuestGame
Developed by Broken Circle Studios

BOOK
bluejetty:00022475:ios.description:
The Copa Airlines app, your travel companion.
Welcome to our mobile app, where we provide you with an enhanced and streamlined travel experience, with quick access to your flight details.
Here are some of the features you can enjoy:
BOOKING
Easily search for and book your next trip through our redesigned booking flow. Once your reservation is completed, your trip will automatically be added to the My Trips section.
MY TRIPS
Keep track of your upcoming trips, view all flight details and updates, and access useful features at the right time, such as:
• Seat selection and purchase
• Check-In
• Baggage allowance
• Upgrade list
• Standby list
You can also complete traveler information in advance to speed up your check-in process, pay for reservations made with PriceLock, and request an upgrade to Business Class.
CHECK-IN
Save time at the airport in just a few steps by checking in from the comfort of your home. Access your boarding pass directly from the app whenever you need it.
CONNECTMILES
Sign in to your ConnectMiles account to view trips associated with your profile and check your bonus miles balance, status qualification progress for the next year, and recent activity. You can also quickly access your ConnectMiles card. If you are not yet a member, you can enroll directly through our app.
DISCOVER MUCH MORE
Other features available in our app include:
• Receive relevant notifications related to your trip.
• Check real-time flight status updates.
• Access our Information Center and Reservations Center.
• Explore the Entertainment page to read our digital magazine, Panorama de las Américas, or access the onboard entertainment section*.
*Onboard entertainment is only available on aircraft equipped with Copa Showpass.

bluejetty:00165979:ios.description:
Record confident videos without memorizing your script. Teleprompter Automatic keeps your text near the camera and scrolls it by voice, fixed speed, reading time, or words per minute. Record, rehearse, edit, add subtitles, or stream live—all from one app.
READ AT YOUR PACE
• Voice Scrolling listens to your speech and advances the script as you speak.
• Use Fixed Speed, set a total reading time with Timed Scrolling, or set your pace in words per minute.
• Adjust speed during your take, set a countdown, and mirror text horizontally or vertically.
• Customize fonts, size, color, alignment, line spacing, and the Reader’s size and position.
• Control scrolling and recording from Apple Watch, Web Remote, a paired keyboard, or a game controller.
RECORD, REHEARSE, OR GO LIVE
• Record video with the front or rear camera while reading directly from your screen.
• Capture audio-only sessions with microphone selection and a detailed playback waveform.
• Fine-tune supported camera options including resolution, frame rate, HDR, stabilization, zoom, filters, and microphone input.
• Use Practice mode for a private rehearsal, then decide whether to save or delete the recording.
• Stream from the Reader with platform presets, direct YouTube setup, or a custom RTMP/RTMPS connection.
BUILD A BETTER SCRIPT LIBRARY
• Write or paste text, import PDF, DOCX, and text files, or create a first draft with AI.
• Organize scripts in folders and personalize their formatting for easier reading.
• Sign in to sync your script and recording library with the cloud.
EDIT AND SHARE YOUR CONTENT
• Trim, rotate, resize, change speed, combine clips, and prepare videos for different aspect ratios.
• Add text, images, a logo, watermark, filters, or a blurred or replacement background.
• Generate subtitles from speech, translate them into another language, and customize their style and placement.
• Export your finished video or share audio recordings from the app.
From quick social videos and lessons to presentations, product demos, interviews, sermons, and live broadcasts, Teleprompter Automatic helps you keep eye contact and deliver every line with confidence.
Open your script, press record, and tell your story without losing your place.
Privacy Policy: https://teleprompter.pw/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://teleprompter.pw/terms/
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Simple tracking and insightful stats: Easily track an
bluejetty:00131188:ios.description:
Import your Goodreads data: We will import all of your currently-reading, read, to-read, and did-not-finish shelves. Any custom shelves will be mapped to a custom tag on The StoryGraph.
Simple tracking and insightful stats: Easily track and learn about your reading habits with our wide range of charts and graphs. See how your reading develops over time and use that to help you pick better books.
Get smart personalized recommendations: Our machine learning AI is like your trusted go-to friend for book recommendations. It'll understand your reading preferences and find the best books for you.
Discover books by mood: In the mood for something adventurous, funny, and fast-paced? What about a darker, slower, more emotional read? Mix and match our comprehensive set of filters to choose your next perfect book.
Read with friends: Add live reactions to specific parts of the book without fear of spoilers. Comments are locked for other participants until they reach that point in their reading. Don't have people to read with? We’ve got machine learning-powered suggestions for great reading buddies.
Reading Challenges: Want to read one book from every country in the world? Or how about read a book per week across a range of genres? Our reading challenges feature help you set up personal goals or join in with others.
Custom Tags: Enhance your book tracking and discovery by making use of our custom tags feature. You can search and filter books by your tags and share curated lists with friends.
Content Warnings: When you review a book, you can let us know if there's any content within it that might be triggering for others. Then, when searching for your next read, all of this information is at your disposal.
Features:
• Import your Goodreads account
• Sync with Kobo
• Reading charts and graphs
• Streaks
• Favorites
• Buddy reads
• Readalongs
• Book Clubs
• Personalized machine learning recommendations
• Follow your friends to see what they're reading
• Annual reading, page, and listening goals
• Search/browse books by mood, pace, and more
• Custom tags
• Lists to share with your friends or the public
• Create your own reading challenge or join in with others
• Dark Mode
• Barcode Scanner
• Giveaways
• Browse similar books
• Find similar users
• Half and quarter star ratings
• Built-in DNF (Did Not Finish) functionality (including tracking pages read)
• Progress updates with built-in reading journal
• Author-approved and user-submitted content warnings
Want to support an independent, Goodreads alternative? Consider upgrading to Plus!
• Keep the platform ad-free: You'll help The StoryGraph stay independent!
• Custom Charts: Create your own pie and bar charts.
• Extra Stats Filters: Filter down your stats to a custom time period, or view stats for your fiction or nonfiction reads, your custom tags, any particular mood or genre, and more.
• Custom Wrap-Up Graphics: Pick any custom date range and instantly generate shareable graphics for your reading.
• Compare Stats: Compare any two stats segments of your StoryGraph library, whether that's a particular year against a custom time period, your To-Read Pile against your owned books, or a combination of several other options. You can also compare any stats segment with any segment from any other user — mix and match however you like.
• Exclusive Charts: When comparing your reading across two different years, see exclusive year-on-year charts on the number of books read and their genres.
• Shape the roadmap: You get to vote and comment on upcoming features as well as submit official requests for new ones
• Priority Support: Your support tickets and requests for book information updates will be handled first
Privacy Policy: https://app.thestorygraph.com/privacy
Terms of Service:https://app.thestorygraph.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00123640:ios.summary:
The Water.io App aims to upgrade the users' life by improving their hydration habits. We build a personalized hydration profile for each user, based on the physical details, which is the hydration daily goal.
Using the Water.io Smart Bottle
bluejetty:00123640:ios.description:
The Water.io App aims to upgrade the users' life by improving their hydration habits. We build a personalized hydration profile for each user, based on the physical details, which is the hydration daily goal.
Using the Water.io Smart Bottle we track and monitor the user's hydration through the day, we remind the user when it's time to hydrate and making sure they never forget!
You can also add sports activity and workouts or connect the app to sport apps such as Garmin, Strava. That way we adjust the hydration goal to the type of activity and other parameters, and we'll tell you how much water is recommended for you.
Watch your historical data, monitor habits and gets stats in the weekly report.
Get yourself a Water.io Smart Bottle and get started!
Water.io must only be used for improving physical fitness and health, and cannot be used for diagnosing disorders or conditions, or for curing, relieving, treating, or preventing disorders.
Apple Health tracks your workouts and can share that data with Water.io to provide more accurate data about your sports activities so that Water.io will adjust your daily hydration goal. You can control permission for this sharing in Apple Health Settings.

Welcome to Astro Future! Discover the astrology app that empowers you to see the good in the stars! 
Navigate the universe to understand yourself more deeply. Gain incredible insight into the astrology of your life and discover how the planet positions and your birth chart impact your life and your future. Astro Future helps you focus on the positive and empowers you to make your own life choices.
Features Include:
Birth charts with detailed horoscopes where you can tap on aspects to understand their meaning in astrology.
Read your daily horoscope in the app or on our amazing widgets, with positive personalised wisdom to help you navigate your day.
Explore transit charts with daily horoscopes where you can scroll through the future and watch the planets move through the zodiac.
Amazing and NASA accurate solar system where you can see the planets travel through the zodiac.
Discover synastry charts to see how two individuals influence each other's horoscope.
Enter as many family members, friends, and crushes as you like.
Extensive PDF reports and Apple Watch support.
Make a beautiful snapshot of your horoscope and share it with family and friends.
Check out the balance between astrology elements (fire, earth, air and water), qualities (fixed, cardinal and mutable) and dualities (masculine and feminine) in all of your horoscopes.
Check how compatible you and your crush are or check the love compatibility between any 2 people, with unlimited love compatibility horoscopes.
Discover detailed interpretations for planet positions in transit charts.
Astro Future can find special astronomical moments like lunar and solar eclipses, solstices and equinoxes or moments with special meaning in astrology like retrogrades and planetary birthdays.
Select different horoscope house systems.
With Astro Future’s comprehensive set of features, gain a deeper understanding of astrology and its impact on your life. Whether you're looking for daily horoscopes, birth charts, or synastry charts, Astro Future has you covered. 
Download Astro Future today and discover the incredible world of astrology today!
Our editorial work on Astro Future endeavours to provide quality astrological information and horoscopes for entertainment purposes only.

bluejetty:00164548:ios.description:
**Business Tycoon: Build Your Luxury Empire**
Step into the world of wealth and power with Business Tycoon, the ultimate business simulation and luxury lifestyle game! Your journey to becoming a billionaire tycoon starts here.
**Key Features**
**Business Management**
• Build and upgrade businesses across multiple industries: Food, Retail, Tech, Entertainment, and more
• Hire managers to automate operations and maximize efficiency
• Progress through business levels and unlock prestigious opportunities
• Earn passive income while offline
**Luxury Assets Collection**
• Real Estate: Mansions, penthouses, and iconic properties
• Cars: Supercars including Bugatti, Rolls-Royce, and Ferrari
• Aircraft: Private jets and helicopters
• Yachts: Luxurious superyachts for ultimate prestige
• Jewelry: Rare diamonds and premium collections
**Live Auction System**
• Participate in real-time auctions with other players
• Bid on exclusive luxury assets and rare collectibles
• List your own items for auction and profit from sales
• Track bidding history and compete for coveted items
**Rental & Passive Income**
• Rent out your luxury assets to generate daily income
• Accept Elite Contracts, Prime Deals, and Flash Deals
• Collect deposits and rental payments
• Manage multiple rental contracts simultaneously
**Investment System**
• Trade in the stock market, real estate, and cryptocurrencies
• Monitor dynamic market prices that change in real-time
• Strategic holding periods for optimal profits
**Prestige System**
• Reset progress strategically to earn permanent income multipliers
• Each prestige level increases earnings by +0.5x
**Special Events**
• Experience market booms, innovation surges, and tourist seasons
• Gain temporary profit multipliers
**Achievement System**
• Unlock achievements across various categories
• Earn monetary rewards and bonuses
**Financial Features**
• Take business loans and manage your credit score
• Track bank balances and transaction history
**Social Features**
• Compete on global leaderboards
• Share achievements and purchases
• 24/7 live chat support
**Visual Experience**
• Stunning graphics showcasing luxury assets
• Interactive UI with smooth animations
• Dark mode support
**Quality of Life**
• Auto-save system
• Offline progress
• Tutorials and customizable settings
**Why Play?**
Business Tycoon combines idle mechanics, strategic management, luxury collecting, live auctions, and investments. Build your empire and define success.
**In-App Purchases**
Optional purchases available to enhance gameplay.
**Download Business Tycoon today!**

bluejetty:00178886:ios.description:
Feel your emotions. Your choices, your story, your otome: love, romance and more! Explore love stories and take them wherever you wish. Discover exciting worlds, filled with seduction, love, and experience all the twists that will keep you hooked. Find all the stories you know and love in one unique app, and find new chapters that will keep you entertained.
Find all the Is It Love? storylines in Stories: Is It Love? & more. With immersive and interconnected universes, as well as rich and dynamic content, the stories of Matt, Drogo, Ryan, Gabriel and many more are waiting for you! Live a whirlwind love story with a vampire, a surfer, musician, or a werewolf, a bad boy or a mysterious multimillionaire… Or decide whether you want to date an angel or a demon. Stories: Is It Love? & more - the place to feel.
Strong points:
• Romantic adventures with the character of your choice
• It’s your game: your choices, your interactive story
• On-demand experience: our otome games are free, and contain a wealth of bonus content - extra love stories, long stories and more!
Embody a female character and live interactive love stories in fascinating universes. You are about to live a true romance with more twists than you can count! Love, adventure, ambition, and more…
Need 5 reasons to download Stories: Is It Love? & more?
• Your story. Your choice. Every decision impacts the storyline
• A visual, sensorial and emotional adventure
• An amazing range of characters
• Photo-realistic backgrounds
• Regular additional content: Mini-series, Extra Love stories, Extra Event stories…
Follow us:
• Facebook: www.facebook.com/isitlovegames/
• Instagram: www.instagram.com/weareisitlovegames/
• Tik Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@isitlovegames
• Website: www.isitlove.com
Got a question or looking for help?
Contact the support in the game by clicking on the Settings button then Support.
About us:
1492 Studio is a video game studio based in France. It was co-founded in 2014 by Claire and Thibaud Zamora, two entrepreneurs with over 20 years’ experience in the freemium game industry. bluejetty:00123730:ios.description:
So you think you understand this thing you’re holding? Think again. Stop tapping. Stop swiping. In fact, stop touching the screen at all. To crack Blackbox’s puzzles you’ll need to find solitude and stillness, climb mountains, call on friends, get in tune with the cosmos, and think outside the box.
Minimalistic visual clues make for incredibly satisfying “Aha!” moments, while sonic interfaces provide an extra level of guidance and nuance that makes Blackbox accessible with or without vision. You’ll never see your device the same way again.
Think you’re clever? Prove it.
(Blackbox is a living game under active development by Ryan McLeod. When not eating burritos or drinking coffee, he’s busy designing and developing new Blackbox challenges.)

bluejetty:00145231:ios.description:

With a library of over 3,000 video movements and 300+ templates, Bridge is a platform for coaches and trainers to efficiently build, assign and track training both in-person and remotely. Bridge is trusted by elite organizations ranging from Professional and Collegiate teams to private gyms and independent trainers.
Here's how:
- Complete Training: All programs assigned to athletes can be completed through the app from anywhere.
- Track Everything: Each set is recorded and tracked so no PR is missed!

- Update Workouts: Make edits on the fly directly within a workout to change prescriptions, sets and exercises.
- Manage Athletes: Available ONLY on a tablet coaches can manage athletes, build programs, and complete workouts.
For more information or to get started with creating custom training programs head to www.BridgeAthletic.com

Viven: Complete Bible and Faith in Action Every Day
Viven was created for Christians who want to live their faith in a practical and inspiring way every day.
Transform your devotion routine into a deep experience, with the complete Holy Bible, daily verses, Christian actions, and personalized themes that strengthen your relationship with God.
MAIN FEATURES
Complete Bible
Read the entire Bible directly in the app. Navigate easily through books, chapters, and verses. Your Christian Bible always available in your pocket.
Highlights and bookmarks
Underline your favorite verses and build your own library of meaningful passages. Organize your Bible reading your way.
Share verses
Send inspiring verses directly to your friends and family. Spread the Word of God through beautiful personalized images.
Home screen and lock screen widgets
Keep the Word of God always visible with daily verse widgets on your home screen and lock screen. A constant reminder throughout the day.
Daily verses
Discover inspiring Bible passages tailored to your spiritual journey. Scroll easily to find the Word that speaks to your heart today.
Devotionals and Christian action
Put your faith into practice with small daily actions and deep devotionals. Every step counts toward growing spiritually and living the Gospel in everyday life.
Bible Quiz
Test and deepen your knowledge of Scripture with daily quizzes. Questions on biblical characters, stories, and teachings to learn while having fun and strengthen your faith with every challenge.
Full customization
Choose from magnificent themes and wallpapers to create a unique environment for prayer and inspiration.
Minimalist design
A clean, intuitive interface to focus on what matters most: your connection with God.
Whether you want to strengthen your faith, deepen your Bible study, find comfort through prayer, or start the day with inspiration, Viven is your daily spiritual companion.
Join thousands of Christians and live your faith in action.
Download Viven and begin your spiritual journey today.

bluejetty:00069991:ios.description:
Say GOODBYE to paperwork and HELLO to productivity with this life-saving PDF Sign & Fill app! Its wide range of editing tools lets you customize documents and work at record speed. 
Simplify the way you work with PDF! This all-in-one tool makes signing documents easier than ever by letting you sign in a tap, store important documents, and share with others. With easy-to-use features and an intuitive design, PDF Editor makes working from anywhere effortless. 
Built for those on the go and those who work from home, PDF Sign & Fill makes signing and editing documents as simple as swiping and clicking. Whether you’re adding text to an essay or filling out forms for co-workers, this comprehensive toolbox lets you interact with your documents in a whole new way. 
With all of the fantastic features in one place, PDF Sign & Fill gives you the power to:
- Scan your documents
- Efficiently e-sign in no time 
- Fill out forms 
- Reorder pages 
- Add text & annotations 
- Add images 
- Share documents 
- View any PDF from anywhere 
By taking advantage of PDF Sign & Fill app’s intuitive features, you’ll be able to:
- Say goodbye to printers and scanners 
- Decrease waste and hassle by signing electronically 
- Make documents legally binding in seconds 
- Deliver documents on time, any time 
Subscriptions:

Annually - $39.99 USD (one-week free trial)

• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

Create your own team, play championships and win the cup.
Already over 500,000 downloads worldwide.

Fiete Soccer is easy to use for children and at the same time provides exciting game situations. 
This guarantees many hours of soccer fun.
Make your way through the opposing ranks. Steal the ball from your opponent. But be careful. In the event of a foul, the referee will also reach for a yellow card. And with a red card you have to leave the soccer field!
The kids soccer app!
Fiete Soccer also makes it possible for young children to participate in soccer fever.

bluejetty:00065840:ios.description:
Burger Shop 2, the sequel to the wildly successful food making game, Burger Shop, is now available!
In Burger Shop, you successfully created a universal chain of restaurants and found fame and fortune... Until one day, you found yourself in a dumpster with a bump on your head, your diner boarded up, and no memory of how any of it happened.
Now in Burger Shop 2 you must rebuild your restaurant empire, adding new twists to your menu to entice new customers while uncovering the truth about what happened to your original hamburger chain. Use your time management skills cooking and serving food for hungry customers. Upgrade your kitchen to provide your customers with different types of food like hamburgers, cheese burgers, chicken sandwiches, French fries, onion rings, salads, pizza, donuts, waffles, pancakes, pasta, steak, cakes, pies, ice cream sundaes and much, much more! Can you dash around serving hungry customers tasty food and discover the truth of what happened to your original burger chain?
Join the Burger Shop 2 craze and grab ingredients from the BurgerTron 2000 to create tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced food shop game!
GAME FEATURES:
• 120 Story Levels and 120 Expert Levels!
• Challenge Modes and Relax Modes!
• Serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner!
• Over 100 different food items!
• Over 100 trophies to collect!
• Unlimited play!
Burger Shop 2 offers endless play with four different game modes!
GAME MODES:
• Story Mode - Rebuild your restaurant empire, and solve the mystery of who or what destroyed your original burger chain.
• Challenge Mode - Play fever-pitched, fast one-minute rounds - but don't lose a customer or it's all over! It's Burger Mania!
• Relax Mode - Serve food without any pressure or stress. Customers are infinitely patient.
• Expert Mode - So, you think you are the Burger Master Chef? Put your food-making skills to the test! 
Available in 11 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish, Indonesian, Russian, and Japanese.

bluejetty:00124131:ios.description:
Essential to life, water is often under-consumed leading to dehydration, fatigue, skin problems, and other serious health issues. Address these problems with Plant Nanny, your cute and friendly hydration companion! This water reminder app motivates you to drink water daily and lets you grow adorable plants in parallel with your hydration journey.
-------------------------------------------
◈ Why Choose Plant Nanny? ◈
-------------------------------------------
With Plant Nanny, you and your water-loving digital plants thrive together! Drink water, hydrate your plant, and watch your personal greenhouse flourish. It's a fun, interactive way to ensure you maintain good hydration habits.
-------------------------------------
◈ Fresh and Engaging Features! ◈
------------------------------------
1. Grow your favorites: With plants available in 3 difficulty levels, witness your hydration habits bloom.
2. Comprehensive Hydration Tracking: Monthly comparisons of your water intake, track your progress effortlessly.
3. Easy Editing: Quickly update your water logs for accurate data.
4. Motivational Visuals: Track progress with charming charts and engage in mini-challenges.
5. Greenhouse Creatures: Marvel as your plants thrive amidst beautifully designed greenhouses and captivating creatures.
And, stay connected with our cute water reminder widget for a glance at your hydration habits and plant health! 
------------------------------------------------------
◈SPARKFUL Subscription: Better Living with Water◈
------------------------------------------------------
 Subscribers are 2.4x better at sticking with their goals! 
＊ Unlimited exclusive plants inspire you to take better care of yourself
＊ Gentle nudges tailored to your schedule and style
＊ Advanced water log for precise, effortless tracking
＊Ad-free, enjoyable drinking experience
◈ Intuitive Charts and User-friendly Interface
＊Graphics that progressively track your daily water intake
＊Track your water consumption history and view daily, weekly, and monthly trends quickly
＊Simple design and user-friendly interface, so you can easily build good habits
◈ Tailored Hydration Goals and Comprehensive Management 
Customize your water intake goals based on your personal health data and exercise habits. Enjoy automated reminders, rewards for consistency, and motivating missions.
◈ Delightful and Animated Plants to Liven Up Your Day! 
＊Each glass of water you drink also waters the plants so that you can grow and thrive together!
＊All kinds of special pots and containers. Develop your own cute plant family!
＊Unlock and collect a variety of different plants, and even interact with mysterious new creatures!
Plant Nanny syncs hydration data with Apple Health.
▼Any questions or suggestions?
For queries or suggestions, go to Plant Nanny > Menu > Settings > FAQ. Still didn't find what you're looking for? Contact our “Garden Assistant” (customer service) via the envelope icon on the top right.
▼Feel free to reach out to our support team with any suggestions
Find us on Instagram: https://link.sparkful.app/instagram
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service: https://sparkful.app/legal/privacy-policy
Stay hydrated and healthy, and let's grow with Plant Nanny!

bluejetty:00142395:ios.description:
SuperMCard is a sharp sword for learners. At present, only a few people learn it. In the exam, if one person has mastered the learning method of using SuperMCard, it will be a great injustice to others. It is a competition between fist and machine gun.  
SuperMCard is not only a learning tool, but also an external embodiment of a learning method ahead of the times. If you want to spend the same time and want to surpass most people, SuperMCard, you should understand! 
What exactly is SuperMCard? SuperMCard is introduced in many places as a memory aid tool. Such introduction is unattractive and does not reflect the real value of SuperMCard.  
I prefer to introduce it to others. SuperMCard is a learning tool to help you scientifically use your brain to remember all information. Compared with traditional learning methods, it does not improve the learning effect by 10% or 20%, but several times.  
[as an ordinary person, what effect does SuperMCard have on me?]
1. Effectively improve test scores and apply to all tests
2. Improve learning quality and take the initiative to find weak knowledge points
3. Learning algorithms bring efficiency changes and reduce time waste
4. Focus more on the learning process and reduce the number of distractions
5. Multi terminal, learning anytime, anywhere
6. Knowledge will be remembered for life and will not be forgotten after learning
[what can SuperMCard be used to learn?]
If you ask me, SuperMCard is suitable for learning that knowledge, my answer is "almost everything".
-Learning English with SuperMCard
-Using SuperMCard to cope with the college entrance examination
-Using SuperMCard to deal with postgraduate entrance examination
-Learning mathematics with SuperMCard
-Learning programming with SuperMCard
-Study law with SuperMCard
-Learning Chinese with SuperMCard
-Learn to drive with SuperMCard
-Learning medicine with SuperMCard
-Almost everything you can think of can be learned with SuperMCard...  
Because no matter what knowledge you learn, you almost need to learn by remembering the knowledge points. When you finish reading books and listening to classes, these knowledge is only short-term memory in your brain. The short-term memory can only last for a few minutes. When you need examination, expression and application, you can't retrieve and use the learned knowledge from your brain.  
If you want to better test taking and application, you need to change the learned knowledge from short-term memory to long-term memory, so that you can call it quickly when needed, and SuperMCard was born to solve this problem.
Subscription:
You’ll get unlimited learning times ,unlock full features.
Subscription information:Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Terms of service:https://info.xiangqin9.com/Anjinotecardagreement.html
A link to the terms of use in either the app description or EULA field of App store Connect.(Please visit :https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ )

bluejetty:00120282:ios.description:
Congratulations! You're about to unlock everything your kids need to master hundreds of 2nd grade spelling words, all on their own. A superb investment into improving the next generation. What makes this app great? It combines simple, read-along lessons with AI-powered spelling-bee-style adaptive practice questions to make learning 2nd grade spelling skills faster and easier than ever before. Bonus: When you sign up, you unlock all 10+ apps by Class Ace to help your child learn thousands of skills on their own. Watch your child's vocabulary, reading, and writing abilities flourish.
Features:
• 50+ award-winning, read-along lessons
• Effective, adaptive practice
• Text to speech. Tap on any word to have it read out loud. 
• Auto-play. Sit back and enjoy the whole lesson read to you.
• Switch between student and teacher profiles.
• Teacher View: Review student mistakes
• Gamification. Unlock beautiful planet art as you learn spelling.
Watch your child's grades improve with just a few minutes of regular practice.
Learn Spelling was developed by a team of veteran teachers, technologists, and student testers.
=======
Learn Spelling is a member of the Class Ace family of apps. One subscription unlocks full access to all 15+ apps by Class Ace, which includes over 2,500+ lessons covering K-6 subjects and 20+ innovative AI tools.
Subscription Info:
• Unlimited access to all Class Ace lessons, apps, and tools starts at $14.99 / month after a 1 week free trial and includes 5 student profiles.
• Cancel Anytime: You won't be charged if you cancel before the end of the trial period.
• Renewal: Auto-renewal may be turned off anytime from your Apple Subscription Manager.
If your child needs Learn Spelling but you simply can’t afford it, please email support@classace.io.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless they are turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in account settings. Renewals are charged within 24-hours preceding the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions are managed by the user. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to Learn Spelling by Class Ace, where applicable.
You can access Learn Spelling without a subscription, but will be limited to 20 free questions per day, and your medals will be lost on leaving the app.
No parent wants to see their child fall behind. Yet over 50% of 4th graders weren't proficient in 4th grade common core standards in the US in 2017. Our own kids were struggling to keep up. We built Learn Spelling for them, and now they are excelling on their own. Your kids can too!
=======
Help & Support
Problems, questions, or want to get in touch?
Contact us at support@classace.io

Terms of Service: https://classace.io/terms
Privacy: https://classace.io/privacy

bluejetty:00066404:ios.description:
Orc Knights, Elf Sages, Dragon Riders, and other incredible warriors are waiting to fight for your empire! Raise a massive fantasy army for HUGE, spectacularly animated battles! Axes fly, dragons roar, and fireballs sizzle as you clash with enemies from all over the world in real-time. Call on your allies to rush to your aid on horse- and lizard-back. Repay them with your undying loyalty as you take castles, slay ogres, and stake new territory as a tribe! THIS is the game you won’t be able to put it down as your screen lights up with constant new battles, chats, and upgrades!
You must battle to become more powerful than any king in history! But you can’t do it alone. It’s up to you and your allies to unite the fantasy races like never before as you conquer an endless world of empires and imagination.
◆HOMELAND
• Recruit and train over 30 unique soldiers.
• Construct and upgrade tons of buildings for new soldiers, buffs, and resources!
• Research new technology FAST for cutting-edge tactics and weapons!
◆ALLIANCE
• Friend, feud, and chat with players from around the world in real time.
• Help each other build and expand your cities faster.
• Rally together to take down enemies you could never face alone!
• Share and expand territory to enjoy exclusive buildings and bonuses! 
◆CONFRONTATION
• Sweep the battlefield in huge real-time PvP matches!
• Build your force to leviathan proportions!
• Engulf other lords' castles as you expand your territory.
◆CONQUEST
• Attack other player's castles to plunder their resources and climb power rankings!
• Vanquish roaming monsters for their treasures, from man-eating Ogres to massive Dragons.
◆EMPIRE
• Take over the Royal City to rule over the realm with unheard of power and privileges!
• Explore unknown lands to find elite resources, ancient ruins, and more surprises!
• Grow your alliance territory for richer rewards and resources!

"S
bluejetty:00127455:ios.description:
What the reviews say:
"A must-have drum synth for electronic music lovers on iOS" - Keyboard Mag
"All of this comes together in a vision that’s really playable [...] this is another excellent choice for the iPad." - CreateDigitalMusic
"Small, compact and easy to use, Ruismaker is both inexpensive and a perfectly credible choice if you are after solid drum synth sounds." - MusicAppBlog
--
Ruismaker is a unique drumsynth plugin (i.e. it does not use samples), which is coupled with a creative Euclidean sequencer when run in standalone mode.
The plugin is fully AUv3 (Audio Unit) compatible:
- Seamless integration with Garageband and other AU hosts
- Audio Unit Instrument: making music on iOS doesn't get more convenient
- Supports Multi-Output AUv3 in AUM and ApeMatrix!
- Each sound is modeled using authentic analog and FM algorithms; 
- Comes with dozens of unique customizable models
- Does not use any samples; all sounds are synthesized in realtime, on the fly
- Emulates analog components, introducing subtle, natural fluctuations in the sound 
- Light on the CPU, so you can run lots of Ruismakers simultaneously
- Fully automatable parameters (requires host support) and MIDI CC controllable 
- Has its own preset manager
The standalone sequencer is refreshingly different:
- Program patterns using Euclidean algorithms
- Powerful random feature and mutation probability settings per channel 
- Syncs with Ableton Link or MIDI Clock
- Exports WAV and MIDI
- Compatible with Audiobus 3 (including MIDI IN/OUT mode)
- CoreMIDI In and Out
- AU MIDI output for the on-screen pads
User manual available on Ruismaker.com

bluejetty:00070382:ios.description:
Tiny Calendar is an intuitive smart calendar works with all your calendars. It inherits the simple and clean look of calendars but makes it more accessible, powerful and reliable on your iPhone and iPad. With Tiny Calendar, you can access and manipulate your google calendar events and tasks more easily, anyway you want.
SMART ENOUGH TO CREATE
Tiny Calendar has features like nature language input, drag and drop, gestures and other smart methods to predict your intention and help you create and edit your events more easily.
SYNC & MANAGE GOOGLE TASKS
You don’t need to download another app to manage Google tasks. 
MULTIPLE WAYS TO VIEW 
Tiny Calendar supports 9 standard views - Forecast, day, week, month, 4-days, year, mini-month, week agenda and agenda. You can instantly switch views to discover events or find a time you're looking for.
REAL-TIME SYNC 
Tiny Calendar syncs directly with all your Google calendars and also works with iOS local calendar to support events on iCloud, Exchange and other calendars.
WORKS OFFLINE 
You can still create, edit and delete events when you don't have an Internet connection. Tiny Calendar will cache your changes and sync back to your calendar account next time you're online. 
ADVANCED REMINDER SYSTEM 
Never forget about a meeting! Tiny Calendar allows you to set reminders via push notification, or email for all events. 
ACCESS FROM EVERYWHERE 
Tiny Calendar works with your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. You don't need to pay extra money to download multiple copies.
Subscription Information:
- Tiny Calendar offers a subscription which is $1.49/week & $2.99/month.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Terms of Use: https://apps.fengge.io/TinyCalendar/TermsConditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://apps.fengge.io/TinyCalendar/PrivacyPolicy.html

bluejetty:00037819:ios.description:
GAİN NEDİR?
GAİN, televizyon ve sinema dünyasının eğitici, eğlenceli ve popüler içeriklerini bir arada sunan yeni nesil dizi ve film platformudur. Farklı seslere, başka renklere ve çeşitli bakış açılarına sahip içerikleri kullanıcılarıyla buluşturan GAİN ile yerli ve yabancı dizi-filmleri, belgeselleri, haber, müzik, spor ve eğlence programlarını, bir de tüm bunların yanı sıra canlı yayınları HD ve 4K formatında izleyebilirsin.
AI tabanlı algoritması ve güncel içerik alternatifleri ile herkesin kendine göre içerik bulabileceği kesintisiz film izleme sitesi ve uygulaması olan GAİN üzerinden dilersen birden fazla liste oluşturabilir, kendine uygun modu seçebilir, yakında gelecek olan içerikleri takip edebilir, beğendiğin dizi ve filmleri istediğin zaman, istediğin yerden izleyebilirsin.
KAÇIRILMAYACAK DİZİLER VE FİLMLER
GAİN; HD film kalitesiyle yabancı dizi, korku filmleri, aksiyon filmleri, komedi filmleri, romantik filmler ve talkshow gibi geniş bir içerik yelpazesine sahiptir.
Türkiye’nin en popüler komedi dizilerinden Ayak İşleri serisinin yanı sıra; Mahsun J, Ru, Şahsiyet, Arjen, Hamlet, 10 Bin Adım, Orta Kafa Aşk, BKM Mutfak ve Tuz Biber gibi birçok popüler içeriğe de ev sahipliği yapar.
Sinema filmlerine ilgi duyanlar ise; John Wick serisi, Taxi, Green Book, Arrival, Her Şey Çok Güzel Olacak, Aile Arasında ve Kelebekler gibi sevilen filmleri bu platformda bulabilir.
Ödüllü filmleri yakından takip eden sinemaseverler de; Eşkıya, Gergedan Mevsimi, Her, Slumdog Millionaire gibi Türkçe ve İngilizce dublajlı filmleri GAİN ayrıcalığıyla izleyebilir.
Hadise ve Seda Bakan’ın başrollerini paylaşacağı “Esas Oğlan” dizisi başta olmak üzere yakında yayınlanacak birçok içeriği de yine GAİN’de üyelik oluşturarak takip edebilirsin.
EN İYİ FİLMLERİ ve DİZİLERİ DİLEDİĞİN CİHAZDA HD ve 4K İZLE
GAİN, kaliteli zaman geçirmek isteyen herkes için farklı cihazlarda aynı anda kullanım imkanı sunar. Böylece film ve dizileri; telefon, tablet, bilgisayar ve televizyon gibi her türlü cihazda HD ya da 4K seçeneği ile aynı anda izleyebilirsin.

bluejetty:00073585:ios.name: Day One: Daily Journal & Diary
bluejetty:00073585:ios.summary: Apple’s App of the Year with over 15 million downloads and 200,000 5-star ratings globally, Day One has reinvented journaling, letting you record your life as you live it. Securely save audio, video, photos, notes, and more wherever you are
bluejetty:00073585:ios.description:
Apple’s App of the Year with over 15 million downloads and 200,000 5-star ratings globally, Day One has reinvented journaling, letting you record your life as you live it. Securely save audio, video, photos, notes, and more wherever you are, whenever you want. 
“Day One creates something so rare it feels almost sacred: A completely private digital space.” – New York Times
“Day One makes keeping a journal delightfully easy.” – Wired
WHY DAY ONE?
Day One is the original digital journal app. A decade of updates and feature additions make it the most private, trusted, and easiest-to-use journaling app in the world. 
SIMPLE TO USE, EASY TO LOVE
• Beautiful, award-winning design
• Unlimited text entries 
• Powerful rich text formatting with markdown
• Different journals for every aspect of your life*
PRIVATE AND SECURE 
• Automatic backups keep your journal entries safe
• End-to-end encryption, which is a fancy way of saying your entries are 100% private
• Journal entries stay secure with passcode, TouchID, or FaceID
• Export options (pdf, plain text, etc.) ensure your entries always stay yours
FORM A HABIT & STAY CONSISTENT 
• Streaks and calendar view help keep your momentum going 
• Programmable reminders through text message or phone notifications
• Unique, daily journal prompts help eliminate writer’s cramp 
• Customizable templates save time and add organization to entries
• Today view provides a summary of where you’ve been and what you’ve done
• Integrates with the Health app to track mindfulness minutes
MORE THAN WORDS
• Unlimited photos and video*
• Auto-importer for your Instagram posts*
• Handwritten entries or drawings*
• Voice recording and transcription*
JOURNAL FROM WHEREVER, WHENEVER
• Cross-platform apps available on iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, and Mac 
• The ability to text or email entries straight to your journal
BUILT FOR REMINISCING
• On This Day feature allows you to revisit past memories
• Tags, favorites, and search filters make it easy to find what you’re looking for
• Map view quickly shows all the places you’ve journaled from
• Print capabilities turn your digital journal into a premium physical book 
TYPE LESS, PRESERVE MORE
• Time, date, weather, moon phase, and more are automatically added to every entry
• IFTTT applets allow importing data from Spotify, YouTube, Strava, Fitbit, Facebook, Twitter, and more
• Siri Shortcuts provides a powerful way to automate more of your journaling
• Share sheet allows you to add content from other apps, like Apple Photos and Safari
*Day One is FREE to use forever with unlimited entries. Additional features, including unlimited photos, videos, and audio recordings are available with a Day One Premium membership. 
Start a free trial today. 
Privacy Policy: https://dayoneapp.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://dayoneapp.com/terms-of-use/
For technical assistance or other inquiries: https://dayoneapp.com/contact/

bluejetty:00164552:ios.description:
Welcome to the Horizon of Speed!
 Rally Horizon delivers a next-gen open world racing experience — right on your mobile device. Feel the thrill of speed, freedom, and precision driving in a world built for car lovers and speed freaks.
Race Like Never Before
 • Push the limits with ultra-detailed supercars, each with unique sound, physics and mod options. 
• Conquer over 80 intense Career Mode levels filled with action-packed races, obstacles and rewards. 
• Enter CS Legend Events and earn powerful new rides — for free!
A World Built for Driving
 • Drift through deserts, snow, mud and asphalt across stunning open-world environments.
 • Experience the Festival Zone – a living racing map full of hidden rewards, stunts and surprises.
 • Walk freely in your garage, interact with your customized cars and live the dream.
Personalize Your Ride
 • Use new Tuning Systems, Puzzles and Scratch Cards to unlock special upgrades.
 • Go beyond racing — your garage is now your playground.
Offline Freedom – Real Racing
 No internet? No problem. Rally Horizon is fully playable offline. Whether you're commuting or chilling, the thrill is always with you.
Heads Up! 
Rally Horizon doesn’t support cloud saving. Deleting the game will erase progress and purchases.

Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of w
bluejetty:00034066:ios.description:
Welcome to Word Connect, a place where the power of words meets the excitement of association! Get ready for an exciting journey through the depths of vocabulary and the joy of puzzle solving.
Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of word associations, where each connection opens up new possibilities and brings the satisfaction of victory. Your task is to group the presented words into sets, each consisting of four words connected by the thinnest association thread. Discover a variety of categories, from food to travel, from animals to professions.
Awesome game features:
- Unique mechanics in which players must decipher sets of words and group them into sets of four words linked by a common association.
- An abundance of rewards and gifts to earn as you progress through the game.
- Addictive gameplay in the association genre.
- Amazing and exciting animations.
But don't be afraid if you get stuck on a level! We'll provide you with intriguing hints that will help you overcome any difficulties. Unlock new levels and keep your brain occupied with unique clues that will help you on your adventure.
How to play:
- You will be presented with a set of words.
- Your goal is to group them into sets of four words with a common association.
- Group the words by marking them or tap to form a set.
- If your choices are correct, the words will lock in, and you will move on to the next task.
- If you get stuck, use the hints to reveal a word or shuffle the set for a fresh perspective.
In addition, every day you will receive many gifts for your activity and dedication to the game. Enjoy the rewards and keep striving for knowledge and development!
Join us and immerse yourself in the world of Word Connect, where words become your gateway to adventure!
Privacy Policy: https://severex.io/privacy/
Terms of Use: http://severex.io/terms/

bluejetty:00142460:ios.name: TingYue
bluejetty:00142460:ios.summary: TingYue is a reading and audiobook app designed for foreign language learners and extensive reading enthusiasts. It supports importing EPUB, PDF, TXT, DOCX and MOBI files, automatic full-text translation, and multi-engine text-to-speech (TT
bluejetty:00142460:ios.description:
TingYue is a reading and audiobook app designed for foreign language learners and extensive reading enthusiasts. It supports importing EPUB, PDF, TXT, DOCX and MOBI files, automatic full-text translation, and multi-engine text-to-speech (TTS), combined with reading plans, vocabulary study and practice features that turn “finish this book” into something you can do a day at a time.
Core Features
 • Reading Plans: Split a book into segments you can finish in a day — set it by total days, daily minutes or a finish date. Your library shows plans in progress, a reminder arrives each day, and finishing a book ends with a recap.
 • Vocabulary Study: Pick the word lists you want to learn and the app analyses how many of those words this book contains, highlights them as you read, and keeps your progress one tap away.
 • Full-Text Translation: Automatically translates paragraphs or entire pages into the target language. Translations can be displayed below the original text or side-by-side. Supports multiple translation engines (including Apple Translate, DeepL, Google, etc.).
 • Smart Reading & TTS: Built-in multiple voice engines, supporting offline and cloud high-quality voices. Suitable for intensive listening and shadowing practice.
 • Reading Assistance: Highlights new words, word frequency analysis, sentence parsing, biomimetic reading, speed reading and blurred text exercises, AI dictionary, AI explanations, helping focus and memory.
 • Learning Tools: Create study sets, add images and example sentences, dictation exercises, export learning materials, supports custom study set sizes and review plans.
 • Practice Modes: Chinese-to-English back translation, blurred text training, split-screen side-by-side reading, and other interactive modes, suitable for translation, speaking, and writing practice.
 • Customization & Extensions: Supports custom translation/voice/AI engines (requires API keys), and allows saving custom translations and notes.
 • Formats & Sync: Import EPUB, PDF, TXT, DOCX and MOBI. Your books, notes, study sets and custom word lists sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac via iCloud.
Target Users
 • English and foreign language learners (beginner to advanced)
 • Readers who enjoy extensive and deep reading
 • Users preparing for translation or speaking exams
 • Users who need high-quality TTS and listening practice
Membership Plans
 • Reader Plan, subscription periods: lifetime
 • Read Plus Plan, subscription periods: 1 month, 1 year, lifetime
 • Listen Plus Plan, subscription periods: 1 month, 1 year, lifetime
 • AI Plan, subscription periods: 1 month
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
----
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.eareyereading.com/help/privacy.html
Cancel Subscription: https://support.apple.com/HT202039

bluejetty:00088749:ios.description:
Paris Aéroport is the Paris Aéroport company’s application for iOS mobiles.
The free application groups together all essential information in real time, along with the following services:
• Schedules and airlines: flight schedules for arrivals and departures, flight-sharing by e-mail, real time notifications of changes in flight status, alerts in the case of unusual events. Information about airlines serving a particular city or country.
• Customer account: create and manage your customer account, favourite flights, airlines, and services, pin your preferred flight to the home page.
• Reservation and payment of parking with price comparison as well as reservation of other services, such as hotels, flights, car hire, etc.
• Search for shops, bars and restaurants by filtering the search list by type and brand logo. Direct access to our marketplace extime.com
• Directions: information on how to access airports, interactive maps of terminals.
• Services available in terminals, practical information, procedures, news, etc.
• Loyalty programm: join the loyalty programm and access your rewards account to track the points you have earned, and view the benefits and reductions possible depending on status, etc.
Languages available: French, English, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Brazilian Portuguese, and Italian. Certain features are only available in French and English.
If you would like to help us improve the Paris Aéroport application, please provide your contact details and contact us at: 
https://www.parisaeroport.fr/en/passengers/services/claims-litigation/contact--form
System requirements: iOS 13 or higher.

bluejetty:00026584:ios.description:
Search fast and rent faster with Apartment List – the most personalized way to apartment hunt. Tell us what you want in your next home, and discover premium apartments for rent in any city, curated just for you. Our Rental Matchmaker instantly filters through 1000s of rental apartments to guide you to the perfect one, so you love where you rent next.
Apartment List Key Features:
Rental Matchmaker Quiz
Our 5-minute quiz saves you hours of searching for the perfect apartment. Answer a few questions about what you’re looking for – apartment size, amenities, location, budget, and more – and we’ll instantly recommend premium rental apartments that match your preferences.
Adjust your preferences at any time, and we’ll refresh your matches.
Curated Apartment Matches
We sort your apartment matches into two categories: Perfect Matches and Flex Matches.
Perfect Matches: Listings that have everything on your wishlist.
Flex Matches: These listings may not match all your preferences, but you might find a few hidden gems. Our Flex Matches are based on local insights and similar searches from renters like you.
See an apartment for rent that you love? Swipe right and we’ll automatically add it to your shortlist. Hit “Maybe” on the listings you’re not sure about–we’ll save them so you can check them out later. 
Additional Features: 
Amenity Focused Filters
Personalize your search even further with filters for everything: amenities, move-in dates, commute times, rent specials, lease lengths, and more!
Map Searches
Discover Perfect Matches and Smart Matches in neighborhoods you’ll love to call home. Our in-map filters help you find rental apartments that fit your wishlist, budget, and location preferences.
Real-Time Alerts
Get updates on unit availability, price changes, or new rent specials on rental apartments saved to your shortlist. 
24/7 Availability and Tour Booking
Get in touch with properties anytime, anywhere via phone, text, or email. Book an in-person or virtual tour from the app whenever you’re ready to check out your favorite listings.
Our premium apartment listings feature high-quality photos, virtual tours, and real-time updates on pricing, unit availability, and rent specials. We don’t skip out on the fine print – like pet policies and move-in fees – so you know exactly what to expect before you rent.

bluejetty:00156196:ios.description:
Take control of your mental health journey with Osmind—your personal care companion that keeps you connected, organized, and informed.
Managing mental health treatment can feel overwhelming. Between appointments, medications, assessments, and paperwork, it's easy to lose track. Osmind simplifies everything by putting your entire care experience in one secure, easy-to-use app.
Why Osmind?
→ Never Miss What Matters
Get gentle reminders for appointments and medication schedules. View your complete care calendar and know exactly what's coming up.
→ Track Real Progress
See how far you've come with visual charts of your PHQ-9 scores and dive deeper with built-in journaling. Celebrate progress and identify patterns over time.
→ Stay Connected Between Visits
Message your provider securely whenever you need support. No more waiting until your next appointment to ask important questions.
→ Complete Questionnaires at Your Convenience
Fill out questionnaires and intake forms from your couch, not the waiting room. Save time and arrive prepared for more productive sessions.

Important documents, care plans, and health records are always at your fingertips. No more lost paperwork or details.

• Appointment self-scheduling and smart reminders
• Journaling
• Secure messaging with your care provider
• Digital questionnaires and assessments
• Document storage and easy access
• Medication reminders and tracking
• HIPAA-compliant security
Your Privacy Matters
All data is HIPAA-compliant and stored securely.
Get Started Today
Join thousands of patients who've simplified their mental health care with Osmind. Download now and experience the peace of mind that comes with having your care journey organized and accessible.
Whether you're just starting treatment or have been on your mental health journey for years, Osmind helps you stay engaged, informed, and connected to what matters most—your wellbeing.

bluejetty:00044243:ios.name: ServiceM8 Phone
bluejetty:00044243:ios.summary: A smarter phone system for trade contractors & services. Take & action client calls efficiently, professionally, anywhere. See which client is calling and their job history. Convert recent calls & voicemails to new jobs. Simplify call diver
bluejetty:00044243:ios.description:
A smarter phone system for trade contractors & services. Take & action client calls efficiently, professionally, anywhere. See which client is calling and their job history. Convert recent calls & voicemails to new jobs. Simplify call diversion after hours. Route business calls to multiple staff, simultaneously. Transfer between staff. Record & transcribe calls, and more. 
ServiceM8 Phone extends the power of your ServiceM8 job management with a smart cloud phone system, enabling you to provide great customer experiences, streamline phone call workflows, and drive productive outcomes from phone enquiries. 
Provide next-level customer service
With caller identification, any team member can greet clients by name, instantly see their active quotes and work orders on screen, and efficiently action the call’s outcome in ServiceM8. 
Make calls more efficient & productive
Streamline phone call workflows, actions and outcomes. Open the client’s active ServiceM8 jobs, create a new job directly from an active or recent call, or record a Call Summary to an existing job’s Diary.
Work remotely 
Route business calls to multiple staff members, simultaneously. Staff can make & receive calls from anywhere on iPhone, iPad, or online through the ServiceM8 dashboard & Chrome extension.
Give clients a single point of contact 
Route all incoming calls through a single number, and set outgoing calls from all staff to display your business number, so clients always know it’s your business calling. 
Gain visibility of phone calls across the business
See incoming calls, missed calls and voicemails from anywhere. 
Simplify after-hours call diversion
Incoming calls to your business after hours automatically divert to the team member On Call, or a custom voicemail message.
Enhance team communication & call handling
Quickly call other team members in the business, and efficiently transfer clients on the line to another staff member, from anywhere. 
Record & transcribe calls 
Improve quality assurance and job history with call events, durations, recordings and transcripts automatically saved to the ServiceM8 job card they’re related to.
Manage enquiries efficiently
Text a booking form to a caller in a few taps while they’re on the line, so they can enter their own details and submit the enquiry online, arriving in your ServiceM8 Inbox.
ServiceM8 Phone is a companion app to ServiceM8 job management software. A ServiceM8 account configured with ServiceM8 Phone is required in order to log in to the ServiceM8 Phone app.

bluejetty:00148060:ios.description:
My Prayers is an Islamic application with accurate Prayer Times using the phone's location (latitude and longitude) based on different conventions and has a fixed prayer time for those cities which have a fixed time table for prayers. Also, this app provides Qibla Direction, 99 Names of Allah and more.
Main Features:
• Accurate prayer times based on your current location with multiple settings available (angles).
• Fixed prayer times for those cities which have fixed time table for prayers.
• Show remaining time of the next prayer time.
• Notification for each prayer time with the ability to adjust their times.
• Ability to adjust prayer times manually.
• Automatic location detection using Network or GPS, or finding the location manually by searching (Without Internet).
• Show Hijri date with the ability to adjust Hijri date.
• Qibla Compass direction.
• 99 Names of Allah
• Azkars
• App fully translated into English, عربي, فارسی, and کوردی
Important Notes:
If you feel that the app is giving you wrong prayer times, do the followings: 
• It is most likely related to your settings. Go to Setting -> Prayer Time Settings to adjust it or.
• Refer to the official Islamic institutions or Mosques in your city and send us the correct times to take them into consideration.
Contact us:
• Website: https://myprayers.io
• Email: contact@myprayers.io
• Facebook: https://goo.gl/ouXCwZ
• Twitter: https://goo.gl/pkMja4
• Telegram: https://t.me/my_prayers
