bluejetty:00013687:ios.summary: Start your journey to understanding the Quran. Read word-by-word meanings, translations and tafsir in 66 languages, listen to recitations, and reflect on every verse. Free and ad-free, trusted by 8M+ users worldwide. Transform your Quran le
bluejetty:00013687:ios.description:
Start your journey to understanding the Quran. Read word-by-word meanings, translations and tafsir in 66 languages, listen to recitations, and reflect on every verse. Free and ad-free, trusted by 8M+ users worldwide. Transform your Quran learning journey with this comprehensive and trusted app.
Understand the Quran in your language:
- Study the Quran by studying 170+ translations & tafsirs of the Quran in 60+ languages: English, Indonesian, Bangla, Hindi, Urdu, German, Chinese, French, Italian, Malay, Russian, Spanish, Tamil, and many more!
- Access 8 Arabic tafsirs (including Ibn Kathir, Tabari) with I‘rab, word meanings, and Asbabun Nuzul. 
Read word by word analysis & translations
- Read word by word translations of the Quran in 15+ languages, including English, Indonesian, Bangla, German, Hindi, Ingush, Malay, Russian, Tamil, Turkish and Urdu
- Study and analyse Word Root/Lemma, Grammar, Morphology, Occurrences in different forms and Verb Forms to dive in more depth. Helpful to learn & understand Quranic Arabic
Build a Quran reading habit:
- Set daily reading goals and gradually increase them
- Track your daily & weekly reading activity effortlessly
- Earn badges for completing streak milestones and exploring app features
Listen to Quran recitations:
- 80+ reciters audio recitations with audio translation in 10+ languages
- Reciter Options: Mishary Al Afasy, Husary, Ayman Suwaid, Abdur Rahman As-Sudais and many others
- Powerful Audio System with repeat, group playback of verses function to aid in Quran Memorisation/Quran Hifz
- Reciters tagged based on recitation types: Murattal, Mujawwad, Translation
- Arabic audio commentary and Quran audio translation in Bangla, English, Urdu
Learn brief of the Juz and Surah:
- Get a quick summary of every Juz
- See surah summaries and virtues at a glance 
Read from Mushaf Mode:
- Recite Quran in Mushaf mode to have the same experience when reciting from a hard-copy Mushaf
- Available Mushaf scripts: Madani, Naskh Indopak, Qaloon, Shemerly, Warsh
Follow Quran reading plan:
- Plan your Khatmah of the Quran using the Quran Planner
- Choose a standard 29 or 30-day plan, or create a custom schedule to reach your Quran reading goals at your own pace 
Bookmark necessary verses and take notes:
- Bookmark ayahs to your own Collections and keep track of the last read ayah using Pins
- Start reading from where you left off using auto Last Reads
- Reflect and take notes for each ayah
- Sync library across multiple devices and even share with others using import/export
Find any verse or topic easily:
- Powerful Search with highlights to quickly find what you are looking for
- Explore by Topics & read the ayahs related to a topic together
Various other options:
- Read Tafsirs in Tafsir view
- Recite with color-coded Tajweed 
- See the list of roots for different Arabic alphabets
- Various fonts and multiple themes, including Night mode
- Autoscroll feature
- Copy & Share the verses
- All feature supports offline
Download the ad-free Quran app and start your journey to a deeper understanding of the Quran!
Share and recommend this beautiful app to your friends and family. May Allah bless us in this world and the hereafter.
Allah’s Messenger (pbuh) said: "Whoever calls people to right guidance will have a reward like that of those who follow him..." [Sahih Muslim: 2674]

Website: https://gtaf.org

bluejetty:00127619:ios.description:
Pleno Vistorias: tecnologia de ponta para quem exige vistorias digitais rápidas, inteligentes e profissionais.
A Sistemas Pleno desenvolve soluções voltadas para imobiliárias, vistoriadores autônomos, empresas de vistorias
e gestores de locações que desejam padronização, velocidade e precisão em suas vistorias de imóveis.
Com mais de 1.200 clientes ativos, o Pleno Vistorias já é referência no Brasil quando o assunto é eficiência operacional aliada à qualidade de entrega. E o melhor: com recursos que realmente fazem diferença no dia a dia de quem está em campo.
Principais diferenciais do Pleno Vistorias:
Trabalhe mesmo sem internet:
Realize e salve vistorias offline, diretamente do celular ou tablet. Quando tiver conexão, tudo é sincronizado automaticamente.
Laudos digitais gerados em segundos:
Com fotos, vídeos, cabeçalho personalizado, observações e dados completos — tudo pronto para ser enviado ou compartilhado com um clique.
Inteligência Artificial aplicada à vistoria:
Descreva automaticamente as imagens com o auxílio da IA; basta fotografar e a descrição é gerada com precisão e agilidade.
Transforme sua voz em texto:
O reconhecimento de voz integrado no app garante mais velocidade e menos digitação.
Vídeos inseridos automaticamente no PDF:
Grave direto no app e o vídeo será incluído no laudo final sem complicações.
Comparação visual entre vistorias:
Compare lado a lado as vistorias de entrada e saída e identifique facilmente danos e alterações. Tudo muito visual e direto.
Checklists inteligentes e personalizáveis:
Crie checklists obrigatórios para cada tipo de vistoria. Padronize seu processo e garanta consistência em todos os laudos.
Fotos e vídeos organizados por ambiente:
Registre por cômodo, setor ou área externa, garantindo clareza e organização no relatório final.
Equipe integrada, trabalhando ao mesmo tempo:
Mais de um vistoriador pode trabalhar simultaneamente na mesma vistoria, cada um com seu acesso. Depois, o sistema permite mesclar os conteúdos em um único laudo final.
Histórico completo sempre à mão:
Todos os laudos ficam salvos com segurança e podem ser acessados e baixados a qualquer momento.
Painel web completo para gestão e controle:
Via computador, gerencie todos os laudos, distribua tarefas, edite PDFs, aplique filtros por tipo de vistoria, imóvel, cliente ou vistoriador.
Integração com o Pleno Locação:
Para quem também usa o Pleno Locação, tudo fica ainda mais conectado — contratos, cadastros e vistorias reunidos em um só lugar.
Como funciona na prática:
Solicitação da Vistoria
A vistoria é criada no painel web com tipo, imóvel, cliente e data. O gestor designa um ou mais vistoriadores.
Execução no aplicativo
No local, o vistoriador acessa tudo pelo celular: realiza o checklist, faz registros, grava vídeos, insere descrições por voz e pode aplicar assinatura digital, se necessário.
Geração e envio do laudo
Com o envio finalizado, o sistema gera automaticamente o laudo com a identidade visual da empresa e conteúdo completo.
Gestão centralizada
Pelo painel web, os gestores acompanham em tempo real o status das vistorias, exportam dados e mantêm tudo organizado.
Seja mais pleno na sua gestão.
Experimente agora o Pleno Vistorias e transforme suas vistorias com tecnologia, inteligência e agilidade.

bluejetty:00175356:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Kroger app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Kroger grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Plus Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Kroger Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Kroger store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.kroger.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.kroger.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Kroger app, you need a Kroger digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Kroger Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Kroger's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.kroger.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

Call Theme - Features
🌟 Caller Information: You can recognize who is calling by display the caller names and his phone number on the new theme.
🌟 Call Color Theme for Contact: After choosing your Caller Screen Design, you can set it for any contact you like.
🌟 Dynamic Buttons: You can customize call and hang answer buttons by picking your favorite one from a set of different buttons.

🌟 Ringtones settings: choose a ringtone from the list and set it with the call theme.

These bus simulator games combine comfort and challenge in every coach bus game mission.
The realistic 3d bus simulator mode turns every route into a challenge, making it one of the most engaging city bus game experiences. Among popular bus games and trending bus games, this title stands out for realism. Play as a professional coach bus driver in intense bus driving games and explore modern cities in city bus simulator mode. This entertaining bus 🚌 game🎮 also includes offroad bus simulator routes for extra challenge. As a complete bus simulator game, it features luxury coach bus models and a smooth bus driving simulator system. Perfect for fans of city bus games, real bus simulator, and realistic bus driving simulator, this title ranks among the top bus games available today.

bluejetty:00163179:ios.name: Campus Coach-Running & Trail
bluejetty:00163179:ios.summary:
YOUR APP FOR RUNNING, TRAIL, 5K, 10K, HALF MARATHON OR MARATHON
Join Campus Coach to improve your running, follow a structured plan, and prepare for your next 5K, 10K, half marathon or marathon — or simply enjoy more fulfilling outdoor runs
bluejetty:00163179:ios.description:
YOUR APP FOR RUNNING, TRAIL, 5K, 10K, HALF MARATHON OR MARATHON
Join Campus Coach to improve your running, follow a structured plan, and prepare for your next 5K, 10K, half marathon or marathon — or simply enjoy more fulfilling outdoor runs. Whether you're just starting out or already experienced, you'll find the right training, the right pace, and the motivation to keep progressing.
PLANS TO TRAIN FOR 5K, 10K, HALF MARATHON OR MARATHON
Want to run your first 5K, train for a faster 10K, or go all the way to your first marathon?
Campus Coach helps you follow a training plan that matches your level and your goal. Whether you’re a beginner or already running regularly, each program is built to improve your pace, your consistency, and your endurance.
All plans include a variety of sessions — intervals, trail runs, endurance efforts, long runs and recovery — designed to help you progress week after week.
PERSONALIZED TRAIL & RUNNING PLANS FROM 12 WEEKS
Choose a plan from 12 weeks or more, fully adapted to your life, your level, and your goals. Whether you're preparing for a road race or training on the trails, the schedule adjusts to help you stay on track.
Training load increases gradually with the right pace zones, smart rest periods, and dedicated trail or road workouts — designed by runners, for runners.
RUN TRACKING, GPS SYNC & OUTDOOR PERFORMANCE INSIGHTS
Track every run, trail session, and outdoor workout in detail. Sync with your Garmin, Suunto, Coros or Strava account. See your pace, distance, elevation and effort after each run.
Use your data to adjust your training plan in real time and progress step by step. Your runs become more consistent, and your improvements more visible.
RUNNING IN THE NETHERLANDS WITH OTHER PASSIONATE RUNNERS
Train for major events like the Paris Marathon, the New York Marathon, or local races near you. Tackle your next challenge with Campus: your first 10K, half-marathon, or marathon, or discover the thrill of trail running. Every new goal is a new success \!You’ll also join a growing community of runners, with guidance from expert coaches in running, trail, recovery, and nutrition. Whether you're chasing a personal best or reaching your first finish line, you’ll be supported every step of the way.
FOR EVERY RUNNER — FROM 5K TO MARATHON
Campus Coach is built for all runners: road or trail, beginner or advanced. Whether you're going for a quick outdoor jog, a long weekend run or a structured training session, the app gives you the tools to keep improving.
Your plan helps you stay consistent, train smarter, and become a stronger runner — whatever your distance or goal.
DOWNLOAD CAMPUS COACH AND START RUNNING TODAY
Download Campus Coach now and start your training journey. Build your custom plan, sync your workouts, track your progress and run with more structure and purpose — from 5K to marathon.
T&C: https://www.campus.coach/legals/cgv
PP: https://www.campus.coach/legals/charte-de-vie-privee

bluejetty:00062240:ios.summary: If you want to learn how to become an expert guitarist, then the Fret Zealot guitar learning app is perfect for you. With the help of the Fret Zealot guitar learning app, you can learn to play guitar from world-class instructors, video less
bluejetty:00062240:ios.description:
If you want to learn how to become an expert guitarist, then the Fret Zealot guitar learning app is perfect for you. With the help of the Fret Zealot guitar learning app, you can learn to play guitar from world-class instructors, video lessons for songs from the most popular artists, and guided guitar courses to easily achieve your goal of mastering the guitar.
Fret Zealot is an easy to use and user-friendly guitar learning app. It is specifically made for those people who want to learn guitar. You can learn to play the guitar at home - without going to a guitar teacher - with the help of the Fret Zealot guitar learning app. All you have to do is install our Fret Zealot app and optionally connect it to the Fret Zealot LED system through Bluetooth. After connecting the app with the LED system, you can display Song tabs, chords, scales, and notes directly on your guitar fretboard. You can also display instructions and video lessons directly on your guitar fretboard. Learn to play guitar by watching the video lessons and following along on the LED display.
The Fret Zealot LED strip shows colorized finger positions synced with on-screen instructions which make the guitar learning process up to five times faster!. You can learn to play guitar quickly and intuitively without the constant distraction of looking at books, computer screens, or printouts to find out where to put your fingers. If you don’t have a Fret Zealot LED system, you may buy it easily from our website (www.fretzealot.com). Fret Zealot has versions to fit all full-size guitars (scale length 24.75” - 25.5”). It fits both acoustic and electric guitars. Concert and Tenor ukulele versions are available as well!
The Fret Zealot system also includes lessons from local artists, teaching you their songs. You can request a song lesson for any song on the app. 
FEATURES OF FRET ZEALOT GUITAR LEARNING APP:
• Video Lessons for Songs and Courses (over 3,000!)
• Song tabs (over 80,000!)
• AI Mode - waits for the correct note or chord before moving on in song tabs
• Chord diagrams and arpeggios (over 10,000)
• Create your own Chord Progressions.
• Notes & Scales (all of them!)
• Guitar/Bass/UkuleleTuner (with over 55 different tunings)
• Metronome to improve your timing & guitar playing speed
• Left-handed and capo settings
• Beautiful lighting effects for fun
DOWNLOAD THE FRET ZEALOT GUITAR LEARNING APP:
So what are you waiting for? Download & Install the Fret Zealot Guitar Learning App for FREE and start your guitar learning journey with us and become an expert guitarist!
SUBSCRIBE TO THE FRET ZEALOT ALL ACCESS PASS & GET UNLIMITED ACCESS TO ALL COURSES & LESSONS:
Some lessons are available for free in our guitar learning app, while others are available as premium content. To unlock all the premium courses & lessons. Subscribe to our Fret Zealot All Access Pass and get unlimited access to all premium courses and lessons.
A free trial (if applicable) will convert to a recurring subscription automatically. Payments will be charged to your account when the subscription begins, and it will auto-renew as described unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of a subscription. The unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your device account settings.
Feedback:
If you like the Fret Zealot guitar learning app, please give us feedback. We always welcome your ideas, suggestions, and recommendations. Send us your feedback at support@FretZealot.com or you can visit our site at www.fretzealot.com to help us improve our guitar learning app and give you more content and better features in the future.

TaxiMe e такси апликация, с която лесно, бързо и безпроблемно може да поръчаш такси в София.

Ние работим само с предварително подбрани, лицензирани таксиметрови шофьори, с които се возиш на стандартни за София тарифи (по-ниски или равни на: 1.22 лв/км дневна и 1.42 лв/км нощна).

- You choose the payment method - cash or card. 
- Get detailed information about the driver, car, and rates.

bluejetty:00013773:ios.description:
Make voice and video calls, send messages, and stay connected with Acrobits Softphone App, a powerful and feature-rich SIP softphone designed for all your calling needs.
BEFORE YOU BUY
Acrobits Softphone is a SIP client app. It does not come with phone service: you sign in with the SIP account your VoIP provider, PBX or employer gives you. Note: this app does not support call transfer or conference calling.
Acrobits Softphone works out of the box with many of the most popular VoIP providers and Bluetooth devices on the market. If you already have SIP service, from work or from any VoIP company, you are ready to go.
It brings all the popular features you expect from a SIP app, including support for 5G, voice and video calling, push notifications, call handover between WiFi and data, multi-device compatibility, lifetime access to support and updates, and more.
Keep a work line separate from your personal number. Carry a home-office extension in your pocket, or call over WiFi while traveling. Calls run over WiFi and mobile data, so your sip phone works wherever you have a connection, at home or abroad.
Bring the account you already have. Acrobits Softphone is a standards-based SIP client, so it registers with Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, hosted PBX platforms and everyday business VoIP services alike. Sign in with your SIP account and you have a business softphone dialer that carries your work line anywhere. Encrypted SIP calling keeps every conversation private.
Calls stay clear with support for popular audio standards, including Opus, G.722, G.729, G.711, iLBC, and GSM. Need video? It goes up to 720p HD with both H.264 and VP8. Pair it with the Bluetooth headsets and car kits you already use. Push notifications do the waiting, so the app stays reachable in the background. And voice is not the whole story: send messages from the same app when a call is too much.
You can set it up your way, with custom call settings, ringtones, and UI options.
And because it follows open standards, you are never locked in. Switch providers whenever you like and keep the same app, the same contacts, and the same settings.
Acrobits Softphone makes it easy to communicate with friends and family on any device. And it runs on virtually all iPhones and iPads.
Don't worry about hidden fees or subscriptions. You pay once, and lifetime support and updates are included. Secure VoIP is part of the deal rather than an upgrade. Try it today, and see why softphone users have trusted Acrobits since 2009.

bluejetty:00140179:ios.description:
THIS… is the Cars & Bids app — the ultimate automotive auction marketplace for the modern car enthusiast, brought to you by automotive reviewer Doug DeMuro. Whether you’re ready to put a new daily driver in your garage or bring home a museum piece on a trailer, Cars & Bids is the BEST platform for buying, selling, and connecting with over 500,000 car enthusiasts.
Some great features of the Cars & Bids app:
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Never miss an auction, and be the first to know when you've been outbid so you can get back in the game!
WATCH LIST
Want a notification when we list a new Porsche or BMW? Follow your favorite makes, models, and keyword searches to find the next car to add to your collection.
QUICK AND EASY TO SUBMIT
In just a few easy steps, you can find out if your car meets our criteria for the marketplace. If so, we'll be in touch every step of the way. Sell your car or truck quickly!
THE BEST PLACE TO SELL YOUR CAR 
We are quick to auction — listings can be ready in a week or less. You’ll have a dedicated contact from listing to post-sale, and your car will be promoted to our HUGE audience of passionate modern car enthusiasts looking for their next car.
COMMUNITY
Join our community to share your expertise with other car enthusiasts and chat with fellow car-lovers as well as Doug, Kennan, and other Cars & Bids personalities. Community is the place to post, share, and connect with your fellow modern automotive enthusiasts! Each model specific community is a gathering place centered around the cars and trucks that we own, lust after, and just love to discuss.

bluejetty:00126927:ios.name: GRIDS Post maker for Instagram
bluejetty:00126927:ios.summary: Instagram & TikTok design made easy. Grids is your go-to tool to easily manage your social media design - create cohesive Instagram layouts, design video covers, build seamless carousel posts, and use ready-made templates for reels and TikT
bluejetty:00126927:ios.description:
Instagram & TikTok design made easy. Grids is your go-to tool to easily manage your social media design - create cohesive Instagram layouts, design video covers, build seamless carousel posts, and use ready-made templates for reels and TikTok videos. Whether you’re a creator, brand, or small business, Grids helps you turn photos and videos into polished content for your feed, stories, and short-form videos.
PLAN YOUR INSTAGRAM LAYOUT
Use Grids to plan your Instagram layout with precision. Drag and drop photos into templates for Instagram - including post templates, templates for stories, and templates for reels. Create clean, on-brand Instagram design with auto-sliced photo grids, carousel posts, and high-quality layouts. Grids splits images for Instagram grids and publishes them in the right order - no manual work needed.
SEAMLESS CAROUSEL MAKER
With the seamless carousel post tool, you can split any photo or design into 2 to 10 perfectly aligned frames. The result is a fluid scrolling experience that grabs attention. These Instagram layouts are ideal for storytelling, portfolio spreads, tutorials, or simply adding a wow factor to your feed.
INSTAGRAM COLLAGES & LAYOUTS
Design unique photo collages by combining images, videos, stickers, and text. The flexible layout editor lets you adjust every frame - whether you’re building a minimalist grid or a creative spread. These layouts work for posts, stories, and even reels previews, giving you full control over your Instagram visual.
TEMPLATES FOR POSTS & STORIES
Access a rich collection of customizable templates for Instagram posts and stories. Add your own photos, adjust fonts, apply filters, and insert stickers or effects to personalize each template. Whether you’re working on a carousel post, reels teaser, or daily story, you’ll find an Instagram template that fits your content and helps you stay visually consistent.
REELS & TIKTOK TEMPLATES
Create scroll-stopping reels with our built-in reels maker. Choose from viral TikTok templates or Instagram reels templates, add text, effects, and music — then publish in minutes. Whether you’re a content creator or a brand, these short-form video tools help you create reels that stand out and drive engagement.
CUSTOM COVERS FOR REELS & TIKTOKS
Make your reels and TikToks stand out at first glance with custom video covers. Use the photo editor to design scroll-stopping freeze frames that match your Instagram layout or brand style. Add filters, stickers, text, and effects to create bold, consistent thumbnails that boost clicks and keep your grid looking sharp. Ideal for creators who want their short videos to look just as good paused as they do in motion.
ADVANCED PHOTO EDITOR
Design your content from scratch using powerful editing tools. Choose from a variety of fonts, filters, effects, and stickers to shape your content exactly how you want it. Ideal for users who want more than templates - this editor supports full creative freedom for Instagram layout perfection.
BACKGROUND & OBJECT REMOVER
Enhance your content with smart editing tools like background remover and object eraser. You can easily swap backgrounds, eliminate visual distractions, and create cleaner, more professional images for posts, stories, and reels. Perfect for polishing product shots, collages, or TikTok template visuals.
TRIAL & SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Start Grids Pro with a free 3-day trial. Once the trial is over, you’ll be charged a weekly or an annual subscription fee. Grids PRO will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Privacy Policy: https://wndr11.cy/files/Privacy_Policy.pdf
Terms of Use: https://wndr11.cy/files/Terms_of_Use.pdf

Tanto pelo site da Tecmóbili quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, ráp
bluejetty:00157792:ios.description:
Tecmóbili Condomínios
Tanto pelo site da Tecmóbili quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Tecmóbili, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para tecmobili@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00021980:ios.description:
This ASL app is specially designed to learn American sign language and help individuals to interact with auditory impairment, and connect with a whole new world. This ASL app will help you to converse with friends and family with auditory impairment.
With the years of sign language teaching experience, demographics and experimentation we have put together an app with the complete set of words and sentences needed by you to connect the in auditory word to the auditory world.
This app comes with an array of features that help make ASL learning fun and easy. ASL Study app is packed with basics to advanced asl content. ASL Learning was never easier to learn as they are now with the all-new American sign language app. This is the app to rely on with 450 common sentences and over 8500 words to connect you with the special world around you.
This app covers all the basics of daily life conversations, the homepage has the following features:
• Bookmark
 With the ASL study App, you can bookmark and save your favorite signs for later referencing.
• Date Time and Weather
 It is the basis of every conversation starter; days of the week, the months and seasons, signing time and
types of weather.
• Expression
 This part covers, common to daily life expressions, customary questions, and idioms.
• Emotions.
 This app helps ASL learners to express daily life feelings such as; positive, neutral and negative emotions.
• Lifestyle
 Whether you are a fashionista, a social media fanatic, a party guru or like other forms of entertainment.
It doesn't matter this app will help you Express your lifestyle choice.
• Sports
 This app will help you explore the world of sports in a way, you didn't think was possible.
• Food and Cooking
 Do you love cooking, are you a food junkie? Well, what are you looking for let's dive right into it then?
• Holidays
 Doesn't matter from what religion or ethnicity you are from, Do you love holidays? Let's start
celebrating then!
• Transportation and Travel
 Just pack your suitcase and get going, the whole world awaits you.
• Emergency and Disaster
 Our ASL Study app will help you convey your situation to the authorities in the most effective way
possible, with our ASL dictionary you are in safe hands.
• People and Family
 Let us help you recognize relationships like you never did before with the world of ASL. Connect with
every relation with the unique individual way it deserves.
• Education
 The early bird years will not be a problem now with our set off words and phrases perfect for the young
mind.
•Test Your Knowledge
 Test Your Knowledge section designed to keep track of your learning. You can attempt a quiz to see where you stand.
This app has been signed by individuals with auditory impairment, to help us bring the ASL world to you in it’s truest sense.
This is by far the best ASL learning app available in the market with a complete array of words and sentences. It’s just not an app it’s a vision, to help bring both worlds together.
Please contact us at aslstudyapp@gmail.com for your precious advice and suggestions, we look forward to improving what we have created to ensure customer satisfaction!
Let's ROCK!

ZUNA DELUXE is a classic marble shooter puzzle game that brings fast-paced action, colorful balls, and satisfying chain reactions to your mobile device. Aim carefully, shoot strategically, and match colors to stop the rolling marbles before they reach the end of the path.

+ Classic marble shooter gameplay – easy to learn, hard to master
+ Color matching puzzle mechanics with smooth ball shooting action
+ Hundreds of fun and challenging levels that increase in difficulty
+ Combo chains & special effects for rewarding high-skill plays
+ Adventure-style stages with mystical and ancient themes
+ Offline play – enjoy the game anytime, anywhere
*** Designed for casual gamers and puzzle lovers
Whether you’re looking for a relaxing offline puzzle game or an exciting arcade-style ball shooter, ZUNA DELUXE delivers hours of entertainment. Perfect for fans of classic marble puzzles, color matching games, and fast reflex challenges.
Download ZUNA DELUXE now and enjoy one of the most addictive marble shooter puzzle games on mobile!

Get the latest Illinois lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Lotto (with Extra Shot)
- Powerball

- Pick 3
- Pick 4
- HotWins
Lotto, Powerball, Mega Millions, Lucky Day Lotto, Pick 3 and Pick 4 also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support

bluejetty:00086819:ios.name: Tweek: Minimal Weekly Planner
bluejetty:00086819:ios.summary:
Super simple planner without the fuss. Tweek feels as natural as pen and paper.
It's a minimal weekly planner and to do list built around one clean week view, with no hourly slots and no clutter. Organise tasks, reminders and notes, share
bluejetty:00086819:ios.description:
Super simple planner without the fuss. Tweek feels as natural as pen and paper.
It's a minimal weekly planner and to do list built around one clean week view, with no hourly slots and no clutter. Organise tasks, reminders and notes, share your week with your family or team, and sync it both ways with the calendars you already use.
- Week, day and month views
Tweek opens in the week view by default, with no hourly scheduling. We think it's the best way to organise your life and work without stress. You see the whole week at a glance and simply move things around. Zoom into a single day planner when you need focus, or switch to the month view for the bigger picture. Use it as a weekly planner, a shared family calendar, or a simple day planner.
- To do list, notes, checklists and subtasks
Note down your thoughts in a text editor, break big items into subtasks, and build checklists. Attach files to any task, so the document you need sits right where you'll look for it. Everything lives next to the day it belongs to.
- Two-way sync with Google, Outlook, Apple Calendar and Reminders
Full two-way sync, not just import. Add or edit something in Tweek and it shows up in Google, Outlook and Apple, and anything you change there flows straight back into your week.
- Web, iPad and Mac apps
Tweek works on iPhone and iPad, on Mac, and in any browser. Start your week on your phone, plan it properly at your desk, tick things off on the go. Your calendar and your tasks are the same wherever you open them.
- Colours and custom themes
Paint any task any colour you like, and build your own colour theme for the whole calendar. A cosy highlighter and paper feel, in an aesthetic minimalist design.
- Reminders and custom recurring tasks
Get reminders by email or push notification so nothing slips. Set up recurring tasks on your own pattern: every few days, on specific weekdays, or whatever your routine actually looks like. Build it once and let it run.
- Share and collaborate
Share your whole weekly planner or just a single task, and work on it together with your team or family. A shared calendar that people actually read.
- Your printable paper planner template
Go beyond online planning. Print your week filled out or empty and do whatever you want with it: pin it to the wall, use it for a brainstorming session with your team, or hand your schedule to a client.
Questions or ideas? Write to us at hello@tweek.so
X: @tweekHQ
Threads: @tweek.so
www.tweek.so

Pray As You Go is a home for the rhythm of your prayer life. We are a Christian prayer app; an audio sanctuary enabling you to find space in your life, to root and recharge with consoling guidance and inspiration, available wh
bluejetty:00063930:ios.description:
Who are we? 
Pray As You Go is a home for the rhythm of your prayer life. We are a Christian prayer app; an audio sanctuary enabling you to find space in your life, to root and recharge with consoling guidance and inspiration, available wherever you go.
We use contemplative prayer reflection, scripture and music to help you embrace both the steady rhythms of daily devotion and the deep moments of discovering God.
All of our content is always free, no subscription required. 
What do we offer you? 
We have been accompanying prayer journeys for 19 years. At the heart of our work is our daily guided prayer session, lasting 10-13 minutes. Even in the short time, many people's lives have changed over the years through an encounter with Christ. 
Whether you're looking to have a steady rhythm with our daily prayers, or explore our wider content including Examen review prayers, imaginative contemplations, sleep prayers, mental health prayer guides or just to stay close to Scripture, we've got content for you.
We also have a range of prayers for children and guides available in sign language.
What spirituality do we use? 
We are based on the spirituality of St Ignatius of Loyola, and we're a work of the Jesuits in Britain. This involves the practice of slowing down, looking out for the movements of God in all areas of our lives and living out all of our contemplation by putting it into action. Although we are a Catholic app, our audience is from a wide range of denominations (fun fact: we're about 50% Catholic, 50% Protestant), so there's something for everyone! 
We’re here to help you embrace both the steady rhythms of daily devotion and the deep moments of discovering God, and we can't wait to be your companion on the journey.

bluejetty:00183366:ios.summary:

Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eatin
bluejetty:00183366:ios.description:
Struggle free, healthy recipes that are easy on the wallet. It’s as simple as that, and it’s a message that’s seen over 1 million people follow FitMenCook on social media.
Be honest, have you ever heard these complaints about healthy eating?
- “Eating healthy is too expensive!”
- “It takes too long! I don’t have hours to spend in the kitchen.”
- “Healthy food is too bland”
- “Meal prep is too complicated”
Kevin Curry, founder of FitMenCook, has been there. After spotting a picture of himself on a friend’s Facebook wall he knew it was time for a change.
He followed all the common advice, changed to a healthy diet and started hitting the gym.
For a few months, things were great, but after a while he found himself craving the old foods he was trying so hard to avoid.
He got his hands on every book he could find on nutrition and started experimenting in the kitchen.
His aims were simple:
A) Food should be easy to prepare and affordable
B) Food should be vibrant and tasty, never boring
C) Preparing food in advance is important
D) Following a, b, c helps you achieve your fitness goals
The results were a game changer for Kevin and now he’s sharing that message to the FitMenCook community on social media, inside the FMC app and as a bestselling cookbook author.
Top 5 features:
#1
SHOPPING LIST
We've taken the hassle out of grocery shopping. Add any recipes you want to your shopping list and we'll organise the list by aisle, so you can easily find the items you need.
#2
EASY STEP BY STEP VIDEO INSTRUCTIONS
If you’ve ever looked at recipe instructions and thought “this just looks too difficult for me” then you’ll find the included recipe videos very helpful. Not only is Kevin a great host, who’ll fill you with inspiration for healthy meals, but he’ll also break down the steps in a way that’s easy to follow.
#3
FOCUS ON MEAL PREP
Many of us don’t have time every day to spend in the kitchen.
Meal prep is the solution. Setting aside two days of the week as your main cooking days, you can prepare your meals in bulk and eat healthy all week.
This is a crucial part of the app, and many of the meals are designed with meal preparation in mind, to make healthy living fit with a busy life.
#4
MACRO COUNTING AND INTEGRATION WITH APPLE HEALTH APP
Every recipe includes nutritional information. Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber. You can also sync all this data to your Apple Health app.
#5
SCALE UP A RECIPE
Adjust the number of servings s by tapping the + and - buttons in the recipe view. You can also switch the measurements between metric and imperial.
There’s more including:
- Over 1000 recipes
- Search by ingredient: Type in Chicken Rice to see all recipes containing both of these ingredients
- Filter by tags
- Add recipes to favorites
- Add notes to recipes
- Share recipes with friends and family
- Available in English and Spanish
For a video demonstration of the app in action, take a look at: http://fitmencook.com/app/
Optional Meal Planner Subscription:
FitMenCook Pro is available as a monthly (0.99 USD) or yearly (5.99 USD) subscription. The subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing. Payment will be charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Your subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: http://nibbleapps.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: http://nibbleapps.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00014520:ios.description:
Og Money – Your All-in-One Digital Lifestyle Super App
Og Money is your gateway to smarter, faster, easier and more convenient digital life.
Whether you're shopping digital cards, topping up mobile lines, booking travel, sending instant transfers,
or unlocking exclusive deals, Og Money brings it all together in one secure lifestyle app.
Available in:
Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, Lebanon, and Egypt
What You Can Do with Og Money:
 • Buy or gift digital cards for gaming, shopping, and entertainment
 • Recharge mobile lines in your country and across 21+ international operators
 • Pay telecom bills, fees, and recurring services
 • Book travel services in-app
 • Send instant transfers to other Og Money users
Og Money Gift Cards:
Surprise someone with a digital gift—instantly. Choose from a wide selection of gift cards and send them
to friends and family in just a few taps and give them the freedom to shop all their favorite service from
Og Money app. Whether it’s for a birthday, celebration, or a simple thank you, Og Money makes gifting
fast, personal, and convenient.
Saving Bundles – Spend Less, Get More:
Get exclusive bundles that combine top-up cards, entertainment services, and shopping vouchers—all at
reduced prices. Designed to help you save on the categories you use most, Og Money’s saving bundles
offer unmatched value with every purchase.
In-App Deals and Promotions:
Discover ongoing offers, flash deals, and cashback campaigns—all inside the app. New promotions are
added regularly, so there’s always something to explore.
Secure. Seamless. Trusted.
 • Real-time confirmation for every transaction
 • Intuitive multilingual interface
 • Safe payments with built-in protection
 •. 24/7 in-app support available when needed
Og Money is your digital companion—built for speed, simplicity, and convenience.
Whether you're gifting, paying, recharging, gaming, shopping, or traveling, do it all in one place.
Download now and take control of your digital lifestyle.

bluejetty:00126728:ios.name: Metal Suit：Superhero Simulator
bluejetty:00126728:ios.summary: Alarm! Earth is under aliens’ attack! Humanity is on the verge of extinction! The world needs an iron hero! Become an avenger to guard the safety of humanity. Put on your iron suit and fight for freedom in the new superhero join & clash her
bluejetty:00126728:ios.description:
Alarm! Earth is under aliens’ attack! Humanity is on the verge of extinction! The world needs an iron hero! Become an avenger to guard the safety of humanity. Put on your iron suit and fight for freedom in the new superhero join & clash hero simulator! You’re the iron hero and the life of humanity depends on you. Create a marvel yourself!
ENDLESS SURVIVAL
How much do you like fighting games? Or better ask how much do you like fighting? Try out the new Endless survival mode and we’ll see! Match up super hero suit for future fights. Hordes of enemies, marvelous champions, aliens and other powerful heroes in the miraculous and harsh clash. Try to survive as many waves as you can and get bonuses for every killed enemy.
JUST DON’T DIE 
You have only 30 seconds to prove you are a superhero and to win your foes. Whoever dare to stand in your way – must be defeated! You are an iron hero and that’s it! You shall just not die.
ASSEMBLE A SUPERHERO IRON SUIT
Start your superhero adventure by crafting a real iron suit. Buy new parts and mighty Elemental Stones to unlock unique superpowers for future fights in your iron suit. Create a collection of suits to your personal taste. Train your fighting skills in Endless Survival and Just don’t Die modes. It’s only this iron suit that will save you in the epic battles!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR SUIT
Show the superhero league who you are.Your metal suit is your own business. Dozens of designs are here to reflect your personal taste and individuality. Show them all what style looks like!
FIGHT HORDES OF ENEMIES
Every epic battle you’ve seen in the movies is nothing compared to what you are going to face in this game! There are thousands of enemies deployed on Earth – you need all your fighting superhero skills to win the mass battles! Prove you are powerful enough to be called an iron hero! Become the leader of Earth’s defenders! 
BUILD A MEGA SUIT
The more parts of the iron suit you could get going through a location intact, the more spare parts you have to build a MEGABOT! Don’t let enemies leave a scratch on your super hero iron suit in these epic crowd battles! 
FIGHT THE BOSS
Are you ready to meet the mighty villain aliens? Okay, give everything you’ve got then! Tap tap tap fast and don’t leave your enemy a chance to beat you! Mash them up! You are the Iron hero!
Why you’ll love this metal suit fighting game:
- Awesome fighting gameplay
- Unique superpowers
- Pvp arena, endless survival and just don’t die modes
- New everyday missions
- Tons of upgrades
- Fun boss battle mechanics
- Simple controls
- Bright graphics
So, what are you waiting for? Iron hero, they need you! Become an avenger to guard the safety of humanity! Create an invincible iron suit to free the world from invaders! Download Iron Suit: Superhero Simulator action game now for free and start the epic battle game!

Unlock a new way to communicate with your feline friend using AI Cat Translator. This innovative app uses advanced AI technology to analyze and interpret your cat’s meows, helping you better understand their emotions and needs.
Whether your cat is hungry, playful, or seeking attention, AI Cat Translator listens to their vocalizations and provides a translation based on tone and frequency patterns. You can also use the app to "talk back" to your cat with a variety of sounds designed to mimic natural feline communication.

- Real-time cat meow recognition and translation
- AI-based analysis of cat emotions and behavior
- Soundboard with cat-friendly phrases to play back
- User-friendly interface for all ages
- Fun and educational tool for cat lovers
Note: While AI Cat Translator is designed for entertainment and bonding, it does not offer veterinary or behavioral advice.

bluejetty:00169852:ios.description:
Blood pressure diary app including weight tracker, blood sugar tracker, medication calendar and medication reminder.
An external blood pressure monitor is required to record values.
Approximately one quarter of the world's population is suffering from hypertension, 5% suffer from low blood pressure (hypotension). Many people do not even know that they are affected, as it usually come without symptoms. However, it is risk factor number one for cardiovascular diseases. Therefore people should check their values regularly and keep the data in a bp log.
At the end of 2018 we finally wanted to take high blood pressure management more seriously ourselves and started developing a smart blood pressure app: AVAX Blood Pressure Diary.
* CORE FEATURES
Some the reasons that make it the best free blood pressure app:
- Comprehensive charts help you to visualize longer periods of data.
- Statistics that follow current hypertension guidelines and that are easy to understand and give a clear picture of what your arterial pressure looks like.
- Our medication calendar let's you track your intake history and allows you to set up custom medication reminder to avoid forgetting to take your medication.
- The app can also remind you whenever it is time for you to take your blood pressure.
- A monthly status chart shows you if you are actively tracking our bp.
- Easily view your history and export it to CSV or XLSX. There is no limitation to get your data.
- New records can be entered in just a few seconds
- Weight tracker: Track weight (to see if there is a link) or manage weight loss.
- Diabetes tracker: We help you to track blood sugar and manage diabetes.
- Various customization options to make our bp app work you and not the other way round.
* USAGE INFORMATION & DATA PROTECTION
Protecting your personal data is very important to us. The key points here are:
- Login via google account or via email - or use the app completely anonymously (without login)
- We do not track any information that would help someone to identify you. Only your email address is being recorded (unless you do not use a login at all, of course)
- No data is being shared with 3rd parties
- No permissions on your phone or access to personal information is required
- An active internet connection is needed to syncronize across devices
* IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Finally, one last important piece of information: Our app is designed as a companion app for information only. Measuring with your home blood pressure checker, keeping a blood pressure log in a blood pressure tracker app should be part of your therapy, but it can't replace a doctor. We can not be made liable for any issues that occur as a result of using our hypertension app, our medication diary or weight tracker. Please consult your doctor to discuss hypertension management.
We hope you enjoy our app and it helps you to keep your diary and possibly even lower blood pressure levels or achieve weight loss. If you like us, we would be very happy about your feedback and rating.
If you have suggestions for features or encounter any issues, please reach out to us at info@avax.app
Start now with AVAX Blood Pressure Diary free of charge!
Terms of Use: https://avax.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://avax.app/privacy-policy

Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00120682:ios.name: TurboWords Spelling
bluejetty:00120682:ios.summary:
Using speech recognition, quickly build a spelling test from your own weekly school words. Record them in one stretch. Sit back and watch as they are recognized into text. It’s easy and fun!
Then play the test, rich with options. Hear an A
bluejetty:00120682:ios.description:
Using speech recognition, quickly build a spelling test from your own weekly school words. Record them in one stretch. Sit back and watch as they are recognized into text. It’s easy and fun!
Then play the test, rich with options. Hear an AI generated sentence made with the word to spell, on devices with Apple Intelligence. Seeing, hearing and writing your words will help you succeed in school tests. An amimo character (from French "ami" [friend] and "mots" [words]) says words of encouragement.
And finally, track your progress. See the results of your last three tests, individually for each word. Earn a shining star.
Alternatively, play one of five games using your words: hangman-style, crossword, word search, charivari and word shuffle.
Includes one sample group to get you started.
TurboWords lets you:
SETUP
• Record as many words as you need. Alternatively, type or paste them.
• Re-order, delete, edit or re-record your words.
• Create up to eight groups of words (lists). An unlimited number of groups can be purchased as a one-time in-app purchase, at a minimal cost.
• Receive and import groups created with TurboWords Parent/Teacher Edition.
TEST
• Play words sequentially or randomly, using your recorded voice or a synthesized voice.
• Hear an AI generated sentence made with the word to spell, on devices with Apple Intelligence.
• Type the words. Or write them on paper.
• Have instant feedback at each keystroke! Letters highlight green or red.
• Use a Hint button, if you’re stuck, pressing this button will reveal the next letter.
• Pronounce the word as you type each keystroke, if you wish.
• Go forward and backwards.
• Set a time limit, so that the next word is automatically played back, after a number of seconds that you set.
• Take partial tests.
• Focus on the words you have difficulty with, by excluding succeeded words from a spelling test.
CORRECT
• See the results of your test.
• Correct words.
• See a positive-reinforcement star, red and green lights showing your progress as you learn.
• Send test results by email.
PLAY
• Play Not Hangman while improving your literacy.
• Solve the crossword puzzle.
• Beat your high score in animated Word Shuffle game.
• Solve the word search puzzle.
• Experience the frantic pace of the one or two player game Charivari.
Steps to use the app:
1. Add a group for your words.
2. Record your words.
3. Take the spelling test.
4. Correct the test.
You will find contextual help on every screen. Portrait and landscape modes are supported. A multi-user option can be purchased. It allows multiple users on the same device. Users can be created with their name and photo (or AI generated image on devices with Apple Intelligence). Each user have their own groups of words.

bluejetty:00065824:ios.name: Breath Companion
bluejetty:00065824:ios.summary: Breath Companion is the complete interactive guide for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity. Explore Hyrule with a detailed offline map, track every collectible with smart checklists, and look up any
bluejetty:00065824:ios.description:
Breath Companion is the complete interactive guide for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity. Explore Hyrule with a detailed offline map, track every collectible with smart checklists, and look up any item, armor, weapon or enemy in seconds.
INTERACTIVE OFFLINE MAP
The whole of Hyrule, including both DLC packs. All map data works without an internet connection once downloaded.
- Sheikah towers, shrines and shrine quests
- Korok seeds with the solution for each puzzle
- Treasure chests, including DLC chests
- Main quests, side quests and memories
- Dragons, Guardians, Talus, Hinox and Molduga
- Great Fairy fountains, stables, shops and villages
- Enemy camps, wizzrobes, cooking pots and rafts
- Filter by type, region or completion state, and search the whole map instantly
CHECKLISTS AND PROGRESS TRACKING
Tick off shrines, koroks, quests, memories, treasures and more, straight from the map. Group and sort entries the way you like and watch your completion percentage climb.
COMPLETE GAME DATABASES
- Compendium with all creatures, monsters, materials, equipment and treasure
- Armor sets with defense values, set bonuses and full upgrade material lists
- Weapons, bows and shields with attack, durability and where to find them
- Enemies with health, attacks, drops and locations
- Recipes and elixirs with the exact ingredients and effects
- Trial of the Sword floor-by-floor guides
- Amiibo rewards and horse and dog rewards
AGE OF CALAMITY
Track your progress through the Warriors spin-off alongside the main game.
SYNC AND BACKUP
Your progress syncs automatically via iCloud. You can also export and import a backup file, or move progress to another device with a sync code.
MADE FOR PLAYERS
- Works fully offline, so it is ready even without a connection
- Light and dark theme with several accent styles
- Available in 20 languages
- Optional ad-free unlock
DISCLAIMER
Breath Companion is a third-party, unofficial companion app. The developer is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nintendo Co., Ltd. The Legend of Zelda, Breath of the Wild, Hyrule Warriors and all related names are trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd. All game content is used under fair use guidelines.

bluejetty:00123761:ios.name: Burger Shop 2 Deluxe
bluejetty:00123761:ios.summary:
Burger Shop 2 Deluxe is the paid version of Burger Shop 2 with exactly the same gameplay and levels. Our Deluxe game versions show NO ADS, collect NO USER DATA, and are completely playable forever with a small one-time purchase!
Burger Sh
bluejetty:00123761:ios.description:
Burger Shop 2 Deluxe is the paid version of Burger Shop 2 with exactly the same gameplay and levels. Our Deluxe game versions show NO ADS, collect NO USER DATA, and are completely playable forever with a small one-time purchase!
Burger Shop 2, the sequel to the wildly successful food making game, Burger Shop, is now available!
In Burger Shop, you successfully created a universal chain of restaurants and found fame and fortune... Until one day, you found yourself in a dumpster with a bump on your head, your diner boarded up, and no memory of how any of it happened.
Now in Burger Shop 2 you must rebuild your restaurant empire, adding new twists to your menu to entice new customers while uncovering the truth about what happened to your original hamburger chain. Use your time management skills cooking and serving food for hungry customers. Upgrade your kitchen to provide your customers with different types of food like hamburgers, cheese burgers, chicken sandwiches, French fries, onion rings, salads, pizza, donuts, waffles, pancakes, pasta, steak, cakes, pies, ice cream sundaes and much, much more! Can you dash around serving hungry customers tasty food and discover the truth of what happened to your original burger chain?
Join the Burger Shop 2 craze and grab ingredients from the BurgerTron 2000 to create tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced food shop game!
GAME FEATURES:
• 120 Story Levels and 120 Expert Levels!
• Challenge Modes and Relax Modes!
• Serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner!
• Over 100 different food items!
• Over 100 trophies to collect!
• Unlimited play!
Burger Shop 2 offers endless play with four different game modes!
GAME MODES:
• Story Mode - Rebuild your restaurant empire, and solve the mystery of who or what destroyed your original burger chain.
• Challenge Mode - Play fever-pitched, fast one-minute rounds - but don't lose a customer or it's all over! It's Burger Mania!
• Relax Mode - Serve food without any pressure or stress. Customers are infinitely patient.
• Expert Mode - So, you think you are the Burger Master Chef? Put your food-making skills to the test! 
Available in 11 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish, Indonesian, Russian, and Japanese.

bluejetty:00082742:ios.summary: List Ease is the ultimate free & fun grocery list app and shareable shopping list app designed to streamline your shopping experience. Whether you're a busy mom, a meticulous planner, or a spontaneous shopper, our list maker app has got you
bluejetty:00082742:ios.description:
List Ease is the ultimate free & fun grocery list app and shareable shopping list app designed to streamline your shopping experience. Whether you're a busy mom, a meticulous planner, or a spontaneous shopper, our list maker app has got you covered! 
A favorite of the TODAY Show's Today.com, Forbes ‘The Best Apps For Smart Black Friday Shopping’ and CNBC ‘A Stress-Free Holiday Is Only One App Away’, List Ease is the best grocery shopping list app around!
Create a shopping list, grocery list, to-do list, or any other checklist and share it with family and friends! 
Features of List Ease, your shared grocery shopping list app:
- Share your grocery list, checklist, or daily to-do list with family and friends with real time syncing
- Sync your grocery list with your other devices
- Track your spending by scanning & saving receipts
- Receive push message alerts when others on your shared list are purchasing checklist items or groceries
- Get list reminders when you walk into a grocery store
- Organize your shopping list any way you want – by food category, by recipes, or by available grocery coupons
- Add groceries into our shopping list app easily and instantly using our barcode scanner
- Add groceries from history – bring items from your last shopping list to your new list
- Trip budgeting - ensure your grocery list isn't too expensive before you shop
- Pantry inventory – simplify your life and save money by keeping track of already purchased items
- Manage multiple shopping lists –flip between grocery and pantry lists in seconds
- Perfect for Christmas, Thanksgiving, BBQs, and all event planning and holiday grocery shopping
- Add quantities, measurements, prices, and additional notes to your food list items to keep perfectly organized
- Calculate your costs to stay on budget
- Mr. Listo, our free grocery list app’s mascot, is your shopping list maker companion- at home or in the supermarket!
For in store reminders, be aware that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
List Ease is 100% Free!
Make your grocery shopping hassle-free and enjoyable with List Ease, the must-have grocery list app and shareable shopping list app. Try it today and never miss an item on your list again!

bluejetty:00155751:ios.description:
Jiffy Cabs App is the booking application for car services in St. John's, NL.
We are pleased to offer fast, convenient, and easy to use free Jiffy Cabs App.
Key Features of the Jiffy Cabs App include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Jiffy Cabs App with the push of a button
To begin using the Jiffy Cabs App today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Jiffy Cabs App retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed up the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Jiffy Cabs App or calling us at +1(709)722-2222
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Jiffy Cabs App in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00079580:ios.description:
Bible for Women is a beautifully designed, free mobile application, conceived with the single purpose to inspire and nurture the faith of women across the globe. Rooted in the teachings of the Holy Bible, this app brings the sacred scriptures of the Bible to life in a way that is practical, user-friendly, and easily accessible.
Whether you are in the cozy comfort of your home or managing the challenges of the outside world, our Bible app ensures that spiritual nourishment from the Bible is always at your fingertips. It offers a plethora of empowering tools that cater to the unique spiritual needs and experiences of women who seek guidance from the Bible. Our aim is to support women on their journey towards a deeper relationship with God through the Bible and to fortify their spiritual connections.
Our range of Bible-related features is just as varied as it is extensive:
- Start your day with thoughtfully chosen, inspirational Bible verses that echo the wisdom and spiritual insight typical of women. These Bible verses are handpicked from the Bible to inspire, motivate, and invigorate you, setting a positive tone for your day with the Bible.
- Receive daily reminders for prayers and meditation guides, crafted with the intention to enrich your soul with the teachings of the Bible. These guides offer a structured route for your daily spiritual journey with the Bible, helping you remain focused and connected to God.
- Our Bible Audio feature allows you to soak in scripture readings from the Bible, making it a perfect companion for the modern, busy woman. Whether you're commuting, exercising, or simply unwinding, this Bible feature lets you absorb the teachings of the Bible.
- The Bible app lets you make personal notes and highlight verses from the Bible that touch your heart. This interactive aspect turns your spiritual journey into a deeply personal experience, enabling you to contemplate, internalize, and document your thoughts and feelings about the Bible.
- For those who enjoy a little challenge, our Bible app includes engaging Bible quizzes designed to test and enhance your knowledge of the Bible. These quizzes add a touch of fun while also fostering a better understanding and recall of biblical teachings.
Bible for Women is more than just an app - it's a spiritual partner that effortlessly integrates the solace of the Holy Bible into your daily routine. It ensures that the wisdom of the Holy Bible is always available to you, even in offline mode. Every single feature is thoughtfully crafted to meet you where you are, empowering, supporting, and guiding you on your faith journey with the Bible.
This Bible app creates a direct and uncomplicated path to spiritual nourishment for every woman seeking a deeper bond with God through the Bible. Experience the transformative power of scripture, tailored exclusively for women, with Bible for Women. Download the Bible app today to unlock the sacred wisdom of the Bible and embark on a journey of self-discovery. Explore a world of biblical insight designed just for you, and let the Bible lead you towards a richer, more fulfilling spiritual life.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Support us subscription options: $2.49/month. These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. 
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. 
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of Services: https://sites.google.com/view/bible-for-women-termofservice/home 
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/bible-for-women-privacy-policy/home

bluejetty:00027525:ios.description:
Take control of your meetings with Attendant for Zoom. Easily manage audio/video, counts, raised hands, breakout rooms, chats, and your waiting room. Use Attendant as host/co-host while connected to a Zoom meeting from another device. Tap into these useful automations:
• Manage Breakout Rooms from your mobile device
• Unmute and lower a hand with a single tap
• Export participant list for record keeping
• Quick tap management of participant audio/video
• Manage participants from the video grid
• Search from the video grid
• Get attendee count (based on count in name)
• Actions to mute/unmute all and turn on/off all cameras
• Mute Everyone Else (everyone but selected participant)
• Turn Off Camera for Everyone Else (everyone but selected participant)
• Easily manage your Waiting Room
• Long press to take a quick look at a participant's video
• Chat with participants
• On iPad, open features in different windows to create your own dashboard and keep an eye on what’s important to you.
• Profanity filter can automatically delete chat messages that contain profanity (English-only).
Upgrade to Attendant Pro to unlock the following:
• Threaded chat and broadcast direct messages to multiple participants
• Automatically mute specific participants
• Always Admit: optionally choose to always admit specific names into your meeting
• Count attendance to quickly mark the number of attendees on each connection
• Auto readmit participants when they reconnect
• Video: configure size, manually sort, and configure external display
• Rename mode to quickly rename participants
• Optionally persist renames across multiple meetings
• Breakout room shuffle
• Configure comment workflow
• Comment counting
• Sort raised hands by time, name, or comment count
• Manage unlimited raised hands
• Themes & Icons
Please note that webinars are not currently supported. Attendant for Zoom uses the Zoom SDK but is not endorsed, certified, warrantied, or supported by Zoom Video Communications, Inc. If Zoom changes their policies or capabilities of their SDK this app may lose access.
If you choose to purchase an Attendant Pro subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00031340:ios.name: Play Nine: Golf Card Game
bluejetty:00031340:ios.summary: Experience the best-selling golf game, Play Nine: The Card Game of Golf, now available on the App Store! Challenge your friends and family with our exciting multiplayer game modes (Play With Friends and Multiplayer) in this fun family game.
bluejetty:00031340:ios.description:
Experience the best-selling golf game, Play Nine: The Card Game of Golf, now available on the App Store! Challenge your friends and family with our exciting multiplayer game modes (Play With Friends and Multiplayer) in this fun family game.
Play Nine is a simple yet entertaining game that will keep you challenged for hours. Hone your skills in our offline mode against AI or compete in multiplayer against your friends and family.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Enjoy closed online games exclusively with your favorite people. Share the game code via text or any platform to get started. Keep the fun going with our new in-game chat feature.
- Local mode for family games and friend games.
- In-game chat feature available.
- Custom game setup: choose the number of players (2-4) and holes (2-9).
- Perfect for family time and fun family game nights.
MULTIPLAYER
Challenge Play Nine fans worldwide! Join existing games or create your own.
- Online multiplayer games with players from around the globe.
- In-game chat feature available.
- Custom game setup: choose the number of players (2-4) and holes (2-9).
OFFLINE
Improve your skills by playing against the AI in our casual offline mode.
- Unlimited FREE gameplay against the AI.
- No time limits—resume your game anytime.
- Ideal for offline play while traveling.
- New offline game bots cater to every skill level.
FEATURES
- Easy to learn, simple to play.
- A safe family golf game for everyone.
- Collect coins by winning games and achieving milestones.
- A perfect card game for the family—fun for all ages, including kids and adults.
- Play offline in Airplane Mode or when you have no cell signal.
GAMEPLAY
Just like golf, the aim of Play Nine is to take as few strokes as possible. Limit your strokes by matching pairs and scoring a Hole-In-One. The player with the lowest score after 9 holes wins!
Each player receives eight cards, with a discard pile and draw pile in the center. Players flip two cards face up to start. Moving clockwise, players can draw from the deck or discard pile and replace one of their cards. They can also flip a facedown card if they don't want the drawn card. The goal is to match vertical pairs to reduce strokes. The player with the lowest score wins the hole.
For more detailed instructions, check the app or follow the in-game tutorial.
Find the physical card game on our website or Amazon.
Visit us on the web:
https://www.playnine.com
Like us on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/playninecardgame/ 
Follow us on Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/playninecardgame/
Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00180654:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
