bluejetty:00186563:ios.description:
== The Indian Air Force ===
• The Indian Air Force is the air arm of the Indian Armed Forces officially established on 8th October 1932. 
• Today, having completed the Platinum Jubilee of dedicated service to the nation, the Indian Air Force is a modern, technology-intensive force distinguished by its commitment to excellence and professionalism. 
• The Indian Air Force prides itself to put in its regular service the most advanced and cutting edge technologies in aviation, space & information technology. It is an early adopter of new and emergent tech, and demonstrates its leadership in implementing the nation’s policy objectives. 
• Inline with the Digital India initiative, the IAF has taken landmark steps like Online Tests for IAF recruitment, and an interactive mobile game to showcase the life of an IAF pilot. 
== Indian Air Force’s mobile gaming application ==
• The official mobile gaming application of the IAF will allow an aspirant to experience first hand the roles of an IAF air warrior, as well as means to apply and appear for recruitment from the comfort of his/her mobile phone.
• The gaming application will have various features, including offline single player missions, an online multiplayer and a career navigator information section as well as augmented reality features. 
=== Single player features ===
• Single player missions will be based on an engaging narrative, allowing the player to fly a wide arsenal of IAF’s aircraft assets. 
• The player will be taught how to handle a high performance aircraft via a tutorial mission – at the end of which, the player will earn his/her wings. 
• 10 engaging and high action missions will follow, which will allow the user to experience air power of the IAF, in the form of its response, reach, precision and flexibility, including support to other arms of the Indian Military, as well as aid to civil authorities in the form of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief. 
• The user will also learn about the IAF’s weapons and tactics, and how IAF’s new acquisitions will help in realizing the IAF’s future strategy. 
=== Multiplayer features ===
• The mobile gaming application will include online multiplayer, where players can engage with other like minded players over the internet. 
• Multiplayer game will have two modes – a squad vs squad where players team up, and a free for all, where the last man standing will be the winner. 
• The user will have the option of using long range missiles which go beyond visual range, as well as ability to go head-on against other players in dogfight mode. 
=== Schedule of release ===
• The official gaming application will be released in a phased manner in the year 2019. The first version, comprising of single player missions is being released in July 2019.
• The full version, including multiplayer features is expected to be released in October 2019. 
=== For support and contact, please use the following resources ===
• Websites
- Official site of the Indian Air Force: http://indianairforce.nic.in
- For Career Options: https://www.careerindianairforce.cdac.in
• Social Media Channels
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/indianairforce/

== The Indian Air Force ===
• The Indian Air Force is the air arm of the Indian Armed Forces officially established on 8th October 1932. 
• Today, having completed the Platinum Jubilee of dedicated service to the nation, the Indian Air Force is a modern, technology-intensive force distinguished by its commitment to excellence and professionalism. 
• The Indian Air Force prides itself to put in its regular service the most advanced and cutting edge technologies in aviation, space & information technology. It is an early adopter of new and emergent tech, and demonstrates its leadership in implementing the nation’s policy objectives. 
• Inline with the Digital India initiative, the IAF has taken landmark steps like Online Tests for IAF recruitment, and an interactive mobile game to showcase the life of an IAF pilot. 

== Indian Air Force’s mobile gaming application ==
• The official mobile gaming application of the IAF will allow an aspirant to experience first hand the roles of an IAF air warrior, as well as means to apply and appear for recruitment from the comfort of his/her mobile phone.
• The gaming application will have various features, including offline single player missions, an online multiplayer and a career navigator information section as well as augmented reality features. 

=== Single player features ===
• Single player missions will be based on an engaging narrative, allowing the player to fly a wide arsenal of IAF’s aircraft assets. 
• The player will be taught how to handle a high performance aircraft via a tutorial mission – at the end of which, the player will earn his/her wings. 
• 10 engaging and high action missions will follow, which will allow the user to experience air power of the IAF, in the form of its response, reach, precision and flexibility, including support to other arms of the Indian Military, as well as aid to civil authorities in the form of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief. 
• The user will also learn about the IAF’s weapons and tactics, and how IAF’s new acquisitions will help in realizing the IAF’s future strategy. 

=== Multiplayer features ===
• The mobile gaming application will include online multiplayer, where players can engage with other like minded players over the internet. 
• Multiplayer game will have two modes – a squad vs squad where players team up, and a free for all, where the last man standing will be the winner. 
• The user will have the option of using long range missiles which go beyond visual range, as well as ability to go head-on against other players in dogfight mode. 

=== Schedule of release ===
• The official gaming application will be released in a phased manner in the year 2019. The first version, comprising of single player missions is being released in July 2019.
• The full version, including multiplayer features is expected to be released in October 2019.

bluejetty:00041988:ios.description:
Dual NBack – Brain Training to Improve Memory
Dual NBack is a fun and challenging brain game designed to strengthen your working memory. Set goals, get reminders, and climb the global leaderboards as you sharpen your mind!
What Is Dual NBack?
Dual NBack is a memory-training game that presents audio (letters) and visual (positions) sequences simultaneously. Research suggests that consistent play may enhance your working memory—the ability to hold and process information briefly—and also boost short-term recall.
How to Play
The game starts at Level N=2, where you need to remember the position (square) and the sound (letter) from two turns back.
If the current position or sound matches what was shown two turns ago, tap the corresponding button.
Strong performance automatically raises your level, but you can manually adjust the difficulty whenever you like.
Key Features
Customizable Settings
Tailor your training: tweak the N-value (number of turns to recall), the interval between sounds/blocks, and session length as you see fit.
Reminders & Goals
Set daily or weekly targets and enable notifications to help you practice consistently.
Global Leaderboards
Compare your scores with players worldwide and see how you rank as you improve.
Share Function
Post your results on social media or messaging apps to challenge your friends and family.
Multilingual Support
Currently offered in English and Japanese, with more languages on the way.
Why Train Your Working Memory?
Working memory stores information for a few seconds to minutes, enabling you to make decisions, perform calculations, or tackle other cognitive tasks. Playing Dual NBack regularly can help strengthen this mental capacity, potentially improving focus, concentration, and overall brain agility.
Ad-Free Experience with Dual NBack Pro
Enjoy a 3-day free trial of Dual NBack Pro to train with no ads or interruptions.
If you choose to purchase Dual NBack Pro, the payment is charged to your iTunes account.
Renewal fees are charged within 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
You can cancel your subscription anytime:
Go to Settings → tap your name → Subscriptions → locate and cancel the subscription you want to end.
If you don’t cancel before the trial ends, the paid subscription automatically starts.
Privacy Policy: https://goukakuappli.co.jp/privacy
End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Strengthen Your Mind: Give your working memory a proven workout.
Adapt the Difficulty: Start at N=2 or set your preferred challenge level.
Stay Motivated: Leverage reminders, goals, and leaderboards to keep pushing your limits.
Go Pro for No Ads: Take advantage of a 3-day free trial and upgrade to an ad-free training experience.
Download Dual NBack now and take your cognitive performance to a new level!

bluejetty:00043723:ios.description:
Track barometric pressure today and forecasts anywhere.
Barometric Pressure Offline turns your device into a powerful barometer, altimeter, forecast, and pressure tracker. Check today’s barometric pressure, follow changing trends, explore upcoming forecasts, and keep a personal history wherever you go.
Live pressure and altitude readings come directly from your device sensors, so the barometer works even when you’re offline. Perfect for hiking, sailing, travel, outdoor activities, weather tracking, or simply understanding how atmospheric pressure changes throughout the day.
Key Features:
▶ Offline Barometer & Altimeter – Measure barometric pressure, sea-level pressure, and altitude directly from your device sensors without an internet connection.
▶ Pressure Forecast – See what’s ahead with interactive forecasts for Today, 72 hours, 7 days, or 16 days. Explore hourly pressure values, daily minimums and maximums, pressure tendency, and predicted rapid pressure changes.
▶ Pressure Change Alerts – Get notified when your device detects a significant pressure rise or drop, or when rapid changes are predicted in the upcoming forecast. Control barometer and forecast alerts independently, and tap a notification to jump directly to the relevant reading or forecast.
▶ Siri & Shortcuts – Ask Siri for pressure readings, forecasts, history, summaries, notes, and upcoming pressure changes. Use Shortcuts to access Barometer actions and build pressure tracking into your own automations.
▶ Spotlight Search – Find Barometer readings, forecasts, history, and other relevant content directly from Spotlight, then open straight to the corresponding reading, chart, or forecast.
▶ Migraine & Headache Tracker – Add notes to your pressure history and compare changes over time with migraines, headaches, joint pain, asthma, arthritis, or other pressure-sensitive symptoms.
▶ Pressure History – Look back at previous barometric pressure readings, trends, altitude measurements, and personal notes to better understand how conditions have changed.
▶ Export Your Data – Export pressure history and notes to CSV or JSON for your own analysis, records, or comparisons.
▶ Widgets – Keep current barometric pressure, recent history, trends, and forecast charts visible from your Home Screen and Lock Screen, including enhanced chart widgets and a portrait forecast layout.
▶ CarPlay Support – Check relevant pressure information while using CarPlay, with improved support for quick access on the road.
▶ Designed for the Latest Apple Platforms – Enjoy resizable layouts, enhanced widget appearances, clearer charts, improved navigation, and a responsive experience across supported screen sizes.
No account is required, and your sensor history stays on your device. Fresh forecast data requires an internet connection, while downloaded forecasts can remain available when you’re offline.
Whether you’re watching today’s weather, tracking an approaching pressure change, checking altitude on a hike, preparing for time on the water, or keeping a migraine and headache log, Barometric Pressure Offline puts the information you need in one clear, easy-to-use app.
Track pressure now. Understand the trend. See what’s coming next.
Terms of service:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00013775:ios.description:
Keep on top of everything in your head, whether it’s movies to watch or the details of your next big project. Designed for busy people who live by making lists to stay on track at work and home, the digital card based design is a clutter-free way to visualise everything that needs doing.
Collect your thoughts in a calm interface with simple natural language like “Water the plants every Saturday” then let Actions take care of reminding you automatically.
–––FEATURES–––
• Create Action Cards to note things you do not want to forget.
• Type naturally like “Post status report every second Friday” and Actions takes care of the scheduling, reminders and notifications.
• Drag and drop your Action Cards into custom Lists to organise them intuitively
• Colour code each list to further personalise your productivity system
• Use the Schedule to see all of the Actions coming up
• Swipe on Action Cards to complete them, delete them and set reminders.
• Add free-form notes to Action Cards for extra details like phone numbers
• Get push notifications, you can quickly choose reminders for the Morning, Afternoon, Evening or custom times
• Create repeating actions with advanced rules like “Call Sam every second Tuesday in June”
• Automatically and securely sync all of your Actions to the cloud instantly
• To keep your lists manageable, Actions will automatically suggest Action Cards that should be rescheduled or deleted
• Use the iOS Share extension to bring lists from other apps into Actions easily
• Use Siri to manage your actions for hands-free productivity!
Actions is a sophisticated app for getting things done, but it’s even more powerful if you have Timepage. With Timepage installed, your calendar events will automatically appear in the Schedule screen in Actions so you can see everything in context. In Timepage, you can see scheduled actions alongside your events. Master your calendar events and your to-dos with the ultimate productivity app duo!
–––MEMBERSHIP–––
Actions is a membership service with a free trial. Download the app free to try it out without restriction or registration. After the trial period you can choose to purchase a membership which allows unlimited use across all of your devices.
Without an active membership, you can still use the app in read-only mode.
• Unlimited access on all your devices.
• Both monthly and annual options available.
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00124090:ios.name: Nonograms 999
bluejetty:00124090:ios.summary:
The puzzle has 999 challenges. And they are all free! 
Easy controls makes solving the challenges a smooth experience. 
Therefore making it a perfect way to kill your downtime! 
* Nonograms 999 strong point
- The puzzle has 999 solutions.
bluejetty:00124090:ios.description:
The puzzle has 999 challenges. And they are all free! 
Easy controls makes solving the challenges a smooth experience. 
Therefore making it a perfect way to kill your downtime! 
* Nonograms 999 strong point
- The puzzle has 999 solutions.
You’ll never pay for any of the solutions, they are all free! 
There is no time limit for the puzzle, so feel free to play whenever you feel like it! 
- Designed to be easily used with just one hand.
While commuting or just riding the train, you always have one hand free for your smartphone, don’t you? 
With that in mind, Nonograms 999 was designed so you can play whenever the mood strikes.
- There is but one but one answer for each challenge
All the challenges are checked continuously so there will be no duplicate solutions. 
- Touch and virtual Joypad support.
- Save your progress
Closing the application in the middle of a solution.
In order to make those cases easier we have implemented an auto save feature so you can easily pick up where you left.
- Complete with an auto-fill function
Continuous clicking can be a drag.
In order to make the experience more enjoyable we have installed an easy auto-fill function, toggled by the simple touch of a button.
When the auto-fill function is turned on you just have to move your marker over the desired squares.
- Undo / Redo function
When solving your challenge it's easy to make a mistake or misclick.
In order to make it easy to correct such mishaps we have implemented a undo / redo function.
- Easy on the eyes design
For long playing session, we have designed the game with colors that are easy on the eyes.
In case you enjoy playing a bit before going to sleep, this easy on the eyes design will also be good due to the darker colors.
- All the challenges are handmade 
All the challenges within the puzzles are handmade by professionals.
Please enjoy all the challenges that were handmade by professionals!
* What kind of illustrations is there?
In total there is 999 illustrations.
You can pick from different sizes of canvas, 10x10, 15x15, 20x20, 25x25 and 30x30.
The illustrations include cute animals, sea creatures, sports, vehicles, fashion, food, electrical appliances and many others! So there is a lot of illustrations to pick from!
When you've cleared a puzzle it will automatically be saved to your selection screen.
*Is it easy to use?
Yes, the application has been designed so that anybody can use it.
You can paint your boxes by clicking in the desired box.
For the more advanced design with many boxes, it might be a little bit hard to hit your desired box so we have included an easy to use controller.
* What is Nonograms?
On the left side and above the puzzle there is a number that gives you hint on how many boxes to color on said row. With the help of those hints, you have to solve the puzzle and complete the illustration.
Also, Nonograms is called "Picross", "Griddlers" and "Picture logic puzzles".
*How to solve a Nonograms.
Every puzzle has numbers written on the left side and above the canvas.
These numbers are indicators on what boxes to paint.
The numbers above the canvas indicate what boxes to paint in the vertical columns.
The number on the left side of the canvas indicate what boxes to paint in the horizontal columns.
In cases where there is multiple numbers, that indicates two fields, with at least one open box in between.
In cases where there is no number written out, it means the entire column will be blank.
These are all the rules you need to follow in order to complete your illustrations!
Please enjoy this free game in order to challenge yourself during your free time!
In order to make Nonograms 999 free for everyone to use it relies on advertising.
Thank you for your understanding and please enjoy our application!

For the more advanced design with many boxes, it might be a little bit hard to hit your desired box so we have included an easy to use controller.


* What is Nonograms?
On the left side and above the puzzle there is a number that gives you hint on how many boxes to color on said row. With the help of those hints, you have to solve the puzzle and complete the illustration.
Also, Nonograms is called "Picross", "Griddlers" and "Picture logic puzzles".


*How to solve a Nonograms.
Every puzzle has numbers written on the left side and above the canvas.
These numbers are indicators on what boxes to paint.
The numbers above the canvas indicate what boxes to paint in the vertical columns.
The number on the left side of the canvas indicate what boxes to paint in the horizontal columns.

In cases where there is multiple numbers, that indicates two fields, with at least one open box in between.
In cases where there is no number written out, it means the entire column will be blank.
These are all the rules you need to follow in order to complete your illustrations!


Please enjoy this free game in order to challenge yourself during your free time!


In order to make Nonograms 999 free for everyone to use it relies on advertising.

Thank you for your understanding and please enjoy our application!

bluejetty:00120817:ios.name: AFPS Airplane Flight Pilot Sim
bluejetty:00120817:ios.summary: Take flight in real airplanes across the massively detailed open-world flight simulator. Explore sceneries and airports in high resolution with satellite maps, 3D buildings, runways, air traffic, weather conditions, and true volumetric clou
bluejetty:00120817:ios.description:
Take flight in real airplanes across the massively detailed open-world flight simulator. Explore sceneries and airports in high resolution with satellite maps, 3D buildings, runways, air traffic, weather conditions, and true volumetric clouds.
More than 150 km² of the area!
Perform a wide variety of missions to become a professional airplane pilot.
!!Airplane Flight Pilot Simulator is the ultimate plane flying simulation with 20 free levels!!
You can drive different vehicles, like cars, helicopters, and planes.
One of the best airplane flight simulators with dynamic weather conditions and realistic day and night cycle, with clear skies, tropical rain, snow, thunderstorms, wind, turbulence, and true 3d volumetric clouds!
Fly and explore the massive open-world environment and its unique locations, take off from 7 airports, commute from international airports to small campaign airports.
There's also tons of point of interest to explore, like rivers and lakes, big city, small town, nuclear power plant, port, Japanese temple, different houses and farms, ruins, camping place, and more...
Drive fast cars on the open roads, from 2x2 lanes to very small offroad road of mountains, with hill climb and canyon. Explore the world not just by flying, but with real car driving simulator experiences as well!
Explore the map and find one of the mission markers to launch a mission. Simply walk into the marker to begin the mission like any familiar open-world style gameplay.
Use the helpful minimap to know where are the missions spots. Press it to expand the whole map. Fly across the open-world and explore for hours in one of the best airplane flying simulation games!
Example of missions:
- Random flight problems (landing gear problems, engine failure, etc.) to test real piloting situations
- Transport passengers
- Escort the president with Airforce (F-18)
- Help victims after a plane accident
- Fly through all the checkpoints as fast as possible
- Land on an aircraft carrier
- Learn to take off and land on a runway, and full flight
- Emergency landing on the water
- Control your aircraft during a tempest
- Attach a banner in your aircraft to do some advertisement
- Race against helicopters
- Land your aircraft during an engine failure
Features:
- Weather forecast: clear sky, rain, thunderstorms, snow
- Day and night cycle
- True 3D volumetric cloud system
- Fly turbulence
- Realistic plane flight physics
- Intuitive flying controls: buttons, joystick, or accelerometers
- Plane crashes and smokes effects.
- Dynamic lighting and sound effects to recreate the realistic experience
- High-quality world environments with high res satellite imagery
- Highly detailed realistic airplane cockpit environment.
- Multiple on-board cameras to get every angle of the jet
- Huge selection of aircraft and airline
- Ultimate racing challenge game
- Hugely open-world driving simulator
- Miles of roads to drift and drive on and do stunt jumps
- Map Informations(Distance, Altitude, etc.)
- Fully interactive cockpit environment and controls
List of airplane :
- Cessna 182
- Embraer Legacy 600
- Piper PA-46
- DHC-6 Twin Otter
- Boeing 777 airliner
- PZL-104 Wilga
- Pitts special
- Piaggio P180 Avanti
You can adjust the quality button to play without lag.
This is some of the most difficult flight situations ever! Test your plane flying skills and car driving!
The latest and one of the best challenging games. Become the ultimate airplane flight pilot in the all-new simulator gaming sensation, Airplane Flight Pilot Simulator!

bluejetty:00175169:ios.description:
Log in with your Hollandamerica.com account and get access to your current profile and information, and all of your past or upcoming bookings.
Before your cruise, you can review all the services available to guests, check out events and shore excursions planned for your trip, and review an interactive Holland America Line fleet map to see the destinations where our ships sail.
Once on board, connect to the ship’s WiFi to view dining menus, spa services, shore excursions, chat with other guests and more at no additional charge. (An onboard Internet purchase is NOT required to use the Navigator app.)
Use the Holland America Line Navigator app when in port to check your daily itinerary, book shore excursions and make dining reservations. So, you can just relax and enjoy your time ashore, knowing you’ll never miss an important event during your cruise.
Happening On Board
Get the latest on events, activities, and the evening dress code even before you board. See planned events and add them to your itinerary.
Chat
Keep in touch with traveling companions, connect with new friends, and more while on board.
Shore Excursions
Reserve and book your shore excursions easily and conveniently.
Dining
Make reservations at any of the ship’s specialty restaurants.
My Itinerary
Stay on top of your daily activities, including your booked shore excursions, and dining reservations.
Fleet Map
See the entire Holland America Line fleet of ships and learn about their destinations and ports of call.
My Account
View account details, see your upcoming bookings and review your onboard statement.
At Your Service
Order items like towels, pillows, ice and more straight to your stateroom. (Available on select ships).
View & Buy Photos
Review, purchase, and share your cruise photos. (Available on select ships).
Daily News
Enjoy a selection of complimentary daily news digests from various regions of the world.
Spa & Salon
View our extensive menu of spa treatments and services.
Connect to Paid Internet
Navigator is your portal to purchase and use additional internet plans.
It doesn’t matter if you are new to cruising or a returning guest, Navigator is available and works with all Holland America Line ships with full functionality... so download today!
Full Holland America Line fleet includes:
Amsterdam, Eurodam, Koningsdam, Maasdam, Nieuw Amsterdam, Nieuw Statendam, Noordam, Oosterdam, Rotterdam, Veendam, Volendam, Westerdam, Zaandam, and Zuiderdam.

Learn birds the fun way!
Learn to identify the birds that you're seeing and hearing. Take birding and birdwatching to a new level!

bluejetty:00129164:ios.name: Groz TAXI
bluejetty:00129164:ios.summary:
Закажите Groz TAXI в городе Грозный через приложение. Это в 3 раза быстрее, чем по телефону! Между желанием доехать до нужного места и поиском автомобиля — пара секунд.
+ Тарифы под ваши задачи: быстрая подача, эконом, комфорт, комфорт +,
bluejetty:00129164:ios.description:
Закажите Groz TAXI в городе Грозный через приложение. Это в 3 раза быстрее, чем по телефону! Между желанием доехать до нужного места и поиском автомобиля — пара секунд.
+ Тарифы под ваши задачи: быстрая подача, эконом, комфорт, комфорт +, женское такси, бизнес, доставка. 
+ Экономьте свое время даже в мелочах 
Адрес подачи определится автоматически. Вам остается указать, куда вы поедете. Используйте шаблоны с адресами и настройками, которыми чаще всего пользуетесь, чтобы заказать такси в пару кликов.
+ Никаких проблем с оплатой 
Оплачивайте поездки наличными, картой или накопленными бонусами.
+ Хотите экономить на поездках? У нас есть бонусы 
Приглашайте друзей в приложение, поделившись специальной ссылкой, чтобы и они могли воспользоваться удобным сервисом. А еще зарабатывайте бонусы с помощью реферальной системы или используйте временные промокоды. Оплачивайте ими и экономьте на поездках.
+ Забыли что-то добавить в заказ? 
Отредактируйте его: поменяйте пожелания, остановки, адрес назначения и тариф.
+ Заказали такси, но не видите водителя? 
Спросите в чате приложения, где он находится, или отправьте ваши координаты с помощью одной кнопки.
+ Нужно заказать такси родственнику или другу? 
Используйте опцию "Вызвать такси другому" в разделе "Пожелания" и укажите его номер телефона. Когда такси подъедет, на указанный номер придет СМС, а вам — сообщение в приложении. Также вы можете поделиться информацией о своем заказе, просто скинув ссылку. Близкие люди будут точно знать где вы и с кем.
+ Планируете важную встречу, у вас рейс на самолет/поезд? 
Выберите опцию "Предварительный заказ". Поиск автомобиля начнется незадолго до заказа поездки, и автомобиль приедет к назначенному времени. Также вы будете заранее знать стоимость поездки.
+ Сократите время ожидания такси 
Спешите по делам? Увеличьте стоимость заказа, и водитель приедет на заказ быстрее. 
+ Понравилась поездка? 
Поставьте оценку водителю, напишите отзыв или выберите реакцию из готовых шаблонов.

bluejetty:00133573:ios.description:
Welcome to Spades Cash game! Embark on an exciting journey in this fresh Spades gaming experience, where you have the chance to win real cash and other amazing prizes!
Spades Cash offers solo gameplay, allowing each player to earn individual points while competing against participants from around the globe in thrilling tournaments for lucrative cash rewards! The best part is, your gaming sessions will remain uninterrupted as we ensure an ad-free environment! Don't hesitate - download the game now and unleash your skills to compete for some serious CASH!
HOW TO PLAY:
• Join head-to-head or multiplayer tournaments.
• Engage in fierce competition against real opponents of similar skill level. Each player receives the same game board, turns, and time limits.
• Outsmart your opponents and claim victory with fabulous CASH PRIZES!
1V1 TOURNAMENT - Once you feel confident in your abilities, dive into our tournaments and challenge other players for the chance to win fantastic rewards! Good luck and have a blast!
Game Features:
• SOLO mode - You don't need to worry about the opponent's level, fight for yourself and strive for the highest score.
• Face challenging and competitive AI opponents in the game.
•Comprehensive tutorial - Easy-to-follow instructions and scoring rules to help beginners get into the game swiftly.
• Immerse yourself in an outstanding visual experience - Enjoy captivating graphics and beautiful game themes.
• Say goodbye to ads - We provide an uninterrupted gaming experience.
• Skillz® Random ensures fair gameplay conditions, allowing only the most skilled competitors to triumph!
• Race against the clock to maximize bonus!
• Free to play & without ad interruptions.
Please note that prize tournaments are not available in the following states: AZ, AR, CT, DE, IN, LA, ME, MT, SC, SD, and TN. However, if you reside outside a real prize-enabled region, you can still enjoy the game with our virtual currency for some delightful fun!
If you have any questions feel free to reach us at dailypuzzle@hotmail.com
If you have any questions about the Skillz® system or cash tournaments please contact: support@skillz.com

bluejetty:00068388:ios.summary:
Redefining Women's Fitness, One Hourglass At A Time 
Dive into home and gym workouts tailored to emphasize your waist and curves, suitable for every body type. Complement your training with delicious recipes and become part of a community
bluejetty:00068388:ios.description:
Redefining Women's Fitness, One Hourglass At A Time 
Dive into home and gym workouts tailored to emphasize your waist and curves, suitable for every body type. Complement your training with delicious recipes and become part of a community that not only inspires and motivates but also stands by you, holding you accountable at every fitness juncture. Created by Lyzabeth Lopez, founder of the Hourglass Workout.
Unlock Your Ultimate Potential, On Your Schedule:
* Diverse Workouts: Engage in a variety of sessions, each tailored to redefine your silhouette. Whether you’re at the gym or at home, have an hour or just 10 minutes, there’s a workout for you.
* Step-by-Step Guidance: Each move detailed to perfection, ensuring you train effectively and safely.
* On-Demand Training: Flexibility at its finest - train anytime, anywhere, even with minimal equipment.
Eat Right, Feel Amazing:
* Tasty & Nutritious Recipes: Enjoy meals that fuel your workouts and tantalize your taste buds.
* Streamlined Meal Prep: Integrated grocery lists make planning your meals a breeze.
Visible Progress, Tangible Results:
* Set & Achieve: Clearly define your fitness goals and use the app to journey towards them.
* Track Your Evolution: Record your workouts and witness your progression towards an hourglass figure.
Join, Engage, Transform:
* Empowering Community: Connect with a global network committed to fitness and supportive of every member's journey.
The Train With Lyzabeth app provides both monthly and annual subscription options with a 7-day FREE trial.
The TWL App is offered as a 7-day free trial and then will continue as a subscription length of one month and billed at $12.99/mth USD. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription lengths will auto-renew each month for a one-month period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the $12.99/mth USD renewal. Subscriptions to the Train With Lyzabeth app may be managed by yourself as a user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. There will be no cancellation of a current subscription during an active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a user purchases a subscription for the one month renewal period"
Privacy Policy: https://lyzabeth.plankk.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://lyzabeth.plankk.com/tos

Client management

Progress tracking

* WhatsApp integration — fast and personal communication with your clients

bluejetty:00160143:ios.description:
Welcome to My Lovely Planet, the adorable match-3 puzzle game where completing levels supports real-world causes, the ones you choose!
In this fun and relaxing journey, you'll solve the cutest puzzles, collect stars, and turn them into real action: planting trees, protecting oceans, saving wildlife, and more.
And the best part is: it's real and it's free ! Every star you collect is transformed into money donated to the cause of your chosing !
Pick the cause closest to your heart, and start making a difference!
Features:
- Swift match-3 gameplay with fun levels for both newcomers and match-3 experts!
- Choose your cause: reforestation, ocean protection, wildlife rescue, and more
- Collect stars to help your NGO and fund actions.
- Join the adorably whimsical Mama Nature in her journey around the most breathtaking landscapes of the world
- Compose heartwarming nature Scenes: join the animals at their picnic day in the forest, dive with the snow monkeys into the thermal pools, and many more!
- Collect Mama's crafts! Reach level 41 to unlock this feature, in which you get to complement each Scene with 7 objects handcrafted exclusively by Mama N.; see the animals react to them!
- Get rewards by completing Scenes: coins, boosters, and power-ups!
- Check anytime the impact you've had and what the whole community has achieved together!
My Lovely Planet is 100% free to play, though some in-game items can optionally be purchased for real money. With each purchase, you're contributing directly to the cause you've chosen.
And the best part is: it's real and it's free ! Every star you collect is transformed into money donated to the cause of your chosing !

bluejetty:00152276:ios.description:
Welcome to Hot Pot Go, the tasty way to test your brain with logic, flavor, and fast-paced fun! If you're a foodie who loves cooking games, match puzzles, and free food games, you're in for a delicious treat. Pick up and serve everything, including all kinds of seafood, veggie, meat and fish cake, from the boiling jam hotpot in this juicy 3D puzzle game.
Inspired by hit cooking games, Hot Pot Go brings the perfect blend of addictive food sorting game mechanics and satisfying taste match action — all in one delicious game!
Gameplay Overview:
You’ll need to collect tasty pieces of food from a mix in the hot pot and place them into matching plates. Think carefully before picking up pieces into temporary slots, or you’ll use up those slots quickly and lose the game! Let's sort all out of the jam!
Juicy 3D Puzzle Game Style:
Immerse yourself in realistic hot pot scenes and beautifully designed ingredients. You’ll feel like you’re right there at your favorite hot pot restaurant!
Enjoy the tasty looking food and satisfying realistic 3D puzzle effects as you tap and sort foods into plates
Match Game Meets Cooking Game:
Mix the best of match 3 and food jam mechanics with the strategy of a food sorting game! You’ll enjoy a perfect blend of relaxation, satisfaction and mental challenge in a delicious food world.
What’s on the Menu? Let's find out the most flavorful ingredients!
Seafood delights 
Fresh veggie stacks 
Savory meat dishes 
Tasty fish cakes of all kinds.
Various experiences of hotpot
Ready for a cozy hot pot meal?

bluejetty:00036415:ios.description:
This is a game that can be played non-stop. What kind of experience will it be when Summon Dragon io is combined with synthetic gameplay?
How to play
Summon gameplay
The player controls the tadpoles to continuously collide with other marine creatures smaller than themselves and continue to upgrade until the tadpoles jump the dragon gate
Players can get gold coins in the game, and gold coins can buy a variety of skins for experience.
It is not so easy to synthesize Shenlong! Remember to move, move, move
Synthetic dragon gameplay
Players use gravity to drop new sea creatures, which can be upgraded when two identical creatures collide to stop synthetic dragons. Shenlong can accumulate, compare and see who can combine more
Synthetic Tadpoles
The reverse gameplay of synthesizing Shenlong is twice as difficult. Synthesizing tadpoles from dragons is quite a test
I hope you like it, if you have any suggestions, welcome to comment, thank you

Best rates: We strive to provide you with the best rates possible and even allow you to check your rates from pick-up Point to Destination ahead of time.

If you facing any issues with the app or have any suggestions, you can email us at info@riderove.com or speak to one of our agents at any time on 1812888.
Follow our Social Media Accounts:
Instagram: @rideroveapp
Tik Tok: @rideroveapp
Ride Rove’s services are 24/7 and only available in Kuwait.
Ride, Relax, Reach.

bluejetty:00128315:ios.description:
OTP MobilBank
Download the app and apply for a personal bank account from your mobile, even with a selfie!
Join the nearly 2 million users and manage your daily finances with the OTP MobilBank app!
Bank simply, digitally!
Why choose OTP MobilBank?
With OTP MobilBank, managing your finances has never been easier and more convenient. Whether it’s opening an account, handling transactions, or managing your savings, everything is easily accessible in one place on your mobile.
Key features and benefits:
• Account opening with selfie identification: Open a bank account from anywhere with just a selfie. Just a few steps and you're done!
• Expense tracker: Do you want to know how much you spend in each month? The app can automatically categorises your expenses, so making your finances more transparent.
• Push notifications: Receiving instant push notifications about every card transactions and account movements, keeping you always up to date.
• Transaction history: See all transactions in one place, transparently, including pending and rejected items.
• QR code bill payment: Pay your postal bills quickly and conveniently with the QR code payment option.
• OpenBank service: Get a comprehensive view of your finances! With the OpenBank service, you can also view the balances of your current accounts held with other banks, so all your financial data is available in one place.
More useful features:
• Instant and scheduled domestic HUF transfers
• Querying, blocking, and setting daily limits for your bank card 
• Creating and modifying direct debit orders
• Viewing quick balance without logging in
• Querying your account details and credit limits
• Managing savings (securities, fixed deposits)
• Purchasing government bonds, bonds, and investment funds
• Applying for personal loans
• Checking transactions
• Arranging travel and lifestyle insurance
• Applying for car prize deposits
• Login into the new OTP InternetBank service with QR code scanning or by push notification
• Setting up shopping discounts
• Querying currency/exchange rates
• ATM and branch locator
• Booking branch appointments
The OTP MobilBank is still evolving, new features and opportunities are constantly added to enhance the user experience. Registration is required, which you can complete on your mobile device after downloading and opening the app. To register, you need an OTPdirekt internet banking contract, so have your contract details ready for the registration.
You can read more about the OTP MobilBank app here : https://www.otpbank.hu/portal/hu/Uj-IBMB-kisokos/ 
By downloading and using the app, you accept the OTP Bank "Privacy Policy," which provides information about the handling of your personal data.

bluejetty:00015698:ios.description:
Explore the playful side of physics! 
“I just love how apps like these get kids genuinely excited about science." — COOL MOM TECH 
Experiment with levers, pulleys, inclined planes, inclined planes, wedges, wheel and axles, and screws. Discover how they work and investigate the invisible forces behind them in this sandbox app. Destroy a castle, make music, send satellites into orbit & more! 
*** App Store Editor's Choice ***
*** Parents’ Choice Gold Award winner ***
Simple Machines integrates with STEM curriculum: kids can alter and test each machine to learn about force and motion, actions and reactions, inputs and outputs, conservation of energy, mechanical advantages, and tradeoffs. Get free activity sheets at tinybop.com.
Simple Machines is No. 4 in Tinybop’s Explorer’s Library series, designed for curious kids ages 4+ to dive deep into big ideas. The apps in this series have won Best of the App Store, App Store Editors’ Choice, Parents’ Choice, and Children's Technology Review Editor’s Choice awards.
Features: 
 * Explore 6 simple machines: levers, pulleys, inclined planes, wedges, wheel and axles, and screws.
 * Experiment with real world physics, actions and reactions, inputs and outputs. Learn about force and motion.
 * Investigate the physics at work behind each machine.
 * Sophisticated sound design rewards experimentation.
 * Original artwork by James Gilleard.
 * Smart features use your device’s camera to bring your kids’ world into the app.
 * Learn new vocabulary in 40+ languages with interactive labels.
 * Intuitive, safe, and kid-friendly design.
 * Entertaining for kids and adults alike.
FREE handbook
Our expert-reviewed handbook is full of facts, interaction hints, and discussion questions to support learning in this app, in the classroom or at home. Download in your app or at: http://tinybop.com/handbooks. 
Privacy Policy 
We take your and your child’s privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your child, nor do we allow any third-party advertising. 
When the camera, microphone, and other services are used within an app, your information is neither collected nor distributed outside of the app.
Read our complete privacy policy at tinybop.com. 
Tinybop, Inc. is a Brooklyn-based studio of designers, engineers, and artists. We make toys for tomorrow. We’re all over the internet.
Visit us: www.tinybop.com
Follow us: twitter.com/tinybop
Like us: facebook.com/tinybop
Peek behind the scenes: instagram.com/tinybop
We love hearing your stories! If you have ideas, or something isn’t working as you expect it to, please contact us: hi@tinybop.com.
Compatible with iPhone 5, 5s, 5c, 6, 6 Plus, iPod touch (5th generation), iPad 2, 3, mini, and Air. **This app is optimized for iPad 2 and iPhone 5 or higher. Requires iOS 7.0 or later. 
psst! It's not Tiny Bop, or Tiny Bob, or Tiny Pop. It's Tinybop.

bluejetty:00200028:ios.name: 2Do: To Do List & Task Manager
bluejetty:00200028:ios.summary:
"2Do adapts to my needs, not the other way around. 2Do gets me." — MacStories
2Do is a to do list, task manager and daily planner in one, with a simple, fluid interface wrapped around a deep and flexible set of features. Keep a quick check
bluejetty:00200028:ios.description:
"2Do adapts to my needs, not the other way around. 2Do gets me." — MacStories
2Do is a to do list, task manager and daily planner in one, with a simple, fluid interface wrapped around a deep and flexible set of features. Keep a quick checklist, run a full GTD® system, or anything in between: there is no wrong way to use 2Do, and it never forces a methodology on you.
One-time purchase. No subscription, no account to create, no strings attached.
TYPE IT THE WAY YOU'D SAY IT
• New: natural language input. Type "Call the dentist tomorrow at 3pm #health" and 2Do fills in the due date, time and tag as you type
• It reads dates, times, repeats, alerts, durations, priorities, tags, lists and saved locations, in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Russian
CAPTURE ANYTHING, FAST
• Quick Add: touch and hold [+] and file task after task, with dates, tags and lists as you type
• Siri & Shortcuts: add tasks by voice, or wire 2Do into routines that do the whole job
• Widgets, Lock Screen and Control Center, so capture never waits for the app
• Mail to 2Do: your device gets a private email address, and anything you send it lands as a task, checklist and all
• A GTD® Inbox for everything not yet sorted
SIMPLE TASKS, OR AS MUCH MORE AS YOU NEED
• Start with a task, grow it into a checklist or a project with sub-tasks
• Notes in Markdown, styled as you type, with links collected for you
• Flexible repeats, start dates that hide tasks until they matter, durations, and actions that make the next call or message one tap away
• Attach images and voice notes
SMART LISTS: SAVED SEARCHES WITH SUPERPOWERS
• Search across titles, notes, tags and dates; sounds-like matching finds it even when you can't spell it
• Save any search as a one-tap view: your weekly review, stalled projects, errands nearby
• Focus filter: set a rule per list and one tap hides everything that can wait
TAGS THAT SORT EVERYTHING
• One tap on a tag filters your day to that context; Tag Groups keep big collections tidy
• Pause a tag and every task carrying it steps out of view, hidden, not deleted, until you're ready
NEVER MISS A THING
• Stack multiple alerts on a task and let 2Do nag until it's done
• On iOS 26.1 and later, an alert can ring like a Clock alarm: full screen, through Silent mode, until you answer
• Nearby: location reminders that fire when you're close enough to actually do the task
• See your calendar events right above your tasks, so plans never collide
COLLABORATE
• Share your lists and complete work together with others over WiFi without needing a cloud service
• Share read-only or editable lists and collaborate together over iCloud
SYNC YOUR WAY
Most apps decide where your data lives. 2Do thinks that's your call:
• iCloud: uses the account already on your device; syncs tasks, Smart Lists, tags, groups and attachments
• Apple Reminders: your tasks live in Reminders too, so Siri and everything that reads Reminders can see them
• Todoist: connect your account and run your Todoist projects right inside 2Do
• Dropbox, Toodledo, Fastmail, or any CalDAV server you trust, including one you run yourself
MADE FOR ONE HAND
• Slide between your lists, tasks and a utility panel with Tags, Nearby and Calendar Events; one thumb runs all three
• Pinch to zoom between three levels of detail
• Quick Open: type a few letters, land on any task or list
• Batch edit and drag & drop: defer, tag or move a whole stack of tasks in one go
YOURS, PRIVATELY
• Lock individual lists or the whole app
• Automatic backups, with single-list restore for the day something goes wrong
• Apple Watch app with complications
2Do has been refined over years of careful work, with feedback from students, parents, professionals and lifelong list-keepers along the way. Use it as a simple list, or push it into full GTD® territory. Either way, it's ready.

This comprehensive guide to cat training and health care is perfect for both new kitten parents and experienced cat owners.
Meowz will answer all your questions about raising a healthy, well-adjusted, and happy pet.
Key features inside our app:
• Cat care tips — Keep your pet healthy and happy with our cat app. Learn how to create a cat-friendly home, a comfortable sleeping area, and environmental enrichment. Get advice about grooming, stress-free transportation, engaging cat games and toys, cat-alone time, and more.
• Cat health guide — Detailed cat and kitten health and vaccination checklists to help you stay on top of your pet's health and well-being. Be prepared with comprehensive first-aid advice.
• Cat training lessons — Step-by-step guides for cats and kittens of all ages. Teach your pet fun tricks like the high five, nose touch to finger, and spin around.
• Breed Identifier — Discover your cat's breed in seconds. Simply upload a photo, and the app will identify the breed — even if it’s a mixed one.
• Cat Translator — Record your cat’s meows to decode their behavior and receive helpful tips based on the sounds they make.
• Games for cats — Discover why games are important to caring for your pet. We prepared fun and essential cat games for physical and mental well-being.
• Cat language — Understanding cat behavior and body language is key to a strong bond. In our cat app, you can find insight into why your furry friend behaves a certain way.
• Cat well-being recommendations — Ensure your feline stays healthy, calm, and content with personalized tips on hygiene, relaxation, and calming sounds.
• Meowz assistant — Do you have a question? Our in-app assistant can provide expert help with problem-solving and cat care queries.
• Cat quizzes — Test your knowledge with quizzes. From cat health to behavior, see how much you know about your feline friend while learning new tips.
Whether your buddy is a playful kitten or a seasoned senior cat, Meowz will help you to ensure your feline friend’s well-being.
The app contains the following subscription options:
- Weekly with family sharing with a 3-day free trial at $4.99; weekly with a 3-day free trial at $3.99; quarterly at $14.99; quarterly with family sharing at $19.99.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://meowz.app/privacy_policy
Terms of Service: https://meowz.app/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00029803:ios.description:
Stop guessing. Start fishing smarter.
Fishing Spots is your AI-powered fish finder — the only fishing app that gets smarter with every catch you log. Verified spots, real-time forecasts, tide charts, and solunar bite times. Built for anglers who want more than luck.
FREE WITH EVERY ACCOUNT
FIND YOUR SPOTS
Explore fishing activity at lakes, rivers, streams, inshore and offshore waters across the US and worldwide. Community-driven fishing spots near you. Discover access points, boat ramps, kayak access, fishing piers, marinas, FADs, oil platforms, buoys, depth gauges, and underwater structure (shipwrecks, fish attractors and artificial reefs) — all on one map.
KNOW BEFORE YOU GO
Local fishing reports, freshwater & saltwater fishing maps, and 7-day weather forecasts. Stop making trip decisions blind.
7-DAY FULL WEATHER FORECASTS
Real-time weather by the hour: air pressure, wind speed & direction, air & water temperature, cloud cover, rain and UV index. Marine tides, wave, swell, currents and sea surface temperature (SST).
FISHING TIDE CHARTS
Hourly tide charts and tide fishing forecasts so you can time every trip around the bite.
LOG EVERY CATCH
Track every fish with 45+ attributes — species, bait used, weather, GPS location, and more. Every entry deepens your fishing intelligence. The more you log, the smarter you fish. Automatic angler catch stats.
AI FISH ID — 866+ SPECIES
Log a catch and instantly identify any fish — freshwater to saltwater — powered by advanced AI species recognition.
KNOW YOUR BOUNDARIES
Public property lines and water access points so you always know where you can fish — and where you can't.
YOUR ANGLER COMMUNITY
Join angler groups for bass, redfish, trout, carp, crappie, and catfish fishing, follow local waters, share catches, and get tips from anglers who fish your exact spots.
IGFA WORLD & STATE FISHING RECORDS
Built-in IGFA world fishing records and USA state fishing records.
GO VIP — FISH ON ANOTHER LEVEL
FISHFORECAST™ OPTIMIZED SOLUNAR BITE WINDOWS
Know exactly when fish will feed, down to the hour. Enhanced bite predictions powered by advanced AI and solunar science.
14-DAY FULL WEATHER FORECASTS
Daily weather forecasts extended to 14 days.
MONTHLY FISHING FORECASTS
A solunar fishing calendar with moon phases that highlights the best days of the month to fish.
NEW: REAL-TIME ANIMATED WEATHER LAYERS
Extended weather radar with animated wind speed/direction, surface temperature, marine waves, swells, currents, sea surface temperature (SST) and more — see conditions in motion, not just numbers.
BAIT & LURE INTELLIGENCE
Species-specific top bait recommendations based on season, conditions, and real catch reports from anglers fishing your local waters.
VERIFIED CATCH LOCATIONS
Exact GPS coordinates of recent confirmed catches — logged by real anglers. Know where to drop in, not just where to look.
PREMIUM 3D LAKE & OCEAN DEPTH CONTOUR MAPS
3D lake contours, ocean floor mapping, and Garmin Navionics bathymetric charts. Explore structure and depth like a pro.
PRIVATE WAYPOINTS & PERSONALIZED MAPMODES™
Keep your secret spots private. Save custom map setups for instant one-tap access on the water.
MEMBER PERKS & AD-FREE
Exclusive discounts with brands, outfitters, and fishing experiences. Plus: an ad-free experience from day one.
RATED #1 FISHING APP
Millions of anglers worldwide
Partners: IGFA · Rapala · Guy Harvey · Fishial.AI · FishAngler
Bad trips happen when you go in blind.
Great trips happen when you have a guide.
Download free. Log your first catch. Fish smarter starting today.
Questions? Email us: support@fishangler.com

Weather Office provides accurate local weather data and forecasts for Canada and the USA.
Features:
- A clean layout that gives you the information you need, with no clutter.
- Current Location site that updates as you move.
- Short-term hourly forecast graph (Temperature, Wind Speed, Precipitation Amount, and Probability of Precipitation).
- Radar (DPQPE/N1P).
- Watches, warnings, and alerts, with local notifications.
- Forecast Widget with small, medium, and large layouts for current conditions, hourly timeline, and multi-day forecast.
- Weather Office is designed to be easy to use, with stable, fast, and reliable performance.
Weather data and forecasts are based on Environment Canada and/or NOAA/NWS sources.
* Radar and hourly graphs are not available in all locations.
** Notifications require Background App Refresh and are best effort.

bluejetty:00027095:ios.description:
THE #1 MOTOCROSS APP
Why choose MX Buddy?
- One-time payment. No subscription needed!
- Works on any outdoor track without internet connection.
- MX Buddy is packed with features and much more flexible than other motocross apps!
Here you find all compatible GPS devices: https://mxbuddyapp.com/devices
Main features of the app:
GPS Recording
• Live with the iPhone, the Apple Watch or for high precision GPS with the XGPS160 or the RaceBox Mini (S)
• Live panels for the display of times, consistency and much more
• Live speaking of lap and split times
• Heart rate recording (heart rate belt required)
• Race mode (time and laps)
Import GPS Data
• RaceBox Mini S or Micro
• Dragy Pro and Lite
• XGPS160
• Polar Flow
• Garmin Connect
• Workouts from Apple Health
• Apple Watch App
• GPX, TCX, KML, VBO or FIT Files
Lap Times
• Import LITPro
• Import MYLaps
• Motocross stopwatch
• Manual input
Analysis
• Lap and split times
• Race start analysis (RaceBox Mini required)
• GPS playback with metrics (speed, acceleration, etc.)
• Corner analysis
• Speed, distance and consistency score
• Theoretically best lap time
• Segment comparison
• Improvement potential per segment
• Extensive statistics
• Summary of all sessions with chart and statistics
• Heart rate analysis
• Best race strategy
• Track consistency over time
Bikes
• Manage setups for every track and track condition
• Load the fastest setup per track and soil
• Maintenance reminders
• Full export of all maintenances as PDF
Additional
• Custom tracks with map, GPS setup and type of soil
• Track weather
• Rider profile with picture and name
• Season goals
• iCloud backups
and a lot more...
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background (on iPhone or Apple Watch) can dramatically decrease battery life.
If you have questions, feel free to ask me!
mxbuddy@peacher.de
GET READY TO RACE WITH MX BUDDY !

bluejetty:00175482:ios.description:
Are you ready to embark on an extraordinary journey of style and creativity? Welcome to Mask Evolution, the ultimate game that lets you take your masks to a whole new level!
In Mask Evolution, you get to choose the right gate to improve your mask and explore an array of different styles. Begin your adventure with a simple and humble basic mask, and witness its incredible transformation as you progress through the gates. Each gate represents a unique stage of evolution, unlocking new possibilities and mind-blowing designs for your masks.
But that's not all - Mask Evolution offers a whole new dimension of gameplay! Build and manage your very own mask factory, where you can experiment and improve your masks to your heart's content. As you evolve your factory, you'll gain access to cutting-edge tools, materials, and equipment, allowing you to create even more remarkable masks.
Collect the most insane masks along the way and curate your fantastic collection of beautifully crafted and awe-inspiring face coverings. The game's intuitive controls and immersive gameplay make it a breeze to evolve your masks and manage your factory, ensuring you have an enjoyable experience from the very start.
However, this journey is not just about aesthetics - your creativity and style will be rewarded! At the end of each level, you'll earn points based on your mask's evolution and the unique combinations you create. Showcase your fashion sense and unleash your imagination to reach the ultimate goal: crafting the best mask ever seen!
Why wait? Step into the world of Mask Evolution and let your creativity shine. Download now and experience the joy of evolution, collection, and style all in one game! The most thrilling mask adventure awaits you.

bluejetty:00176612:ios.description:
It's time to start an exciting day in the airport game. To begin with, you can choose who you want to be: a passenger or a pilot.
Various cool activities await the passengers of the plane. To get started in the airport simulator game, you have to pack a suitcase. And then - welcome to the airport itself. There you have to choose where you want to fly and buy a ticket. But they will not forget to pay for it. After that, you have to hand in all the things that cannot be transported on the plane. And now the most interesting thing awaits you - passport control. There they will stamp your document - and you can get on the plane. Place all passengers in their seats, fasten their seat belts and it's time to take off. During the flight, you will have a chance to distribute drinks and food to passengers. You will reach your destination in a very short time. There you will have to get off the plane, collect your luggage and enjoy your vacation.
If you choose to become a pilot, then first you will have to choose the plane on which you will travel, prepare it for flight. You have to wash the plane and repair it. You can do this at the car wash and in the workshop. All this is in one place - the airport. You will also have to clean the interior of the plane. After that, it's time to travel.
And for the parents of our young users, we would like to point out that airport games will not only be good entertainment for your child. They will help develop her spatial thinking, imagination and attention.
P.S. We will be very thankful if after playing the game you leave reviews with your ideas and recommendations regarding the game. It will help us to make our games better and to create interesting content for you.

Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Experience the sensation of your fingers transformi
bluejetty:00066234:ios.description:
The Real Percussion provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing percussion musical instruments on your smartphone or tablet.
Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Experience the sensation of your fingers transforming into drumsticks and feel like part of a real band! 
What is percussion? 
A percussion instrument is an object designed to produce sound through shaking, scraping, or striking with the aid of drumsticks or hands.
Why haven't you started learning to play percussion yet? The Real Percussion offers various video lessons to assist you, along with a variety of loops to play along with.
Don't have access to real percussion instrument or drum set? No problem! The Real Percussion offers a diverse range of percussion musical instruments and drum sets with high-quality sounds, allowing you to play any music you desire!
You don't need an acoustic or electronic percussion to learn to play! The Real Percussion is an excellent choice for practicing or playing drums quietly, without causing disruptions or requiring much space. Enjoy the freedom to play percussion wherever you like!
Show your friends how good you are at playing percussion! Share videos of your performances with friends and on social media! 
The Real Percussion app allows children and adults to learn drumming while having fun, enhancing their cognitive and motor skills. This drum game will stimulate your musical talent, making it easy to learn beats as if using a real percussion kit.
With Real Percussion, you can play instruments like: 
- Xylophone 
- Marimba 
- Maracas 
- Tambourine
- Timpani 
- Guiro 
- Agogo
- Vibraphone 
- Castanets 
- Cajon
- Hang drum 
- Cabasa 
- Vibraslap 
- Bongos 
- Conga 
- Drum
- Cymbal 
- and more!
So what are you waiting for to become a percussionist?
Explore Real Percussion features: 
- Over 100 drum lessons to learn drumming 
- Various percussion kits, including realistic 3D sets 
- Wide variety of drums, cymbals, tambourines, and other percussion instruments
- Loops for playing along 
- Studio-quality audio 
- Export your recordings to MP3 format 
- Share your recordings on social media 
- New percussion sets, lessons, and loops introduced weekly
- Compatible with all screen resolutions 
- Phones and Tablets (HD images) 
- MIDI support 
- Free app 
The app contains the following subscription:
- Premium Version (Remove ads; Unlock all loops; Unlock all lessons and Unlock Metronome)
- Monthly payment ($3,90).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal.
- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription).
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use and Privacy Policy:
http://www.kolbapps.com/privacy_policy_and_terms.pdf
Terms of use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Designed for drummers, percussionists, professional musicians, enthusiasts, and beginners! 
Download the Real Percussion app and turn your fingers into drumsticks right now! Follow us on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube for tips on using the app: @kolbapps 
Kolb Apps: Touch & Play!

apple-macos:6760956601.name: Slate: Personal Finance
apple-macos:6760956601.description:
No subscription, no bank login, no ads. Budget together: share a folio with your partner over iCloud, and they get their own 30-day trial. Pay once, own it.
SHARE A FOLIO, SHARE THE PICTURE
Budget as a household or a business. Send an invite link, or add someone from the folio's Sharing settings, and they open the same folio on their iPhone or Mac. They get their own 30-day free trial, so there's nothing to buy before they try it. Everyone you add can enter and edit transactions, and changes appear on every device through iCloud. Each person arranges their own Dashboard, so sharing the books never means sharing a layout. Share the household folio and keep your own private. You can remove someone, or stop sharing, any time.
ADD A TRANSACTION IN SECONDS
Tap the floating + and pick a suggested payee. Slate fills in the account and category it usually goes with, so an expense is a payee, an amount, and Save. Swipe the Category row to split one purchase across several categories, with a running balance so the split always adds up.
YOUR DASHBOARD, YOUR WAY
Build a home screen of widgets: balances, what's left in a budget, cash flow, top spending, upcoming bills, and transactions to review. Filter each by account, category, payee, or period, and add, remove, resize, and rearrange them. Your widgets sync to your other devices.
MINDFUL, NOT AUTOMATIC
Bank-linking apps guess. Slate doesn't. You enter each transaction yourself, and that habit is what makes you notice where your money goes. No credentials to hand over, no connection to break.
BUDGETS THAT MAKE SENSE
Set a monthly amount per category and see what's left all month. Split one transaction across many categories so your budgets stay accurate to the dollar.
SEE THE FULL PICTURE
Budget-versus-actual, category, payee, and cash-flow reports, with a ring that shows how the month is going.
FIND ANYTHING
One Filter button searches your ledger by payee, category, amount, date, status, or type. Match any filter or all of them.
NEVER MISS A BILL
Schedule recurring rent, subscriptions, and paychecks once. When they come due, Slate enters them for you, marked unapproved, and a pop-up shows what was added so you can review and approve each one. You also see what's coming up next.
ALL YOUR ACCOUNTS, ALL YOUR BOOKS
Checking, savings, cards, and cash, with fast transfers between them. Keep personal and business in separate Folios, each with its own icon and color.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Slate collects no data. Everything lives in your iCloud and syncs across your Apple devices.
PAY ONCE. OWN IT.
30 days free, then a single purchase for every feature and every future update. No subscription, ever.

apple-itunes:6825690458.name: KIKKU: Cute Keyboard Themes
apple-itunes:6825690458.description:
KIKKU is a cute keyboard for iPhone that you decorate like a phone charm
Squishy 3D jelly keycaps, a tiny charm on the space bar, a soft patterned background and real mechanical typing sounds, all in one keyboard theme.
14 CUTE KEYBOARD THEMES
Strawberry Jelly, Chrome Heart, Black Cherry, Macaron, Soda Candy, Aurora Pearl, Milk Ribbon, Moonlight, Milk Toast, Cloud Cushion, Rose Tea, Lilac Pearl, Lilac Gummy, Silver Studio
• Each skin is a full set: keycap material, colors and background pattern
• Most skins add a little charm on the space and enter keys: ribbons, cherries, pearl hearts, macarons, lemon slices
• Pick a skin and a matching font, sound and vibration come with it
17 ASMR TYPING SOUNDS
Made from real mechanical keyboard switch recordings. Key press and release sound different, and space, enter and delete have their own sounds.
• Clicky: Clicky Blue, Heavy Click, Crisp Click
• Thocky: Deep Thock, Round Thock, Smooth, Silky, Creamy, Bright
• Bubbly: Bumpy Brown, Bubbly, Big Bump
• Retro: Retro Spring, Typewriter (with a ding on enter!)
• Everyday: Laptop, Mushy, Slim
8 PREMIUM PACKS
Winter Holiday, Keycap Keyring, Photocard Deco, Dark Coquette, Squishy Paws, Retro Game, Doodle Cat Dance, Doodle Pup Dance
• Doodle Cat & Doodle Pup Dance: a doodle cat or poodle dances on the space bar with every key you press
• Each pack: 3 skins, moving stickers, swinging charms and its own typing sound
• Get one pack, a 1-year pass or a lifetime pass. Try each pack free for 10 minutes
• Prefer another sound? You can switch any time
HAPTICS
Sharp tap, light tap or double tap, with strength from 30 to 100%.
MAKE YOUR OWN KEYBOARD
Skin → font → sound → haptics → name. That's it!
• Keycap fonts: 11 English styles (Bubble, Script, Serif, Retro, Pixel…) and 12 Korean styles
• Name it, save it and switch any time (up to 50 keyboards)
CUTE AND HANDY
• Kaomoji button with 24 cute faces
• Quick replies like "omw!" and "thank u", and you can write your own
• English word suggestions and autocorrect, processed on your phone
• Type in English, or add Korean (Hangul 2-set) and switch with one key
• Layouts that adapt to number, email and web address fields
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No internet features at all: KIKKU cannot send anything you type
• What you type is never saved or collected
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics
• "Allow Full Access" is used only for sounds, haptics and syncing your picks from the app
• In password fields, iPhone shows its own keyboard instead
MADE FOR YOU IF YOU LOVE
• Phone decorating and aesthetic keyboard themes
• Kawaii, coquette and Y2K looks: jelly, gummy, ribbons, pearls, chrome hearts
• The satisfying sound of a mechanical keyboard (keyboard ASMR)
• Apps that respect your privacy
FAQ
Q. Does KIKKU collect what I type?
A. No. KIKKU has no internet features, so it cannot send anything anywhere, and it does not store what you type.
Q. Which languages can I type in?
A. English (QWERTY) and Korean (Hangul 2-set).
Q. How do I turn it on?
A. Open the app and it walks you through it: in Settings → Keyboards turn on KIKKU and Allow Full Access, then tap the globe key while typing to switch to KIKKU.
Q. Why does it ask for Full Access?
A. iPhone only lets a keyboard play sounds, use haptics or read the skin you picked in the app when Full Access is on. KIKKU sends nothing with it. Without it you can still change skins from the KIKKU button inside the keyboard.
Q. Which iPhones are supported?
A. Any iPhone on iOS 16 or later.
Ideas or a skin you'd love to see? Tell us with "Send feedback" in the app
The 1-year pass is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically each year unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Cancel anytime in Settings > Subscriptions.

apple-macos:6766007683.name: Taverns
apple-macos:6766007683.description:
Taverns is a community and group chat app for gaming groups, guilds, clans, fandoms, roleplayers, creators, and friends. Create a Tavern, organize it into Halls, and give every conversation, call, event, and watch party a place of its own.
Core community features are available without a subscription, including Stage watch parties and file uploads up to 2 GB.
WATCH TOGETHER IN A STAGE
• Start a synchronized watch party from a YouTube, TikTok, X, Vimeo, Twitch clip, or video-file link
• Chat and react over the video, build an Up Next queue, and vote to skip
CHAT, CALL, AND SHARE
• Use text Halls, direct messages, group chats, threads, forums, announcements, and polls
• Join voice and video calls and share your screen
• Send files up to 2 GB each
• Use up to 700 custom emoji and 1,000 stickers per Tavern, plus GIFs and reactions
BUILD A PLACE THAT FEELS LIKE YOURS
• Customize Tavern themes, backgrounds, colors, fonts, Hall icons, and profiles
• Arrange Halls into categories and create public, private, or staff-only spaces
• Discover public Taverns or build your own
TOOLS FOR COMMUNITY OWNERS
• Set roles and detailed permissions
• Publish rules, plan events, manage invites, and moderate members
• Keep fast chat and longer forum discussions organized
SAFETY AND PRIVACY
Report content or accounts, block people, choose who can contact you, manage friend requests, and control how sensitive content appears. Voice, video, and screen sharing are end-to-end encrypted when everyone is using a current Taverns app. A voice Hall is not encrypted while it is being restreamed to a third-party service.
Taverns works with the same account on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows, Linux, and the web.

apple-itunes:6773389497.description:
Scan wirelessly from old and modern network scanners and multifunction printers without installing manufacturer drivers.
Bring old scanner back to life, this app quickly discovers old and new scanners that are wifi connected.
We made this app as our Samsung and HP multifunction printer/scanners were no longer supported in macOS or iOS. We found out the scanners used common protocols so developed this app. It should support most modern and older scanners if they support AirPrint or Windows wireless scanning.
This scanner app supports the two most common driverless scanning standards used by today’s wireless scanners: Apple AirScan/eSCL and Microsoft WSD/WS-Scan. In most cases, simply open the app and it will automatically detect compatible scanners on your network.
Scan documents, letters, receipts, photos and paperwork directly from your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Choose colour or black-and-white scanning, automatically crop pages, and save your scans as PDF, PNG or JPG files.
Works with many major scanner and MFP brands including Brother, Canon, Dell, Epson, HP, Kyocera, Lexmark, OKI, Panasonic, Pantum, Ricoh, Samsung, Sharp and Xerox.

* eSCL/AirScan and WSD/WS-Scan support;
* Automatic scanner detection, colour or black-and-white scanning;
* PDF/PNG/JPG saving;
* Automatic document cropping;
* Oo manufacturer scanner driver required;
Compatibility: Most wireless scanners and multifunction printers that support eSCL/AirScan or WSD/WS-Scan are expected to work. Compatibility can vary by device model, firmware version and network setup.

apple-macos:6817893874.name: 40+Fit: Workouts in 15 Minutes
apple-macos:6817893874.description:
Fifteen minutes. Thirty days. Your numbers.
40+Fit is a bodyweight program for busy people over 40. It starts with a 15-minute fitness check: push-ups, sit-ups and squats in two minutes, a pull-up set and a plank. Every session after that is scaled from your own results, so it's hard enough to work and easy enough to keep.
• A new session every day: every-minute sets, intervals, pyramids, timed max sets, a twelve-move circuit, a walk-or-run day and a mobility reset.
• A joint-friendly ramp: volume rises in four steps, with a mobility day every week.
• A guided timer: start once, and the app takes you through every block with sound, haptics and a big dial. Tap the dial to count your reps.
• A climb to follow: earn meters, reach new altitudes, collect patches, keep your streak with hut days when life gets in the way.
• A summit check on Day 30: see Day 1 against Day 30 for every exercise.
• Apple Watch: run the session on your wrist and close your Activity rings.
• Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your training stays on your device.
Days 1–8 are free. One purchase unlocks the full program, with no subscription.
Always warm up, use the easier variations when you need them, and check with a doctor if you have a heart or joint condition.
